<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;This is yet another paragraph.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> ~</span><span style="color:#22863A"> p</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">blue</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This will target <em>all</em> <code>&lt;p&gt;</code> elements that are siblings of the <code>&lt;h2&gt;</code> element and appear after it. In the example, the first two paragraphs will be blue. The last paragraph will <em>not</em> be blue, as the <code>&lt;ul&gt;</code> element breaks the sibling relationship.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3>Pseudo-Class Selectors</h3>
<p>Pseudo-classes are used to define a special state of an element. They allow you to style elements based on user interaction, element history, or content status. Pseudo-classes are prefixed with a <code>:</code>.</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong><code>:hover</code>:</strong> This pseudo-class applies styles when the user hovers their mouse over an element.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">:hover</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">red</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  text-decoration</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">none</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This will change the color of a link to red and remove the underline when the user hovers over it.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>:active</code>:</strong> This pseudo-class applies styles when an element is being activated (e.g., clicked).</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">:active</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">darkgray</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This will change the background color of a button to dark gray while it's being clicked.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>:focus</code>:</strong> This pseudo-class applies styles when an element has focus (e.g., when a user tabs to it).  It's particularly important for accessibility.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">:focus</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> blue</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  outline</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">none</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This will add a blue border to an input field and remove the default outline when it's focused. Removing the <code>outline</code> requires a visual replacement like the border for accessibility.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>:visited</code>:</strong> This pseudo-class applies styles to links that the user has already visited.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">:visited</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">purple</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This will change the color of visited links to purple.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>:first-child</code>:</strong> This pseudo-class targets the first child element within another element.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;First item&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Second item&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Third item&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">:first-child</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-weight</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">bold</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This will make the first <code>&lt;li&gt;</code> element within the <code>&lt;ul&gt;</code> bold.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>:last-child</code>:</strong> This pseudo-class targets the last child element within another element.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">:last-child</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border-bottom</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">none</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This would remove the bottom border from the last list item in a list, assuming the list items initially had a bottom border.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>:nth-child(n)</code>:</strong> This pseudo-class targets an element that is the <em>n</em>th child of another element.  <code>n</code> can be a number, a keyword (<code>even</code>, <code>odd</code>), or a formula.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Item 1&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Item 2&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Item 3&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Item 4&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Item 5&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">:nth-child</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">green</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Targets the second list item */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">:nth-child</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">odd</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#f2f2f2</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Targets odd-numbered list items */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">:nth-child</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">even</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#ddd</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Targets even-numbered list items */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">:nth-child</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">3n</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-style</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">italic</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Targets every third list item */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>These examples demonstrate targeting specific list items, alternating the background color of odd and even list items, and styling every third list item.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>:nth-of-type(n)</code>:</strong> This pseudo-class is similar to <code>:nth-child(n)</code> but targets elements of a specific type.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Paragraph 1&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Paragraph 2&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">span</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Span 1&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">span</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Paragraph 3&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">:nth-of-type</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">red</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Targets the second paragraph element within the div */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This will target the <em>second</em> <code>&lt;p&gt;</code> element within the <code>&lt;div&gt;</code>, regardless of other elements present. In this example, "Paragraph 2" would be red.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3>Pseudo-Element Selectors</h3>
<p>Pseudo-elements are used to style specific parts of an element. They allow you to style things that don't actually exist in the HTML, such as the first line of a paragraph or a marker before a list item. Pseudo-elements are prefixed with <code>::</code>. (Note the double colon <code>::</code> - using a single colon <code>:</code> will still work in many cases, but the double colon is the modern standard to distinguish pseudo-elements from pseudo-classes).</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong><code>::first-line</code>:</strong> This pseudo-element targets the first line of a block-level element.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">::first-line</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-weight</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">bold</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  text-transform</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">uppercase</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This will make the first line of every paragraph bold and uppercase.  The length of the "first line" depends on the width of the element and the size of the text.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>::first-letter</code>:</strong> This pseudo-element targets the first letter of a block-level element.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">::first-letter</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">em</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">blue</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  float</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">left</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  margin-right</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">5</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This will make the first letter of every paragraph twice the normal size, blue, floated to the left, and add a small right margin. This is often used to create a "drop cap" effect.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>::before</code>:</strong> This pseudo-element inserts content before the content of an element. It <em>requires</em> the <code>content</code> property to specify what to insert.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">::before</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  content</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Section: "</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">gray</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This will insert the text "Section: " before every <code>&lt;h2&gt;</code> element, in gray color.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>::after</code>:</strong> This pseudo-element inserts content after the content of an element.  It also <em>requires</em> the <code>content</code> property.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">::after</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  content</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">" (opens in a new window)"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">gray</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0.8</span><span style="color:#D73A49">em</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This will add the text " (opens in a new window)" after every link, in gray and a smaller font size. This can be useful for indicating that a link will open in a new tab/window, improving accessibility.  However, it is generally better practice to handle this with proper <code>target</code> and <code>rel</code> attributes and accessible link text.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>::selection</code>:</strong> This pseudo-element styles the portion of an element that is selected by the user (e.g., when highlighting text with the mouse).  It only allows a limited set of CSS properties: <code>color</code>, <code>background-color</code>, <code>cursor</code>, and <code>outline</code>.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">::selection</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">white</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">blue</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This will change the text color to white and the background color to blue when the user selects text on the page.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3>Attribute Selectors</h3>
<p>Attribute selectors target elements based on the presence or value of their attributes.</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong><code>[attribute]</code>:</strong> This selector targets all elements that have a specified attribute, regardless of its value.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"https://www.example.com"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Example Link&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"text"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"username"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">[</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">href</span><span style="color:#24292E">] {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  text-decoration</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">none</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#24292E">[</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">type</span><span style="color:#24292E">] {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> gray</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This will remove the underline from all <code>&lt;a&gt;</code> elements that have an <code>href</code> attribute and add a gray border to all <code>&lt;input&gt;</code> elements that have a <code>type</code> attribute.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>[attribute=value]</code>:</strong> This selector targets all elements that have a specified attribute with a specific value.</p>

<li>
