<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"text"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> placeholder</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Enter your email address"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"text"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> placeholder</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Enter your phone number"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#24292E">[</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">placeholder</span><span style="color:#D73A49">*=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"email"</span><span style="color:#24292E">] {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> blue</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This will target the first input field because its <code>placeholder</code> attribute contains the word "email".</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2>Specificity</h2>
<p>When multiple CSS rules target the same element, the browser needs to determine which rule takes precedence. This is determined by <em>specificity</em>. Specificity is a weight that is assigned to each CSS declaration, based on the types of selectors used. The rule with the highest specificity wins. Here's the order of specificity, from highest to lowest:</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Inline styles:</strong> Styles applied directly to the HTML element using the <code>style</code> attribute. (e.g., <code>&lt;p style="color: red;"&gt;</code>)</li>
<li><strong>IDs:</strong> ID selectors. (e.g., <code>#my-element</code>)</li>
<li><strong>Classes, pseudo-classes, and attribute selectors:</strong> (e.g., <code>.my-class</code>, <code>:hover</code>, <code>[type="text"]</code>)</li>
<li><strong>Elements and pseudo-elements:</strong> (e.g., <code>p</code>, <code>::first-line</code>)</li>
<li><strong>Universal selector:</strong> <code>*</code> (has the lowest specificity)</li>
</ol>
<p>Combinators do not affect specificity, but they do help to define the path to the element. If two selectors have the same specificity, the rule that appears <em>later</em> in the CSS will take precedence.</p>
<p>It's also possible to override specificity using the <code>!important</code> declaration. However, using <code>!important</code> excessively can make your CSS difficult to manage and debug, so it should be used sparingly and with caution. A good use case is when overriding third-party styles.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">blue</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> !important</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* This will override any other color declarations for p elements, except for inline styles */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h2>Practice Activities</h2>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Basic Selectors:</strong> Create a simple HTML document with headings, paragraphs, and links. Use element, ID, and class selectors to style these elements with different fonts, colors, and sizes.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Combinator Selectors:</strong> Create a nested HTML structure (e.g., a <code>&lt;div&gt;</code> containing an <code>&lt;article&gt;</code> containing <code>&lt;p&gt;</code> elements). Use descendant, child, adjacent sibling, and general sibling selectors to target specific elements within this structure. Experiment with different combinations to see how they affect the styling.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Pseudo-Class Selectors:</strong> Style links with different colors for their <code>:hover</code>, <code>:active</code>, and <code>:visited</code> states. Style list items with different backgrounds for <code>:nth-child(odd)</code> and <code>:nth-child(even)</code>.  Add focus styles to form elements.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Pseudo-Element Selectors:</strong> Use <code>::first-letter</code> to create a drop-cap effect on a paragraph. Use <code>::before</code> and <code>::after</code> to add custom bullets to a list or to insert decorative elements before or after headings. Style the selected text using <code>::selection</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Attribute Selectors:</strong> Style links based on their <code>href</code> attribute (e.g., different styles for external links, internal links, and email links). Style input fields based on their <code>type</code> attribute (e.g., different styles for text fields, password fields, and email fields).</p>
</li>
</ol>
  
</div>

<div id="chapter-2.2">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Understanding the CSS Box Model</h1><p>The CSS Box Model describes how HTML elements are rendered on a webpage. Every HTML element can be considered a rectangular box, and this model defines how the size, spacing, and positioning of these boxes are calculated by the browser. Understanding this model is fundamental to effectively controlling the layout and appearance of elements using CSS.</p>
<h2>Components of the Box Model</h2>
<p>The CSS Box Model is composed of four distinct areas that collectively define the space an element occupies on a page. These areas, from the innermost to the outermost, are: content, padding, border, and margin.</p>
<h3>Content Area</h3>
<p>The content area is the innermost part of the box and holds the actual content of the element, such as text, images, or other media. Its dimensions are determined by the <code>width</code> and <code>height</code> CSS properties. If no explicit <code>width</code> or <code>height</code> is set, the content area will naturally size itself to fit its content.</p>
<p>Consider a simple paragraph:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"content-example"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;This is the content of the paragraph.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.content-example</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Sets the width of the content area */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Sets the height of the content area */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">lightblue</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Helps visualize the content area */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this example, the blue area you see is the content area, explicitly set to 200 pixels wide and 100 pixels tall. Any text or images within this paragraph will reside inside this defined space.</p>
<h3>Padding Area</h3>
<p>The padding area surrounds the content area and provides space <em>between</em> the content and the element's border. Padding is an invisible space, but it takes up physical space and affects the overall size of the element. You can control padding on all four sides (top, right, bottom, left) using individual properties or a shorthand property.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>padding-top</code>: Sets the padding on the top side.</li>
<li><code>padding-right</code>: Sets the padding on the right side.</li>
<li><code>padding-bottom</code>: Sets the padding on the bottom side.</li>
<li><code>padding-left</code>: Sets the padding on the left side.</li>
<li><code>padding</code>: Shorthand property for all four sides.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.padding-example</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">lightblue</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Adds 20px padding on all sides */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* Equivalent to:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  padding-top: 20px;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  padding-right: 20px;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  padding-bottom: 20px;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  padding-left: 20px;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.individual-padding-example</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">lightcoral</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  padding-top</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  padding-right</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">30</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  padding-bottom</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  padding-left</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">40</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>With <code>padding: 20px;</code>, the content (e.g., text) will be 20 pixels away from the edge of the blue background on all sides. The total width of the element, <em>including padding</em>, would now be 200px (content) + 20px (left padding) + 20px (right padding) = 240px. Similarly, the total height would be 100px (content) + 20px (top padding) + 20px (bottom padding) = 140px. The <code>individual-padding-example</code> demonstrates how to apply different padding values to each side.</p>
<h3>Border Area</h3>
<p>The border area surrounds the padding area. It is a visible line that frames the element. You can customize the border's width, style, and color. Like padding, borders can be applied individually to each side or using shorthand properties.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>border-width</code>: Sets the thickness of the border.</li>
<li><code>border-style</code>: Sets the style of the border (e.g., <code>solid</code>, <code>dashed</code>, <code>dotted</code>, <code>none</code>).</li>
<li><code>border-color</code>: Sets the color of the border.</li>
<li><code>border</code>: Shorthand property for <code>border-width</code>, <code>border-style</code>, and <code>border-color</code>.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.border-example</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">lightblue</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">5</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> darkblue</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Adds a 5px solid dark blue border on all sides */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* Equivalent to:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  border-width: 5px;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  border-style: solid;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  border-color: darkblue;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.individual-border-example</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">lightcoral</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">15</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border-top</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> dashed</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> green</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border-right</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">4</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> purple</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border-bottom</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">6</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> dotted</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> orange</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border-left</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> double</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> teal</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Adding a border further increases the total space the element occupies. For the <code>.border-example</code>, the total width would now be 200px (content) + 20px (left padding) + 20px (right padding) + 5px (left border) + 5px (right border) = 250px. The total height would be 100px (content) + 20px (top padding) + 20px (bottom padding) + 5px (top border) + 5px (bottom border) = 150px.</p>
<h3>Margin Area</h3>
<p>The margin area is the outermost layer of the box model. It creates space <em>outside</em> the element's border, separating it from adjacent elements. Margins are transparent and do not have a background color. Similar to padding and borders, margins can be set individually or with a shorthand property.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>margin-top</code>: Sets the margin on the top side.</li>
<li><code>margin-right</code>: Sets the margin on the right side.</li>
<li><code>margin-bottom</code>: Sets the margin on the bottom side.</li>
<li><code>margin-left</code>: Sets the margin on the left side.</li>
<li><code>margin</code>: Shorthand property for all four sides.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.margin-example</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">lightblue</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">5</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> darkblue</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  margin</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">30</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Adds 30px margin on all sides, pushing other elements away */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.individual-margin-example</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">lightcoral</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> black</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  margin-top</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">5</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  margin-right</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">15</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  margin-bottom</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">25</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  margin-left</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">35</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Margins create external spacing. For the <code>.margin-example</code>, the total space occupied by the element, <em>including margin</em>, would be 250px (element with content, padding, border) + 30px (left margin) + 30px (right margin) = 310px wide. And 150px (element with content, padding, border) + 30px (top margin) + 30px (bottom margin) = 210px tall. It's crucial to understand that margins push <em>other elements away</em> from the current element.</p>
<h2>Box Sizing: <code>content-box</code> vs. <code>border-box</code></h2>
<p>By default, CSS uses the <code>content-box</code> model. This means that when you set an element's <code>width</code> and <code>height</code>, these properties apply only to the content area. Any padding and border you add will <em>increase</em> the total width and height of the element beyond the specified <code>width</code> and <code>height</code>. This can often make layout calculations more complex, as you constantly need to factor in padding and border values.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.default-box-sizing</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Content width */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Content height */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Adds 40px total to width/height */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">5</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> black</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Adds 10px total to width/height */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">lightgreen</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Total width: 200px (content) + 20px*2 (padding) + 5px*2 (border) = 250px */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Total height: 100px (content) + 20px*2 (padding) + 5px*2 (border) = 150px */</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The <code>border-box</code> model changes this behavior. When <code>box-sizing: border-box;</code> is applied, the <code>width</code> and <code>height</code> properties include the content, padding, <em>and</em> border. This means that if you set an element's <code>width</code> to 200px and then add 20px of padding and a 5px border, the content area will shrink to accommodate the padding and border, ensuring the total width remains exactly 200px. This makes layout calculations much more intuitive and predictable.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.border-box-sizing</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  box-sizing</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">border-box</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Changes the box model calculation */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Total width including padding and border */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Total height including padding and border */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* 20px left/right and 20px top/bottom taken from total width/height */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">5</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> black</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* 5px left/right and 5px top/bottom taken from total width/height */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">orange</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Total width: 200px */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Content width: 200px - (20px*2) - (5px*2) = 200px - 40px - 10px = 150px */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Total height: 100px */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Content height: 100px - (20px*2) - (5px*2) = 100px - 40px - 10px = 50px */</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Due to its predictability, <code>border-box</code> is the preferred <code>box-sizing</code> model for modern web development. Many developers apply it globally to all elements using a universal selector, sometimes combined with pseudo-elements, to simplify layout calculations:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Modern reset for box-sizing */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  box-sizing</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">border-box</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">*</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#22863A">*</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">::before</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#22863A">*</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">::after</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  box-sizing</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">inherit</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Inherit border-box from html element */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This ensures that all elements, including pseudo-elements (which were covered in the previous lesson on CSS Selectors), will use the <code>border-box</code> model for their dimensions.</p>
<h2>Margin Collapse</h2>
<p>A specific behavior of vertical margins is called <em>margin collapse</em>. When the top margin of one element meets the bottom margin of another element (or between parent and first/last child, or even empty blocks), only the larger of the two margins is applied, and the smaller one collapses. They do not add up.</p>
<p>Consider two paragraphs, each with a top and bottom margin:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"margin-collapse-example"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Paragraph 1&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"margin-collapse-example"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Paragraph 2&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.margin-collapse-example</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  margin-top</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">30</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  margin-bottom</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">lightgreen</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this scenario, the bottom margin of "Paragraph 1" (20px) meets the top margin of "Paragraph 2" (30px). Instead of a total of 50px separating them, only the larger margin of 30px will be used. The 20px margin from the first paragraph will "collapse" into the 30px margin of the second. Margin collapse only applies to vertical margins (top and bottom), not horizontal margins (left and right).</p>
<p>Understanding margin collapse is essential when debugging unexpected vertical spacing between elements. It's a common source of confusion for beginners but a standard browser behavior designed to create aesthetically pleasing vertical rhythms in text content.</p>
<h2>Practical Examples and Demonstrations</h2>
<p>Let's build a simple card component to demonstrate all aspects of the box model and the effect of <code>box-sizing</code>.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;!</span><span style="color:#22863A">DOCTYPE</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> lang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> charset</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"UTF-8"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"viewport"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> content</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;CSS Box Model Demo&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">style</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        /* Modern box-sizing reset */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        html</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            box-sizing</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">border-box</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        *</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#22863A">*</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">::before</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#22863A">*</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">::after</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            box-sizing</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">inherit</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        body</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-family</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">sans-serif</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Using flexbox for layout, will be covered in a later lesson */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            gap</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            flex-wrap</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">wrap</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .card</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">250</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Intentional total width */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#f0f0f0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> #ccc</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">15</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            text-align</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">center</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .card</span><span style="color:#22863A"> h3</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin-top</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Reset top margin to prevent collapse with parent's padding */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin-bottom</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#333</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .card</span><span style="color:#22863A"> p</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin-bottom</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Reset bottom margin to keep content tight to bottom padding */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0.9</span><span style="color:#D73A49">em</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#555</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        /* Demonstrating content-box vs. border-box */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .card-content-box</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            box-sizing</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">content-box</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Override global setting for demonstration */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">250</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* This will be the content width */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">15</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> red</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* To highlight the difference */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#f9e0e0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">style</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
