<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"card"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Product A&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;This is a description for product A. It has a nice design and features.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"card"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Product B&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Product B offers great value and comes with excellent customer support.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"card card-content-box"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Product C (Content Box)&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Notice how this card is wider than the others due to content-box sizing.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this example:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong><code>.card</code></strong>:
<ul>
<li><code>width: 250px;</code> with <code>box-sizing: border-box</code> (inherited from the universal reset) means the <em>total</em> width of the card, including its padding and border, will be 250px. The content area inside will be <code>250px - (15px * 2) - (2px * 2) = 250px - 30px - 4px = 216px</code> wide.</li>
<li><code>padding: 15px;</code> creates internal space around the content.</li>
<li><code>border: 2px solid #ccc;</code> creates a visual boundary.</li>
<li><code>margin: 10px;</code> creates external space, pushing cards away from each other by 10px in all directions.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong><code>.card h3</code> and <code>.card p</code></strong>:
<ul>
<li>Their <code>margin-top</code> and <code>margin-bottom</code> are adjusted. Setting <code>margin-top: 0;</code> on <code>h3</code> prevents its top margin from collapsing with the top padding of the <code>.card</code> div, ensuring the heading starts directly at the card's padding boundary. Setting <code>margin-bottom: 0;</code> on <code>p</code> ensures the paragraph aligns closely with the bottom padding.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong><code>.card-content-box</code></strong>:
<ul>
<li>This class <em>overrides</em> the global <code>box-sizing: border-box</code> to demonstrate the default <code>content-box</code> behavior.</li>
<li>Here, <code>width: 250px;</code> means the <em>content area alone</em> is 250px.</li>
<li>Adding <code>padding: 15px;</code> and <code>border: 2px solid red;</code> will <em>increase</em> its total width to <code>250px (content) + 15px*2 (padding) + 2px*2 (border) = 284px</code>. This card will appear visibly wider than the others.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>This demonstration visually highlights the practical implications of the box model components and the critical difference <code>box-sizing: border-box</code> makes for predictable layouts.</p>
<h2>Exercises</h2>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Box Model Exploration:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Create an HTML file with three <code>div</code> elements.</li>
<li>Apply a distinct <code>background-color</code> to each <code>div</code> for visibility.</li>
<li>For the first <code>div</code>, set a <code>width</code>, <code>height</code>, and then add <code>padding</code>, <code>border</code>, and <code>margin</code> using different units (e.g., <code>px</code>, <code>%</code>, <code>em</code>). Use the default <code>content-box</code> model.</li>
<li>For the second <code>div</code>, apply the exact same <code>width</code>, <code>height</code>, <code>padding</code>, <code>border</code>, and <code>margin</code> values, but explicitly set <code>box-sizing: border-box;</code>.</li>
<li>For the third <code>div</code>, use individual <code>padding</code> properties (e.g., <code>padding-top</code>, <code>padding-left</code>) and individual <code>border</code> properties (e.g., <code>border-bottom-width</code>, <code>border-left-color</code>).</li>
<li>Observe the differences in their rendered sizes and spacing. Use your browser's developer tools to inspect each element and see the computed box model dimensions.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Margin Collapse Challenge:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Create an HTML file with two <code>h2</code> elements and two <code>p</code> elements directly stacked one after another.</li>
<li>Apply <code>margin-top: 40px;</code> and <code>margin-bottom: 30px;</code> to the <code>h2</code> elements.</li>
<li>Apply <code>margin-top: 20px;</code> and <code>margin-bottom: 50px;</code> to the <code>p</code> elements.</li>
<li>Analyze the vertical spacing between the elements.</li>
<li>Specifically, what is the gap between the first <code>h2</code> and the first <code>p</code>? What about between the first <code>p</code> and the second <code>h2</code>? And between the second <code>h2</code> and the second <code>p</code>? Explain why based on margin collapse rules.</li>
<li>Modify the CSS (e.g., add padding, or change <code>display</code> property which will be covered later) to prevent margin collapse between one specific pair of elements and observe the change.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Building a Button with Box Model:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Create an HTML button (<code>&lt;button&gt;</code>) or an anchor tag styled as a button (<code>&lt;a&gt;</code>).</li>
<li>Using only <code>width</code>, <code>height</code>, <code>padding</code>, <code>border</code>, and <code>margin</code>, style it to look like a prominent call-to-action button.</li>
<li>Experiment with different <code>padding</code> values to control the spacing of the text inside the button.</li>
<li>Add a subtle <code>border</code> and experiment with its <code>width</code> and <code>color</code>.</li>
<li>Give it <code>margin</code> to ensure it's spaced appropriately from other elements on the page.</li>
<li>Ensure the button uses <code>box-sizing: border-box;</code> for predictable sizing.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
  
</div>

<div id="chapter-2.3">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Working with Colors, Fonts, and Text Styles</h1><p>This lesson focuses on how to control the visual presentation of text and background elements using CSS. You will learn to manipulate colors, choose and style fonts, and apply various text styling properties to enhance readability and aesthetics.</p>
<h2>Understanding Colors in CSS</h2>
<p>Colors are fundamental to web design, affecting both aesthetics and user experience. In CSS, colors can be specified using several different formats, each offering different levels of control and readability.</p>
<h3>Color Keywords</h3>
<p>The simplest way to define colors is by using predefined color keywords. CSS offers a wide range of these keywords, such as <code>red</code>, <code>blue</code>, <code>green</code>, <code>black</code>, <code>white</code>, <code>orange</code>, <code>purple</code>, and many more. These are straightforward and easy to read.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Example using color keywords */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">blue</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Sets the text color to blue */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">lightgray</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Sets the background of the heading to light gray */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>While convenient, color keywords offer limited precision as you can only choose from the predefined set.</p>
<h3>Hexadecimal Color Codes</h3>
<p>Hexadecimal color codes (hex codes) provide a more precise way to define colors. They start with a <code>#</code> symbol followed by six hexadecimal digits (0-9, A-F). Each pair of digits represents the intensity of red, green, and blue light, respectively, ranging from <code>00</code> (least intense) to <code>FF</code> (most intense).</p>
<ul>
<li><code>#RRGGBB</code>: Represents full-length hex codes.
<ul>
<li><code>RR</code>: Red intensity</li>
<li><code>GG</code>: Green intensity</li>
<li><code>BB</code>: Blue intensity</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>For example, <code>#FF0000</code> is pure red, <code>#00FF00</code> is pure green, and <code>#0000FF</code> is pure blue. Black is <code>#000000</code> and white is <code>#FFFFFF</code>.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Example using hexadecimal color codes */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#f0f8ff</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* AliceBlue background */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.highlight</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#c0392b</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* A shade of red */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>A shorthand notation exists for hex codes where each pair of digits is the same (e.g., <code>#FFCC00</code> can be written as <code>#FC0</code>). The shorthand form is <code>#RGB</code>.</p>
<h3>RGB and RGBA Color Values</h3>
<p>RGB (Red, Green, Blue) color values use the <code>rgb()</code> function to define a color by specifying the intensity of red, green, and blue as integers from 0 to 255.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>rgb(red, green, blue)</code>: Each component is an integer from 0 to 255.</li>
</ul>
<p>For example, <code>rgb(255, 0, 0)</code> is pure red, <code>rgb(0, 255, 0)</code> is pure green, and <code>rgb(0, 0, 255)</code> is pure blue. <code>rgb(0, 0, 0)</code> is black, and <code>rgb(255, 255, 255)</code> is white.</p>
<p>RGBA (Red, Green, Blue, Alpha) extends RGB by adding an alpha channel, which controls the opacity of the color. The alpha value ranges from 0 (completely transparent) to 1 (completely opaque).</p>
<ul>
<li><code>rgba(red, green, blue, alpha)</code>: <code>alpha</code> is a float from 0 to 1.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Example using RGB and RGBA color values */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.main-heading</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">rgb</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">75</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">139</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">190</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* A specific shade of blue */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.overlay</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">rgba</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0.5</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Semi-transparent black */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>RGBA is particularly useful for creating overlays or effects where you want to see content behind a colored element.</p>
<h3>HSL and HSLA Color Values</h3>
<p>HSL (Hue, Saturation, Lightness) color values describe colors based on how humans perceive them. This method uses the <code>hsl()</code> function:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>hsl(hue, saturation, lightness)</code>:
<ul>
<li><code>hue</code>: A degree on the color wheel from 0 to 360 (0 = red, 120 = green, 240 = blue).</li>
<li><code>saturation</code>: A percentage from 0% (grayscale) to 100% (full color).</li>
<li><code>lightness</code>: A percentage from 0% (black) to 100% (white).</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>HSLA (Hue, Saturation, Lightness, Alpha) adds an alpha channel, similar to RGBA.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>hsla(hue, saturation, lightness, alpha)</code>: <code>alpha</code> is a float from 0 to 1.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Example using HSL and HSLA color values */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.button</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">hsl</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">70</span><span style="color:#D73A49">%</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">50</span><span style="color:#D73A49">%</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* A vibrant blue button */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.shadow</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">hsla</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#D73A49">%</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#D73A49">%</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0.7</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Slightly transparent black text */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>HSL/HSLA can be more intuitive for designers as it aligns with how colors are often chosen in design tools.</p>
<h3>Applying Colors</h3>
<p>The primary CSS properties for applying colors are:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>color</code>: Sets the foreground color of an element's text.</li>
<li><code>background-color</code>: Sets the background color of an element.</li>
<li><code>border-color</code>: Sets the color of an element's border (covered in more detail with the Box Model).</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;!</span><span style="color:#22863A">DOCTYPE</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> lang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"viewport"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> content</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-family</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">Arial</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">sans-serif</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .text-section</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .colored-box-hex</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">white</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* White text for contrast */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin-bottom</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">black</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Black text for contrast */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin-bottom</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            text-align</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">center</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .colored-box-hsl</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">hsl</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">80</span><span style="color:#D73A49">%</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">60</span><span style="color:#D73A49">%</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Blue color using HSL */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">white</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* White text for contrast */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin-bottom</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            text-align</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">center</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .transparent-overlay</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">rgba</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0.7</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Semi-transparent black overlay */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">white</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            text-align</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">center</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            position</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">relative</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            z-index</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Ensures it's above other elements if positioned */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">80</span><span style="color:#D73A49">%</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">auto</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">style</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Exploring Color in CSS&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"text-section"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;This paragraph uses a dark gray text color defined with a hex code.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> style</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"color: purple;"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;This paragraph uses a CSS color keyword for its text color.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"colored-box-hex"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        This box has a background color defined using a hexadecimal code.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"colored-box-rgb"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        This box has a background color defined using RGB values.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"colored-box-hsl"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        This box has a background color defined using HSL values.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"transparent-overlay"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        This is an example of a semi-transparent background using RGBA. You can still vaguely see through it.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In the example above, different color formats are used for <code>background-color</code> and <code>color</code> properties, demonstrating their application across various HTML elements. The <code>transparent-overlay</code> class specifically shows how the alpha channel in <code>rgba()</code> can create a see-through effect.</p>
<h2>Working with Fonts</h2>
<p>Fonts are crucial for readability and conveying the tone of a website. CSS provides properties to control which fonts are used, their size, weight, and style.</p>
<h3>Font Families (<code>font-family</code>)</h3>
<p>The <code>font-family</code> property specifies the typeface to be used for an element's text. It's best practice to provide a "font stack," which is a comma-separated list of font names. The browser will try to load the first font in the list. If that font isn't available, it moves to the next, and so on. The list should end with a generic font family.</p>
<p>Common generic font families include:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>serif</code>: Fonts with small decorative lines at the ends of strokes (e.g., Times New Roman).</li>
<li><code>sans-serif</code>: Fonts without these decorative lines (e.g., Arial, Helvetica).</li>
<li><code>monospace</code>: Fonts where all characters have the same width (e.g., Courier New).</li>
<li><code>cursive</code>: Fonts that mimic handwriting.</li>
<li><code>fantasy</code>: Decorative fonts.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Example of font-family declaration */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-family</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">Arial</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">Helvetica</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">sans-serif</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Prioritizes Arial, then Helvetica, then any sans-serif font */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-family</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Palatino Linotype"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Book Antiqua"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, Palatino, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">serif</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Custom serif stack */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>If a font name contains spaces, it must be enclosed in quotation marks (e.g., <code>"Times New Roman"</code>).</p>
<h3>Font Size (<code>font-size</code>)</h3>
<p>The <code>font-size</code> property controls the size of the text. It can be specified using various units:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Absolute units:</strong> <code>px</code> (pixels), <code>pt</code> (points), <code>cm</code> (centimeters). Pixels are common for fixed-size designs.</li>
<li><strong>Relative units:</strong>
<ul>
<li><code>em</code>: Relative to the font-size of the <em>parent</em> element. <code>2em</code> means twice the parent's font size.</li>
<li><code>rem</code>: Relative to the font-size of the <em>root</em> (html) element. <code>2rem</code> means twice the root's font size. This is often preferred for more predictable scaling.</li>
<li><code>%</code>: Relative to the font-size of the parent element.</li>
<li><code>vw</code> (viewport width), <code>vh</code> (viewport height): Relative to the viewport's dimensions.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Example of font-size */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">16</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Absolute size in pixels */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1.5</span><span style="color:#D73A49">em</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* 1.5 times the parent's font size */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.lead-text</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1.2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">rem</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* 1.2 times the root element's font size */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Using relative units like <code>rem</code> and <code>em</code> is crucial for creating responsive designs, allowing text to scale appropriately across different screen sizes.</p>
<h3>Font Weight (<code>font-weight</code>)</h3>
<p>The <code>font-weight</code> property sets the thickness (or boldness) of the characters.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Keywords:</strong> <code>normal</code> (equivalent to 400), <code>bold</code> (equivalent to 700).</li>
<li><strong>Numeric values:</strong> From 100 (lightest) to 900 (heaviest), in multiples of 100. Not all fonts support all numeric weights; if a specific weight isn't available, the browser will render the closest available weight.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Example of font-weight */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">strong</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-weight</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">bold</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Bold text */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.thin-text</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-weight</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">300</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Lighter text if font supports it */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-weight</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">700</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Often used for headings */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Font Style (<code>font-style</code>)</h3>
<p>The <code>font-style</code> property is primarily used to set text to <em>italic</em>.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>normal</code>: Standard text.</li>
<li><code>italic</code>: Text is italicized.</li>
<li><code>oblique</code>: Text is slanted, but typically less common than <code>italic</code> and often rendered the same.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Example of font-style */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">em</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-style</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">italic</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Emphasized text is italic by default */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.intro-paragraph</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-style</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">normal</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Ensures text is not italic */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>The <code>font</code> Shorthand Property</h3>
<p>The <code>font</code> shorthand property allows you to set several font properties in a single declaration: <code>font-style</code>, <code>font-variant</code>, <code>font-weight</code>, <code>font-size</code>, <code>line-height</code>, and <code>font-family</code>. The order is important.</p>
<p>The most common usage is: <code>font: font-weight font-size/line-height font-family;</code></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Example of font shorthand property */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.caption</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">italic</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> bold</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 14</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">/</span><span style="color:#005CC5">1.5</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> Arial</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">sans-serif</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* Equivalent to:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">     font-style: italic;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">     font-weight: bold;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">     font-size: 14px;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">     line-height: 1.5;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">     font-family: Arial, sans-serif;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Using the shorthand can make your CSS more concise.</p>
<h3>Web Fonts (<code>@font-face</code>)</h3>
<p>While browsers come with a default set of "web-safe" fonts, designers often want to use custom fonts. The <code>@font-face</code> CSS rule allows you to define and embed custom fonts on your webpage, ensuring that they are displayed correctly even if the user doesn't have them installed on their system.</p>
<p>You need to provide the path to the font files (e.g., <code>.woff</code>, <code>.woff2</code>, <code>.ttf</code>, <code>.otf</code>). <code>WOFF2</code> is the most modern and efficient format.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Example of @font-face rule */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">@font-face</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-family</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Open Sans'</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* The name you'll use in font-family */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  src</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">url</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'fonts/OpenSans-Regular.woff2'</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#005CC5">format</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'woff2'</span><span style="color:#24292E">),</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">       url</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'fonts/OpenSans-Regular.woff'</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#005CC5">format</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'woff'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-weight</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">normal</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-style</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">normal</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">@font-face</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-family</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Open Sans'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  src</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">url</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'fonts/OpenSans-Bold.woff2'</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#005CC5">format</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'woff2'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-weight</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">bold</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Defines the bold version of Open Sans */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-style</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">normal</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-family</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Open Sans'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">sans-serif</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Uses the custom font */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>It's common to use services like Google Fonts which provide embed codes that include the <code>@font-face</code> rules for you.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> lang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"viewport"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> content</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Font Examples&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">link</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Open+Sans:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,700;1,400&amp;display=swap"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> rel</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"stylesheet"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
