<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-family</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Open Sans'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">sans-serif</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Using Open Sans from Google Fonts */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            line-height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1.6</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Default line height for readability */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#333</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        h1</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2.5</span><span style="color:#D73A49">rem</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Larger heading using rem units */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-weight</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">700</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Bold weight */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#2c3e50</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Dark blue color */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        h2</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1.8</span><span style="color:#D73A49">rem</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-weight</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">600</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#34495e</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        p</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">rem</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin-bottom</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">em</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Margin below paragraphs */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .light-text</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-weight</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">300</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Lighter text */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-style</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">italic</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Italic style */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#7f8c8d</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .emphasized</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-weight</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">bold</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-style</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">normal</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Explicitly normal style */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#e74c3c</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Red color */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .small-caption</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">italic</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 12</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">/</span><span style="color:#005CC5">1.4</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> Georgia</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">serif</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Shorthand for smaller, italic text */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#95a5a6</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">style</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Welcome to Our Website&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;This is a standard paragraph using the 'Open Sans' font with default weight and style. We're learning how to control fonts in CSS.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Exploring Font Properties&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"light-text"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;This paragraph demonstrates a &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">strong</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;lighter font weight&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">strong</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt; and an *italic* font style. It's often used for subtle emphasis or secondary information.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"emphasized"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Here, we have some &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">span</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> style</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"font-size: 1.2em;"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;emphasized text&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">span</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt; that is explicitly set to bold and normal style to stand out from the default italic for `&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">em</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;` or `&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">i</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;`.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Using different &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">span</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> style</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 0.9em;"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;font-families like monospace&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">span</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt; can be useful for code snippets or special formatting.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"small-caption"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;This is a small caption using the font shorthand property to quickly define its appearance.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The example above imports a custom font (<code>Open Sans</code>) from Google Fonts and then applies various <code>font-*</code> properties, including <code>font-family</code>, <code>font-size</code>, <code>font-weight</code>, and <code>font-style</code> to different elements. It also demonstrates the <code>font</code> shorthand.</p>
<h2>Text Styling Properties</h2>
<p>Beyond color and font, CSS provides many properties to control the appearance of text, such as alignment, decoration, spacing, and capitalization.</p>
<h3>Text Alignment (<code>text-align</code>)</h3>
<p>The <code>text-align</code> property controls the horizontal alignment of text within its containing block element.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>left</code>: Aligns text to the left.</li>
<li><code>right</code>: Aligns text to the right.</li>
<li><code>center</code>: Centers text horizontally.</li>
<li><code>justify</code>: Stretches lines so that each line has equal width, and the left and right margins are straight.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Example of text-align */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.header</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  text-align</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">center</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Centers the heading */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.article-content</span><span style="color:#22863A"> p</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  text-align</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">justify</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Justifies paragraph text */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Text Decoration (<code>text-decoration</code>)</h3>
<p>The <code>text-decoration</code> property is used to add or remove decorations from text. It's most commonly used to remove the underline from links.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>none</code>: Removes any decoration (e.g., underlines on links).</li>
<li><code>underline</code>: Adds an underline.</li>
<li><code>overline</code>: Adds a line above the text.</li>
<li><code>line-through</code>: Adds a line through the text.</li>
</ul>
<p>You can also specify the color, style (<code>solid</code>, <code>double</code>, <code>dotted</code>, <code>dashed</code>, <code>wavy</code>), and thickness of the decoration.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Example of text-decoration */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  text-decoration</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">none</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Removes underline from links */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.strike-through</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  text-decoration</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">line-through</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> red</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> wavy</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Red, wavy, 2px thick line-through */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Text Transform (<code>text-transform</code>)</h3>
<p>The <code>text-transform</code> property controls the capitalization of text.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>none</code>: No capitalization change.</li>
<li><code>uppercase</code>: Converts all characters to uppercase.</li>
<li><code>lowercase</code>: Converts all characters to lowercase.</li>
<li><code>capitalize</code>: Capitalizes the first letter of each word.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Example of text-transform */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.tagline</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  text-transform</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">uppercase</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* All caps */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.product-name</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  text-transform</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">capitalize</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* First letter of each word capitalized */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Line Height (<code>line-height</code>)</h3>
<p>The <code>line-height</code> property sets the height of a line box. It influences the vertical spacing between lines of text. A common best practice is to set it as a unitless number (a multiplier) relative to the font size, typically between 1.2 and 1.8 for good readability.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Example of line-height */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  line-height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1.6</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* 1.6 times the font-size */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  line-height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1.2</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Tighter line-height for headings */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Letter Spacing (<code>letter-spacing</code>)</h3>
<p>The <code>letter-spacing</code> property controls the spacing between individual characters (letters) in a text. Positive values increase spacing, negative values decrease it.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Example of letter-spacing */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  letter-spacing</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Spreads out letters in heading */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.compact-text</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  letter-spacing</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">-0.5</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Slightly tighter letter spacing */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Word Spacing (<code>word-spacing</code>)</h3>
<p>The <code>word-spacing</code> property controls the spacing between words in a text.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Example of word-spacing */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.emphasized-quote</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  word-spacing</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">5</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Increases space between words */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Text Shadow (<code>text-shadow</code>)</h3>
<p>The <code>text-shadow</code> property applies shadow effects to text. It takes values for horizontal offset, vertical offset, blur radius, and color.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>text-shadow: horizontal-offset vertical-offset blur-radius color;</code></li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Example of text-shadow */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.shadowed-title</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">white</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  text-shadow</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 4</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> #000000</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Black shadow, 2px right, 2px down, 4px blur */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.subtle-shadow</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#333</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  text-shadow</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> rgba</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0.3</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Subtle light shadow */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Whitespace (<code>white-space</code>)</h3>
<p>The <code>white-space</code> property controls how white space (including spaces, tabs, and newlines) inside an element is handled.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>normal</code>: White space is collapsed, and text wraps as needed.</li>
<li><code>nowrap</code>: White space is collapsed, but text will not wrap (it will continue on a single line until a <code>&lt;br&gt;</code> tag).</li>
<li><code>pre</code>: Preserves white space exactly as written in the HTML and prevents text wrapping.</li>
<li><code>pre-wrap</code>: Preserves white space and allows text to wrap.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Example of white-space */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.code-block</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  white-space</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">pre-wrap</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Preserves formatting but allows wrapping */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-family</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">monospace</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#eee</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;!</span><span style="color:#22863A">DOCTYPE</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> lang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> charset</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"UTF-8"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"viewport"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> content</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Text Styling Examples&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">style</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        body</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-family</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">Arial</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">sans-serif</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#333</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            line-height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1.6</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        h1</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            text-align</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">center</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Center aligns the main heading */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#2c3e50</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            text-transform</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">uppercase</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Converts to uppercase */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            letter-spacing</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Increases space between letters */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            text-shadow</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 3</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> rgba</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0.3</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Adds a subtle shadow */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin-bottom</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">30</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .intro-paragraph</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            text-align</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">justify</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Justifies the introductory paragraph */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            text-indent</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">30</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Indents the first line */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin-bottom</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .section-heading</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            text-align</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">left</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Left aligns the section heading */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#3498db</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            text-decoration</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">underline</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Underlines the text */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin-top</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">40</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin-bottom</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">15</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .highlighted-text</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#e74c3c</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-weight</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">bold</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-style</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">italic</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            text-decoration</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">line-through</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> #e74c3c</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Red line-through */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .call-to-action</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            text-align</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">right</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Right aligns a call to action */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1.1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">em</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            word-spacing</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">5</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Increases space between words */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin-top</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">25</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .code-example</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#f4f4f4</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> #ddd</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-family</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Courier New'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">monospace</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            white-space</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">pre-wrap</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Preserves white space and allows wrapping */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0.9</span><span style="color:#D73A49">em</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#555</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin-top</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">style</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Advanced Text Styles&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"intro-paragraph"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;This introductory paragraph demonstrates the use of &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">code</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;text-align: justify;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">code</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt; to create neat, block-like text, along with a first-line indent using &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">code</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;text-indent&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">code</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;. Readability is key in web design.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"section-heading"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Styling Specific Elements&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Here is some &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">span</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"highlighted-text"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;text with multiple decorations and styles&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">span</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt; applied, including a custom line-through. This shows how you can combine different text properties.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"call-to-action"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        Ready to learn more? Explore our &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">span</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> style</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"text-transform: uppercase; color: #27ae60;"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;courses today!&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">span</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Below is an example of a code block where &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">code</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;white-space: pre-wrap;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">code</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt; is used to maintain formatting while also allowing long lines to wrap:&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">pre</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"code-example"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">function greet(name) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    if (name) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        console.log("Hello, " + name + "! Welcome to the world of web development. We hope you enjoy learning with us!");</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    } else {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        console.log("Hello there!");</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">greet("Learner");</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">pre</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Using &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">code</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;text-shadow&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">code</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt; can add depth to text, as seen in the main heading of this page. It's great for visual flair.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The example showcases a variety of text styling properties, including <code>text-align</code>, <code>text-transform</code>, <code>letter-spacing</code>, <code>text-decoration</code>, <code>line-height</code>, <code>word-spacing</code>, <code>text-shadow</code>, and <code>white-space</code>, applied to different HTML elements to achieve distinct visual effects.</p>
<h2>Exercises</h2>
<p>Apply the knowledge gained from this lesson to the following exercises. Each exercise builds upon the previous examples or introduces new scenarios for practice.</p>
<h3>Exercise 1: Color Palette Application</h3>
<p>Modify the <code>Color Examples</code> HTML and CSS from the "Understanding Colors in CSS" section.</p>
<ol>
<li>Change the <code>body</code> background color to a very light blue using <strong>HSL</strong>: <code>hsl(210, 60%, 98%)</code>.</li>
<li>Update the <code>.colored-box-hex</code> background color to a vibrant orange using a <strong>hex code</strong> like <code>#FF6F00</code>. Change its text color to black.</li>
<li>Update the <code>.colored-box-rgb</code> background color to a calming teal using <strong>RGB</strong>: <code>rgb(0, 128, 128)</code>. Change its text color to white.</li>
<li>Update the <code>.colored-box-hsl</code> background color to a deep purple using <strong>HSLA</strong> with 80% opacity: <code>hsla(270, 50%, 40%, 0.8)</code>. Change its text color to a light gray (<code>#eee</code>).</li>
<li>Change the paragraph text color within <code>.text-section</code> to a dark charcoal gray using a <strong>color keyword</strong>: <code>darkslategray</code>.</li>
</ol>
<h3>Exercise 2: Font Styling Overhaul</h3>
<p>Take the <code>Font Examples</code> HTML and CSS from the "Working with Fonts" section.</p>
<ol>
<li>Change the <code>body</code> <code>font-family</code> to <code>"Lato", sans-serif;</code> (you'll need to link to Google Fonts for Lato, similar to how Open Sans was linked).</li>
<li>Set the <code>h1</code> <code>font-size</code> to <code>3rem</code> and its <code>font-weight</code> to <code>900</code>.</li>
<li>Set the <code>h2</code> <code>font-size</code> to <code>2rem</code> and its <code>font-weight</code> to <code>700</code>.</li>
<li>Create a new class <code>callout-text</code> for a paragraph. Apply <code>font-size: 1.15em;</code>, <code>font-weight: 500;</code>, and <code>font-style: italic;</code>.</li>
<li>Change the <code>.small-caption</code> font stack to use a <code>monospace</code> font like <code>"Lucida Console", Monaco, monospace;</code> and reduce its <code>font-size</code> to <code>11px</code>.</li>
</ol>
<h3>Exercise 3: Advanced Text Transformations</h3>
<p>Using the <code>Text Styling Examples</code> HTML and CSS from the "Text Styling Properties" section.</p>
<ol>
<li>Remove the <code>text-decoration</code> from the <code>.section-heading</code> and instead add <code>border-bottom: 2px solid #3498db;</code> with <code>padding-bottom: 5px;</code> to achieve a similar visual separation.</li>
<li>For the <code>h1</code> element, adjust the <code>text-shadow</code> to be <code>0px 5px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)</code>. Change its <code>letter-spacing</code> to <code>5px</code>.</li>
<li>Create a new paragraph with the class <code>disclaimer</code>. Set its <code>font-size</code> to <code>0.8rem</code>, <code>color</code> to <code>gray</code>, <code>text-align</code> to <code>center</code>, and <code>text-transform</code> to <code>lowercase</code>.</li>
<li>In the <code>.call-to-action</code> div, increase the <code>line-height</code> to <code>1.8</code> and set its <code>text-transform</code> to <code>capitalize</code>.</li>
<li>For the <code>.code-example</code> block, ensure <code>letter-spacing</code> is set to <code>0.5px</code> to make it slightly more legible.</li>
</ol>
  
</div>

<div id="chapter-2.4">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">CSS Layout Techniques: Flexbox</h1><p>Flexbox is a one-dimensional layout method designed to distribute space among items within a single row or column. It provides a more efficient way to lay out, align, and distribute space among items in a container, even when their size is unknown or dynamic. Flexbox offers powerful capabilities for creating flexible and responsive designs, addressing common layout challenges without relying on floats or positioning.</p>
<h2>Flex Container and Flex Items</h2>
<p>To use Flexbox, you first define a <strong>flex container</strong>. Any direct children of this container become <strong>flex items</strong>. The core principle is that the container manages the layout of its direct children.</p>
<p>You declare an element as a flex container by setting its <code>display</code> property to <code>flex</code> or <code>inline-flex</code>.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>display: flex;</code> makes the container a block-level flex container, meaning it takes up the full width available and forces a line break after it.</li>
<li><code>display: inline-flex;</code> makes the container an inline-level flex container, meaning it flows with the surrounding content like an inline element, only taking up as much width as its content, but its internal children are laid out using Flexbox.</li>
</ul>
<h3><code>display: flex;</code> Example</h3>
<p>Consider a common scenario: arranging navigation links horizontally.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"#"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Contact&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Makes .main-nav a flex container */</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.main-nav</span><span style="color:#22863A"> a</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">white</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  text-decoration</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">none</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  margin-right</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Add some space between links */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this example, the <code>nav</code> element becomes a flex container. Its direct children (<code>a</code> elements) automatically become flex items and arrange themselves in a row by default.</p>
<h3><code>display: inline-flex;</code> Example</h3>
<p>Imagine a group of buttons that should appear inline with text, but whose internal content needs flexible alignment.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Action 1&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Action 2&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">span</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt; more text.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.button-group</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">inline-flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Flex container acts like an inline element */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> blue</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  gap</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Space between buttons, a more modern approach than margin-right */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.button-group</span><span style="color:#22863A"> button</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">8</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 12</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">lightblue</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">none</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Here, <code>.button-group</code> behaves like an inline element in the flow of the <code>p</code> tag, but the buttons inside it are laid out flexibly.</p>
<h2>Main Axis and Cross Axis</h2>
<p>Flexbox operates along two axes:</p>
<ul>
<li>The <strong>main axis</strong> is the primary axis along which flex items are laid out. By default, this is horizontal (left to right).</li>
<li>The <strong>cross axis</strong> is perpendicular to the main axis. By default, this is vertical (top to bottom).</li>
</ul>
<p>The direction of the main axis is controlled by the <code>flex-direction</code> property, which you apply to the <strong>flex container</strong>.</p>
<h3><code>flex-direction</code> Property</h3>
<p>The <code>flex-direction</code> property defines the direction of the main axis and thus the direction in which flex items are placed in the flex container.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>row</code> (default): Items are arranged horizontally, from left to right (or right to left in RTL languages).</li>
<li><code>row-reverse</code>: Items are arranged horizontally, from right to left.</li>
<li><code>column</code>: Items are arranged vertically, from top to bottom.</li>
<li><code>column-reverse</code>: Items are arranged vertically, from bottom to top.</li>
</ul>
<h3><code>flex-direction: row;</code> (Default)</h3>
<p>This is the default behavior. Items flow horizontally.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"container row-example"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<p>The items "1", "2", and "3" will appear next to each other from left to right.</p>

<h2>Wrapping Flex Items with <code>flex-wrap</code></h2>
<p>By default, flex items try to fit onto a single line. The <code>flex-wrap</code> property, applied to the <strong>flex container</strong>, controls whether flex items should wrap onto multiple lines.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>nowrap</code> (default): All flex items will try to stay on one line, potentially causing overflow if they are too wide.</li>
<li><code>wrap</code>: Flex items will wrap onto multiple lines if there isn't enough space on the current line.</li>
<li><code>wrap-reverse</code>: Flex items will wrap onto multiple lines, but in reverse order (new lines appear above the previous ones).</li>
</ul>
<h3><code>flex-wrap: nowrap;</code> (Default) Example</h3>
<p>If items have fixed widths and the container is too small, <code>nowrap</code> will cause overflow.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"item small-item"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;5&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#e6e6fa</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">250</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Container is narrow */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> purple</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  margin-top</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>

<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.small-item</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">80</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Each item is wide */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  flex-shrink</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Prevent items from shrinking, highlighting overflow */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Here, the items will overflow the container because the container's width (250px) is less than the total width of the items (5 * 80px = 400px).</p>
<h3><code>flex-wrap: wrap;</code> Example</h3>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  flex-wrap</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">wrap</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Items will wrap to the next line */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#e6e6fa</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">250</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The items will now arrange themselves on multiple lines. The first three items will fit on the first line (3 * 80px = 240px &lt; 250px), and the remaining two items will appear on the next line.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#e6e6fa</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">250</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> purple</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  margin-top</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.small-item</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">80</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The wrapping behavior is similar to <code>wrap</code>, but the lines are stacked in reverse order. So, if items "1, 2, 3" are on the first visual line and "4, 5" on the second, with <code>wrap-reverse</code>, the "4, 5" line would appear <em>above</em> the "1, 2, 3" line.</p>
<h2>The <code>flex-flow</code> Shorthand</h2>
<p>The <code>flex-flow</code> property is a shorthand for <code>flex-direction</code> and <code>flex-wrap</code>. It's applied to the <strong>flex container</strong>.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* Equivalent to: */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* flex-direction: row; */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* flex-wrap: wrap; */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  flex-flow</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">row</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> wrap</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This shorthand is useful for concisely setting both properties at once.</p>
<h2>Justifying Content with <code>justify-content</code></h2>
<p>The <code>justify-content</code> property, applied to the <strong>flex container</strong>, aligns flex items along the <strong>main axis</strong>. It controls how free space is distributed between and around items.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>flex-start</code> (default): Items are packed toward the start of the main axis.</li>
<li><code>flex-end</code>: Items are packed toward the end of the main axis.</li>
<li><code>center</code>: Items are centered along the main axis.</li>
<li><code>space-between</code>: Items are evenly distributed; the first item is at the start, the last item is at the end.</li>
<li><code>space-around</code>: Items are evenly distributed with equal space around them. Note that the space between items is twice the space at the ends.</li>
<li><code>space-evenly</code>: Items are distributed so that the space between any two items, and the space to the edges, is equal.</li>
</ul>
<h3><code>justify-content: flex-start;</code> (Default) Example</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"container justify-start-example"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"item"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;A&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
