<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.justify-start-example</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  justify-content</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex-start</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Items start at the beginning of the main axis */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> green</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">400</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  justify-content</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">space-evenly</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* All gaps (between items and at ends) are equal */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> green</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">400</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The space before "A", between "A" and "B", between "B" and "C", and after "C" will all be exactly equal.</p>
<h2>Aligning Items with <code>align-items</code></h2>
<p>The <code>align-items</code> property, applied to the <strong>flex container</strong>, aligns flex items along the <strong>cross axis</strong>. This is particularly useful when items have different heights or when you want to center items vertically within their container.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>stretch</code> (default): Flex items are stretched to fill the container along the cross axis, respecting <code>min-height</code>/<code>max-height</code>.</li>
<li><code>flex-start</code>: Items are packed toward the start of the cross axis.</li>
<li><code>flex-end</code>: Items are packed toward the end of the cross axis.</li>
<li><code>center</code>: Items are centered along the cross axis.</li>
<li><code>baseline</code>: Items are aligned such that their baselines align.</li>
</ul>
<p>For these examples, assume <code>flex-direction: row;</code> (so main axis is horizontal, cross axis is vertical).</p>
<h3><code>align-items: stretch;</code> (Default) Example</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"container align-stretch-example"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"item short-item"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Short&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"item tall-item"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Tall content that makes this item higher&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"item"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Normal&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.align-stretch-example</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  align-items</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">stretch</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Items stretch to fill the container's height */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> orange</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">150</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Container has a defined height */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.short-item</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">50</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* This height will be overridden by stretch */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.tall-item</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* This height will also be overridden by stretch */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>All flex items will expand vertically to fill the entire height of the <code>align-stretch-example</code> container. Their individual <code>height</code> properties will be ignored unless a <code>min-height</code> is set.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"item tall-item"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Tall content&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> orange</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">150</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.short-item</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">50</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Individual height will be respected */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.tall-item</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>All items will align to the top of the flex container. Their individual heights will be maintained.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> orange</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">150</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.large-text</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">em</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Make text larger */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  padding-top</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Push the text down slightly */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The text content of each item will align along a common baseline. Notice how the items themselves might not be perfectly centered, but their inner text content's bottom line is aligned.</p>
<h2>Aligning Flex Lines with <code>align-content</code></h2>
<p>The <code>align-content</code> property, applied to the <strong>flex container</strong>, aligns entire lines of flex items along the <strong>cross axis</strong> when there is extra space in the container and <code>flex-wrap</code> is set to <code>wrap</code> or <code>wrap-reverse</code>. It controls how space is distributed between the lines. It has no effect when there is only one line of flex items.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>stretch</code> (default): Lines stretch to take up the remaining space.</li>
<li><code>flex-start</code>: Lines are packed toward the start of the cross axis.</li>
<li><code>flex-end</code>: Lines are packed toward the end of the cross axis.</li>
<li><code>center</code>: Lines are centered along the cross axis.</li>
<li><code>space-between</code>: Lines are evenly distributed; the first line is at the start, the last line at the end.</li>
<li><code>space-around</code>: Lines are evenly distributed with equal space around them.</li>
<li><code>space-evenly</code>: Lines are distributed so that the space between any two lines, and the space to the edges, is equal.</li>
</ul>
<p>These properties are similar to <code>justify-content</code> but apply to the arrangement of multiple lines.</p>
<h3><code>align-content: stretch;</code> (Default) Example</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"container align-content-stretch-example"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  align-content</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">stretch</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Lines stretch to fill vertical space */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> blue</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">250</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">300</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Plenty of vertical space for multiple lines */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.small-item</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">80</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">50</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Each item has a base height */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Since the <code>small-item</code> has a fixed height, the lines themselves will not stretch in height (they'll maintain the <code>small-item</code> height). However, if the items did <em>not</em> have a <code>height</code> set, they would stretch. The <em>space between the lines</em> is what <code>align-content: stretch</code> would typically manage by expanding the height of each line to fill the container. With fixed item heights, this example primarily shows how the lines are positioned at the start, but without visible stretching of the lines themselves if their contents are fixed. Let's make the items not have a fixed height to better see <code>stretch</code>.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.align-content-stretch-example</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> .item</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">80</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* Removed fixed height */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Now, the items will stretch vertically to fill the available space, effectively distributing the container's height among the lines.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  flex-wrap</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">wrap</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  align-content</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">space-between</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* First line at top, last line at bottom, space in between */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> blue</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">250</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">300</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.small-item</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">80</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">50</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The first line will be at the very top of the container, the last line at the very bottom, and any lines in between will have equal vertical space distributed among them.</p>
<h2>Flex Item Properties: <code>order</code>, <code>flex-grow</code>, <code>flex-shrink</code>, <code>flex-basis</code>, <code>flex</code></h2>
<p>While the container properties control the overall layout, flex items themselves have properties to influence their individual behavior.</p>
<h3><code>order</code> Property</h3>
<p>The <code>order</code> property, applied to <strong>flex items</strong>, controls the order in which items appear in the flex container. By default, all flex items have an <code>order</code> of <code>0</code>. Items with lower <code>order</code> values appear before items with higher values. If multiple items have the same <code>order</code>, their source order (HTML order) is maintained.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> red</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-2</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">order</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">; } </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Will appear first */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-3</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">order</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">; } </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Will appear second */</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The visual order of items will be "2", "3", "1".</p>
<h3><code>flex-grow</code> Property</h3>
<p>The <code>flex-grow</code> property, applied to <strong>flex items</strong>, specifies how much a flex item will grow relative to the rest of the flex items in the flex container when there is available free space. It accepts a unitless value that serves as a proportion. Default is <code>0</code> (item does not grow).</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"container grow-example"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"item item-A"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;A&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"item item-B"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;B&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"item item-C"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;C&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.grow-example</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> green</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">500</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Container with extra space */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-A</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex-grow</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">; } </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Grows to take 1 part of available space */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-B</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex-grow</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">; } </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Grows to take 2 parts of available space */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-C</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex-grow</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">; } </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Grows to take 1 part of available space */</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>If the initial width of A, B, C combined is less than 500px, the remaining space will be divided into 4 parts (1+2+1). Item A and C will each take 1 part of that space, and Item B will take 2 parts. So, B will be twice as wide as A or C after growth.</p>
<h3><code>flex-shrink</code> Property</h3>
<p>The <code>flex-shrink</code> property, applied to <strong>flex items</strong>, specifies how much a flex item will shrink relative to the rest of the flex items in the flex container when there is not enough free space (i.e., when items would overflow). It accepts a unitless value. Default is <code>1</code> (item shrinks proportionally). <code>0</code> means the item will not shrink.</p>

<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-X</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-Y</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-Z</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Each item initially wants 100px */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-X</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex-shrink</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">; } </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Will not shrink */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-Y</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex-shrink</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">; } </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Will shrink by 1 part */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-Z</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex-shrink</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">; } </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Will shrink by 2 parts */</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The total desired width is 300px (100+100+100), but the container is only 200px wide, so there's 100px of negative space to absorb. Item X will keep its 100px width. The remaining 100px of negative space will be absorbed by Y and Z. Since Y has <code>flex-shrink: 1</code> and Z has <code>flex-shrink: 2</code>, the 100px will be distributed in a 1:2 ratio. Y will shrink by approximately 33.3px, and Z will shrink by approximately 66.7px.</p>
<h3><code>flex-basis</code> Property</h3>
<p>The <code>flex-basis</code> property, applied to <strong>flex items</strong>, defines the default size of an element before the remaining space is distributed. It can be a length value (e.g., <code>100px</code>, <code>50%</code>) or <code>auto</code> (default). When <code>flex-basis</code> is <code>auto</code>, the item's content size or explicit <code>width</code>/<code>height</code> (depending on <code>flex-direction</code>) is used.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"container basis-example"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"item item-P"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;P&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"item item-Q"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Q&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"item item-R"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;R&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.basis-example</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> purple</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">400</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-P</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex-basis</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; } </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Desired width is 100px */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-Q</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex-basis</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">150</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; } </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Desired width is 150px */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-R</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex-basis</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">50</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; }  </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Desired width is 50px */</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The items will first try to take their <code>flex-basis</code> widths. Then, if there's remaining space or overflow, <code>flex-grow</code> and <code>flex-shrink</code> will distribute or absorb that space. In this case, total basis is 300px, container is 400px, so 100px free space. If <code>flex-grow</code> is 0 for all, the items will be 100px, 150px, 50px respectively, and 100px free space will remain. If <code>flex-grow</code> is 1 for all, the 100px free space will be equally distributed among them.</p>
<h3><code>flex</code> Shorthand</h3>
<p>The <code>flex</code> property is a shorthand for <code>flex-grow</code>, <code>flex-shrink</code>, and <code>flex-basis</code>. It's applied to <strong>flex items</strong>.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* Equivalent to: */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* flex-grow: 1; */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* flex-shrink: 1; */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* flex-basis: 0%; */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#D73A49">%</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-fixed</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* Equivalent to: */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* flex-grow: 0; */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* flex-shrink: 0; */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* flex-basis: 100px; */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-grow-only</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* Equivalent to: */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* flex-grow: 1; */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* flex-shrink: 0; */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* flex-basis: auto; */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> auto</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Common values for <code>flex</code>:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>flex: auto;</code> is equivalent to <code>flex: 1 1 auto;</code> (item can grow and shrink from its content size).</li>
<li><code>flex: none;</code> is equivalent to <code>flex: 0 0 auto;</code> (item does not grow or shrink, maintains its content size).</li>
<li><code>flex: 1;</code> is equivalent to <code>flex: 1 1 0%;</code> (item can grow and shrink, and its base size is 0, so it will fill available space). This is very common for making items equally share space.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Practical Examples and Demonstrations</h2>
<p>Let's build a few common layout patterns using Flexbox.</p>
<h3>Centering an Element</h3>
<p>A classic challenge is to center an element both horizontally and vertically. Flexbox makes this straightforward.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"center-container"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"centered-box"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;I'm Centered!&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.center-container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  justify-content</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">center</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Horizontally centers content */</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.centered-box</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#28a745</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">white</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 40</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1.5</span><span style="color:#D73A49">em</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border-radius</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">8</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The <code>centered-box</code> will appear perfectly in the middle of its <code>center-container</code>.</p>
<h3>Responsive Card Layout</h3>
<p>Create a grid-like layout of cards that wraps onto multiple lines as the screen size changes.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"card-layout"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"card"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Card Title 1&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Short description for card 1.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  box-shadow</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 4</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 8</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> rgba</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0.1</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">white</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  justify-content</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">space-between</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Push title to top, paragraph to bottom */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.card</span><span style="color:#22863A"> h3</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  margin-top</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#007bff</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.card</span><span style="color:#22863A"> p</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0.9</span><span style="color:#D73A49">em</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#6c757d</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The <code>card-layout</code> container uses <code>flex-wrap: wrap</code> to allow the cards to move to new lines as the viewport changes. <code>justify-content: space-around</code> distributes them evenly. Each <code>card</code> uses <code>flex: 1 1 250px</code> which tells it to try to be 250px wide, but grow and shrink as needed to fit the available space. The <code>gap</code> property provides spacing between items without needing <code>margin</code> on individual items, which can simplify layout calculations. Notice that each <code>.card</code> itself is also a flex container, using <code>flex-direction: column</code> and <code>justify-content: space-between</code> to structure its internal content.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#3498db</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Here, the <code>site-header</code> is the flex container. <code>justify-content: space-between</code> neatly places the <code>logo</code> at the start and <code>main-navigation</code> at the end. <code>align-items: center</code> ensures both are vertically aligned in the middle of the header. The <code>main-navigation</code> itself is also a flex container to manage its links.</p>
<h2>Exercises</h2>
<h3>Exercise 1: Three-Column Layout</h3>
<p>Create a flex container that holds three equal-width columns. Each column should contain some text.</p>
<ul>
<li>The columns should always be equal width, regardless of content or screen size (within reason).</li>
<li>The columns should have 20px of space between them.</li>
