<h2>Real-World Application</h2>
<p>Flexbox is fundamental in modern web development for arranging content. A typical application involves building a product listing page on an e-commerce website. Each product card (with image, title, price, add-to-cart button) needs to be consistently sized and aligned, regardless of content length, and should automatically reflow into fewer or more columns based on screen width.</p>
<p>Consider a company dashboard application. Flexbox can be used to arrange widgets (e.g., sales charts, user statistics, recent activities feed) into a customizable layout. Users might drag and drop widgets, or the dashboard might automatically adjust based on the device. Each widget, as a flex item, can <code>flex-grow</code> to fill available space or maintain a <code>flex-basis</code> for consistent sizing. The internal content of each widget would also often use Flexbox to align its title, data, and action buttons.</p>
<p>Another example is a simple contact form. While individual input fields might be block elements, aligning labels with input fields, or arranging a group of radio buttons or checkboxes horizontally, benefits greatly from Flexbox. A group of submission buttons (e.g., "Submit" and "Cancel") often uses Flexbox to position them side-by-side with appropriate spacing.</p>
  
</div>

<div id="chapter-2.5">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">CSS Layout Techniques: Grid</h1><p>CSS Grid is a two-dimensional layout system for the web. It allows developers to create complex, responsive layouts with rows and columns, providing a powerful way to organize content on a webpage. While Flexbox, as covered in the previous lesson, is ideal for one-dimensional layouts (either rows <em>or</em> columns), Grid excels at arranging items simultaneously in both dimensions.</p>
<h2>Understanding Grid Containers and Grid Items</h2>
<p>The foundation of CSS Grid lies in two core concepts: the <strong>grid container</strong> and <strong>grid items</strong>.</p>
<p>A <strong>grid container</strong> is the HTML element on which <code>display: grid;</code> or <code>display: inline-grid;</code> is applied. This declaration transforms the element into a grid, making its direct children <strong>grid items</strong>. All the direct children of the grid container automatically become grid items, which can then be positioned and sized within the grid.</p>
<h3>Declaring a Grid Container</h3>
<p>To start using Grid, apply the <code>display: grid;</code> property to a parent element.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"grid-container"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"grid-item"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Item 1&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"grid-item"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Item 2&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"grid-item"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Item 3&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.grid-container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">grid</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Makes this div a grid container */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This simple declaration creates a grid, but without defining rows and columns, the items will just stack in a single column by default, similar to block-level elements.</p>
<h2>Defining Grid Tracks: Rows and Columns</h2>
<p>Grid tracks are the spaces between the grid lines, forming the rows and columns. You define these tracks using <code>grid-template-columns</code> and <code>grid-template-rows</code>.</p>
<h3><code>grid-template-columns</code></h3>
<p>This property defines the number and width of columns in the grid. You specify values for each column, separated by spaces.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Fixed Units (px, em, rem):</strong> Define columns with exact dimensions.
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.grid-container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">grid</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-template-columns</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 200</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Three columns: 100px, 200px, 100px */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
<li><strong>Percentage Units (%):</strong> Define columns as a percentage of the container's width.
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.grid-container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">grid</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-template-columns</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">25</span><span style="color:#D73A49">%</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 50</span><span style="color:#D73A49">%</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 25</span><span style="color:#D73A49">%</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Three columns: 25%, 50%, 25% of container width */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
<li><strong>Flexible Units (<code>fr</code>):</strong> The <code>fr</code> unit (fractional unit) represents a fraction of the available space in the grid container. This is particularly powerful for responsive designs.
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.grid-container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">grid</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-template-columns</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Three equal-width columns, each taking 1/3 of available space */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
If you have <code>1fr 2fr 1fr</code>, the second column will be twice as wide as the first and third, with all three sharing the available space proportionally.
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.grid-container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">grid</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-template-columns</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* First and third columns take 1 share, second takes 2 shares */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
<li><strong><code>repeat()</code> Function:</strong> A shorthand for repeating track definitions.
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.grid-container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">grid</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-template-columns</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">repeat</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Equivalent to 1fr 1fr 1fr */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
You can mix <code>repeat()</code> with other units:
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.grid-container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">grid</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-template-columns</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> repeat</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#005CC5">50</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* 100px, then two equal flexible columns, then 50px */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
<li><strong><code>minmax()</code> Function:</strong> Defines a size range for a track. This is useful for making tracks responsive, ensuring they don't become too small or too large.
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.grid-container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">grid</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-template-columns</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">minmax</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#005CC5">minmax</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">150</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* First column is at least 100px, but takes 1fr. Second is at least 150px, but takes 2fr. */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
This means the column will be at least <code>min-size</code> and at most <code>max-size</code>. If there's enough space, it will grow up to <code>max-size</code>. If not, it will shrink down to <code>min-size</code>.</li>
</ul>
<h3><code>grid-template-rows</code></h3>
<p>This property defines the number and height of rows in the grid, behaving similarly to <code>grid-template-columns</code>.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.grid-container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">grid</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-template-columns</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">repeat</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-template-rows</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> auto</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 50</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Three rows: 100px height, auto height (adjusts to content), 50px height */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The <code>auto</code> keyword allows the browser to determine the height based on the content of the grid items in that row.</p>
<h2>Placing Grid Items</h2>
<p>Once the grid structure (rows and columns) is defined, you can place individual grid items within that structure. Grid placement is based on <strong>grid lines</strong>, which are the dividers between grid tracks. Grid lines are numbered starting from 1.</p>
<h3><code>grid-column</code> and <code>grid-row</code></h3>
<p>These shorthand properties define which grid lines an item starts and ends at.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>grid-column-start</code>: Specifies the starting column line.</li>
<li><code>grid-column-end</code>: Specifies the ending column line.</li>
<li><code>grid-row-start</code>: Specifies the starting row line.</li>
<li><code>grid-row-end</code>: Specifies the ending row line.</li>
</ul>
<p>The shorthand combines these:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>grid-column: &lt;start-line&gt; / &lt;end-line&gt;;</code></li>
<li><code>grid-row: &lt;start-line&gt; / &lt;end-line&gt;;</code></li>
</ul>
<p>You can also use <code>span</code> to specify how many tracks an item should span.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"grid-container"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"grid-item item-b"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Item B&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"grid-item item-c"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Item C&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"grid-item item-d"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Item D&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.grid-container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">grid</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  gap</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Space between grid items */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-a</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-row</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E"> / </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">;    </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Starts at row line 1, ends at row line 2 (spans one row) */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-row</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E"> / </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
