<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-column</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E"> / </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Spans one column */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-row</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E"> / </span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#24292E">;    </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Spans one row */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-d</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-column</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E"> / </span><span style="color:#005CC5">5</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Starts at column line 2, ends at column line 5 (spans three columns) */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-row</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E"> / </span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This arrangement creates a layout where Item A and Item B share the first row, each taking up half the width. Item C is in the first column of the second row, and Item D spans the remaining three columns of the second row.</p>
<h3><code>grid-area</code></h3>
<p>The <code>grid-area</code> property is a shorthand for <code>grid-row-start</code>, <code>grid-column-start</code>, <code>grid-row-end</code>, and <code>grid-column-end</code>.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-a</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-area</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E"> / </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E"> / </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E"> / </span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* row-start / column-start / row-end / column-end */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This is equivalent to the previous example for <code>item-a</code>.</p>
<h3>Naming Grid Lines and Areas</h3>
<p>For more complex layouts, using line numbers can become cumbersome. CSS Grid allows naming lines and defining grid areas.</p>
<h4>Naming Grid Lines</h4>
<p>You can name grid lines directly within <code>grid-template-columns</code> and <code>grid-template-rows</code> using square brackets <code>[]</code>.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.grid-container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">grid</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-template-columns</span><span style="color:#24292E">: [col-start] </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [col-middle] </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [col-end];</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-template-rows</span><span style="color:#24292E">: [row-start] </span><span style="color:#005CC5">auto</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [row-end];</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-a</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-column</span><span style="color:#24292E">: col-start / col-middle; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Refers to named lines */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-row</span><span style="color:#24292E">: row-start / row-end;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h4>Naming Grid Areas with <code>grid-template-areas</code></h4>
<p>This property defines a grid layout by referencing named grid areas. Each string represents a row, and the words in the string represent the columns within that row. A <code>.</code> (dot) signifies an empty cell.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.grid-container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">grid</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-template-columns</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-template-rows</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">auto</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> auto</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* header, main content, footer */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-template-areas</span><span style="color:#24292E">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">    "header header header"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">    "sidebar main   main"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">    "footer footer footer"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.header</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-area</span><span style="color:#24292E">: header;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.sidebar</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-area</span><span style="color:#24292E">: sidebar;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.main-content</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-area</span><span style="color:#24292E">: main;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.footer</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-area</span><span style="color:#24292E">: footer;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This creates a common web page layout where the header and footer span all columns, and the main content area is next to a sidebar. This approach makes the layout visually intuitive within the CSS.</p>
<h2>Gaps Between Grid Items</h2>
<p><code>gap</code> (formerly <code>grid-gap</code>) creates space between grid tracks.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>row-gap</code>: Sets the size of the gap between rows.</li>
<li><code>column-gap</code>: Sets the size of the gap between columns.</li>
<li><code>gap</code>: Shorthand for both, e.e., <code>gap: 10px;</code> (same gap for rows and columns) or <code>gap: 10px 20px;</code> (10px row gap, 20px column gap).</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.grid-container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">grid</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-template-columns</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">repeat</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-template-rows</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">repeat</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  gap</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* 20px gap between all rows and columns */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h2>Alignment within Grid</h2>
<p>Grid provides powerful alignment properties for both the grid container and individual grid items.</p>
<h3>Aligning Grid Items within the Container (on the Container)</h3>
<p>These properties are applied to the <strong>grid container</strong> to align grid items collectively within their grid tracks.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>justify-content</code>: Aligns the grid <em>tracks</em> along the inline (row) axis when the total width of tracks is less than the container width.
<ul>
<li><code>start</code>: Items are packed to the start of the container.</li>
<li><code>end</code>: Items are packed to the end of the container.</li>
<li><code>center</code>: Items are centered in the container.</li>
<li><code>space-around</code>: Items are evenly distributed with space around them.</li>
<li><code>space-between</code>: Items are evenly distributed with space between them.</li>
<li><code>space-evenly</code>: Items are evenly distributed with equal space around them.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><code>align-content</code>: Aligns the grid <em>tracks</em> along the block (column) axis when the total height of tracks is less than the container height.
<ul>
<li><code>start</code>, <code>end</code>, <code>center</code>, <code>space-around</code>, <code>space-between</code>, <code>space-evenly</code>: Behave similarly to <code>justify-content</code> but vertically.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.grid-container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">grid</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-template-columns</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">repeat</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Total width of tracks is 200px */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  grid-template-rows</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">repeat</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">80</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">);     </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Total height of tracks is 160px */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">300</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Container is wider than tracks */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">250</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Container is taller than tracks */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> #ccc</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  justify-content</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">center</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Centers columns horizontally */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  align-content</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">center</span><span style="color:#24292E">;   </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Centers rows vertically */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Aligning Individual Grid Items (on the Item)</h3>
<p>These properties are applied to <strong>individual grid items</strong> to align their content within their <em>own</em> grid cell.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>justify-self</code>: Aligns an item along the inline (row) axis within its grid cell.
<ul>
<li><code>start</code>: Aligns to the start of the cell.</li>
<li><code>end</code>: Aligns to the end of the cell.</li>
<li><code>center</code>: Centers within the cell.</li>
<li><code>stretch</code>: (Default) Stretches to fill the cell.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><code>align-self</code>: Aligns an item along the block (column) axis within its grid cell.
<ul>
<li><code>start</code>, <code>end</code>, <code>center</code>, <code>stretch</code>: Behave similarly to <code>justify-self</code> but vertically.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.grid-item</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">lightblue</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  text-align</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">center</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.item-specific</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  justify-self</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">end</span><span style="color:#24292E">;   </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Aligns this item to the end of its column cell */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  align-self</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">center</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Centers this item vertically within its row cell */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Shorthand <code>place-items</code> and <code>place-content</code></h3>
<ul>
<li><code>place-items</code>: Shorthand for <code>align-items</code> and <code>justify-items</code> (not covered here as it is about <em>items</em> within cells, not <em>content</em> within items, similar to Flexbox).</li>
<li><code>place-content</code>: Shorthand for <code>align-content</code> and <code>justify-content</code>.
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.grid-container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  place-content</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">center</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> start</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* align-content: center; justify-content: start; */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Practical Examples and Demonstrations</h2>
<h3>Example 1: Basic Blog Layout</h3>
<p>Let's create a simple blog layout with a header, main content, sidebar, and footer.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;!</span><span style="color:#22863A">DOCTYPE</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> lang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> charset</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"UTF-8"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"viewport"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> content</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Grid Blog Layout&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">style</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        body</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-family</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">Arial</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">sans-serif</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">grid</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Make body a grid container */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            min-height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">vh</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Ensure body takes full viewport height */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            grid-template-columns</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 3</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Sidebar, Main, Sidebar */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            grid-template-rows</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">auto</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> auto</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Header, Main/Sidebar, Footer */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            grid-template-areas</span><span style="color:#24292E">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">                "header header header"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">                "nav    main   aside"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">                "footer footer footer"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            gap</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            box-sizing</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">border-box</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Include padding in element's total width and height */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        header</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            grid-area</span><span style="color:#24292E">: header;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#333</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">white</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            text-align</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">center</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        nav</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            grid-area</span><span style="color:#24292E">: nav;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#f0f0f0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">15</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        main</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            grid-area</span><span style="color:#24292E">: main;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#e0e0e0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">15</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        aside</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            grid-area</span><span style="color:#24292E">: aside;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#f0f0f0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">15</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        footer</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            grid-area</span><span style="color:#24292E">: footer;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#333</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">white</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            text-align</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">center</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        /* Basic styling for content within areas */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin-top</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        ul</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            list-style</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">none</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        li</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin-bottom</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">5</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        a</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            text-decoration</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">none</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#333</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">style</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">header</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;My Awesome Blog&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">header</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">nav</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Navigation&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"#"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Home&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"#"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;About&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"#"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Contact&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"#"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Archives&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">nav</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">main</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Main Content Area&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;This is the primary content of the page. It will expand to fill the available space. Using CSS Grid, we can easily control the layout of entire pages or smaller components.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;This layout is defined using `grid-template-areas` which provides a very readable way to describe the page structure directly in the CSS.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">main</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">aside</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Sidebar&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;This is a sidebar for additional information or advertisements.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Popular Posts&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Post 1&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Post 2&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Post 3&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">aside</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">footer</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5">&amp;copy;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> 2023 My Blog&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">footer</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this example, the <code>body</code> element itself becomes the grid container. <code>grid-template-areas</code> makes the layout very clear to read. The <code>1fr 3fr 1fr</code> column definition ensures the main content area is three times wider than the navigation and aside. The <code>auto 1fr auto</code> row definition means the header and footer take only as much height as their content needs, while the middle row (containing nav, main, and aside) takes up all remaining available vertical space.</p>
<h3>Example 2: Photo Gallery</h3>
<p>Create a responsive photo gallery using <code>repeat()</code> and <code>minmax()</code>.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;!</span><span style="color:#22863A">DOCTYPE</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> lang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> charset</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"UTF-8"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"viewport"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> content</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Grid Photo Gallery&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">style</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        body</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            font-family</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">Arial</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">sans-serif</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#f4f4f4</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .gallery-container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">grid</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            /* Responsive columns:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">               At least 250px wide, but take up a fraction of available space.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">               auto-fit tries to fit as many columns as possible without overflowing.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">               auto-fill will create empty tracks if items don't fill the space.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            grid-template-columns</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">repeat</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">auto-fit</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">minmax</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">250</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#24292E">));</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            gap</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">15</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Space between gallery items */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            max-width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1200</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> auto</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Center the gallery */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .gallery-item</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">white</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> #ddd</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            border-radius</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">8</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            overflow</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">hidden</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Ensures image doesn't overflow rounded corners */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            box-shadow</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 5</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> rgba</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0.1</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Use flexbox for content inside item for centering */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            flex-direction</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">column</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            justify-content</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">center</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            align-items</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">center</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .gallery-item</span><span style="color:#22863A"> img</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            max-width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">%</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">auto</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">block</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Remove extra space below image */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            border-radius</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">4</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin-bottom</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .gallery-item</span><span style="color:#22863A"> h3</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Ocean Sunset 6&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Here, <code>grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));</code> is key for responsiveness.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>auto-fit</code>: Tells the grid to fit as many columns as possible without overflowing the container. If there's extra space, columns will grow to consume it. If there are fewer items than the available space for <code>minmax(250px, 1fr)</code> columns, <code>auto-fit</code> will expand the items to take up the empty space.</li>
<li><code>minmax(250px, 1fr)</code>: Each column should be at least 250 pixels wide, but can grow up to <code>1fr</code> (one fraction of the available space).</li>
</ul>
<p>This ensures that on larger screens, you get multiple columns of approximately 250px width that grow to fill the space. On smaller screens, columns will wrap, potentially reducing to a single column if the screen width is less than 250px per column plus gaps.</p>

<p><strong>Task:</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>Make <code>.dashboard-container</code> a grid container.</li>
<li>Define two columns: a fixed 200px for the <code>.sidebar</code> and the remaining space (<code>1fr</code>) for the <code>.main-panel</code>.</li>
<li>Inside <code>.main-panel</code>, make it a nested grid container.</li>
<li>For <code>.main-panel</code>, define three rows: <code>auto</code> for <code>.main-header</code>, <code>1fr</code> for <code>.card-grid</code>, and <code>auto</code> for <code>.main-footer</code>.</li>
<li>Inside <code>.card-grid</code>, make it a nested grid container.</li>
<li>For <code>.card-grid</code>, create a 2x2 grid of equal-sized cards using <code>repeat()</code> and <code>1fr</code>.</li>
<li>Add a <code>gap</code> of 15px to both <code>.dashboard-container</code> and <code>.card-grid</code>.</li>
<li>Add some basic background colors to the elements for visual distinction.</li>
</ol>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Short description of the second benefit goes here.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p><strong>Task:</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>Make <code>.landing-section</code> a grid container.</li>
<li>Use <code>grid-template-areas</code> to define the layout:
<ul>
<li>The <code>hero-image</code> should span across two columns in the first row.</li>
<li><code>box-a</code> and <code>box-b</code> should each occupy one column in the second row.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Define two columns using <code>1fr 1fr</code>.</li>
<li>Define two rows using <code>auto</code> for both.</li>
<li>Assign the <code>grid-area</code> property to each item (<code>.hero-image</code>, <code>.box-a</code>, <code>.box-b</code>) corresponding to the areas defined.</li>
<li>Add a <code>gap</code> of 20px.</li>
<li>Style the boxes with some padding and background colors.</li>
</ol>
  
</div>

<div id="chapter-2.6">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Responsive Design with Media Queries</h1><p>Websites need to adapt their layout and appearance to various screen sizes and devices. Responsive design ensures that a website provides an optimal viewing and interaction experience across a wide range of devices, from desktop monitors to mobile phones. Media queries are a core component of responsive design, allowing CSS styles to be applied conditionally based on device characteristics like screen width, height, resolution, and orientation.</p>
<h2>Understanding Media Queries</h2>
<p>Media queries are CSS rules that apply a set of styles only when certain conditions are met. These conditions typically relate to the capabilities of the device displaying the content. They extend the <code>@media</code> rule from CSS2.1, enabling more fine-grained control over styling.</p>
<h3>Syntax of Media Queries</h3>
<p>A basic media query consists of an <code>@media</code> rule, a media type (optional), and one or more media features.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">@media</span><span style="color:#24292E"> media-type </span><span style="color:#D73A49">and</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (media-feature: value) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  /* CSS rules applied when conditions are met */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<ul>
<li><strong><code>@media</code></strong>: The keyword that initiates a media query.</li>
<li><strong><code>media-type</code></strong>: Specifies the type of device the style sheet is for. Common types include:
<ul>
<li><code>all</code>: For all media types. This is the default if no type is specified.</li>
<li><code>screen</code>: For color computer screens.</li>
<li><code>print</code>: For paginated material and documents viewed in print preview mode.</li>
<li><code>speech</code>: For speech synthesizers.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong><code>and</code></strong>: A logical operator used to combine multiple media features. You can also use <code>not</code> (negates the entire media query) and <code>,</code> (OR operator, applies if <em>any</em> of the conditions are true).</li>
<li><strong><code>media-feature</code></strong>: The property being tested. Examples include <code>width</code>, <code>height</code>, <code>min-width</code>, <code>max-width</code>, <code>orientation</code>, <code>resolution</code>, etc.</li>
<li><strong><code>value</code></strong>: The value associated with the media feature (e.g., <code>(min-width: 768px)</code>).</li>
</ul>
<h3>Common Media Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong><code>width</code> and <code>height</code></strong>: Refers to the width and height of the <em>viewport</em> (the visible area of the browser window), not the device itself.
<ul>
<li><code>min-width</code>: Applies styles when the viewport is <em>at least</em> this wide.</li>
<li><code>max-width</code>: Applies styles when the viewport is <em>at most</em> this wide.</li>
<li><code>min-height</code>, <code>max-height</code>: Similar to width, but for height.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong><code>orientation</code></strong>: Checks if the viewport is in <code>portrait</code> (height is greater than or equal to width) or <code>landscape</code> (width is greater than height) mode.</li>
<li><strong><code>resolution</code></strong>: Checks the pixel density of the screen, often expressed in <code>dpi</code> (dots per inch) or <code>dppx</code> (dots per pixel). Useful for serving high-resolution images to retina displays.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Example: Basic Media Query</h3>
<p>Consider a simple webpage with a main content area and a sidebar. On larger screens, the sidebar might appear next to the main content. On smaller screens, it might stack below.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;!</span><span style="color:#22863A">DOCTYPE</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> lang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> charset</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"UTF-8"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"viewport"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> content</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">link</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> rel</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"stylesheet"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"style.css"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
