<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"container"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">header</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;My Responsive Site&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">header</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">main</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;This is the main content area. On larger screens, this will be next to the sidebar. On smaller screens, it will stack above.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">main</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">aside</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Sidebar&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Item 1&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Item 2&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Item 3&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">aside</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">footer</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5">&amp;copy;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> 2023 Responsive Design&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">footer</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* style.css */</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Base styles (for all screen sizes, or "mobile-first") */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    max-width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">960</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    margin</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> auto</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Use flexbox for layout */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    flex-direction</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">column</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Default stack vertically for small screens */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    gap</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">header</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#22863A">main</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#22863A">aside</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#22863A">footer</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">15</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> #ccc</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#f9f9f9</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Styles for screens wider than 768px (tablets and desktops) */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">@media</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> screen</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> and</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">min-width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">768</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    .container</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        flex-direction</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">row</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Arrange horizontally */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        flex-wrap</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">wrap</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Allow items to wrap */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">    main</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Main content takes more space */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">    aside</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Sidebar takes less space */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">    header</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#22863A">footer</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        flex-basis</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">%</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Header and footer span full width */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Styles for screens wider than 1024px (large desktops) */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">@media</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> screen</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> and</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">min-width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1024</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">    main</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#e0f7fa</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Different background for very large screens */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">    aside</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#ffe0b2</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this example:</p>
<ul>
<li>Base styles define a columnar layout using <code>flex-direction: column</code>, which is suitable for smaller screens.</li>
<li>The first media query targets screens with a <code>min-width</code> of <code>768px</code>. For these screens, the <code>.container</code> switches to <code>flex-direction: row</code>, and <code>main</code> and <code>aside</code> are given flex growth factors to control their relative widths, making them appear side-by-side.</li>
<li>A second media query targets screens with a <code>min-width</code> of <code>1024px</code>, applying further styling changes to demonstrate nested or overlapping media query effects.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Breakpoints</h2>
<p>Breakpoints are the specific screen widths at which your layout changes. Choosing effective breakpoints is crucial for responsive design. Common breakpoints are often based on typical device sizes (e.g., mobile, tablet, desktop), but modern practice encourages creating breakpoints based on content needs rather than specific device dimensions.</p>
<h3>Mobile-First vs. Desktop-First</h3>
<p>Two main approaches exist for structuring responsive CSS with media queries:</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Mobile-First</strong>: This approach starts by designing and coding for the smallest screens first, then progressively adding styles for larger screens using <code>min-width</code> media queries. This ensures a solid base experience for mobile users and often leads to more optimized CSS because mobile devices generally require fewer styles.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Mobile styles (default) */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.element</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">14</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">@media</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">min-width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">600</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    /* Tablet styles */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    .element</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">16</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">15</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">@media</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">min-width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1024</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    /* Desktop styles */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    .element</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">18</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This is the generally recommended approach as it prioritizes the experience of the most constrained devices.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Desktop-First</strong>: This approach starts by designing for larger screens, then uses <code>max-width</code> media queries to override or adjust styles for smaller screens.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Desktop styles (default) */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.element</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">18</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">@media</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">max-width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1023</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    /* Tablet styles */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    .element</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">16</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">15</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">@media</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">max-width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">599</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    /* Mobile styles */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    .element</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">14</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>While functional, this approach can sometimes result in more complex stylesheets as you constantly override previous styles.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>The example above uses a mobile-first approach, starting with a column layout and then switching to a row layout for wider screens.</p>
<h2>The Viewport Meta Tag</h2>
<p>For media queries to work correctly on mobile devices, the <code>viewport</code> meta tag is essential in the <code>&lt;head&gt;</code> of your HTML document.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"viewport"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> content</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<ul>
<li><strong><code>width=device-width</code></strong>: Sets the width of the viewport to the actual width of the device in device-independent pixels. Without this, mobile browsers might render the page at a desktop width (e.g., 980px) and then scale it down, causing elements to appear tiny.</li>
<li><strong><code>initial-scale=1.0</code></strong>: Sets the initial zoom level when the page is first loaded. A value of <code>1.0</code> means no zoom.</li>
</ul>
<p>Failing to include this meta tag will result in mobile browsers ignoring your media queries or rendering your site incorrectly, as they will try to fit the "desktop" version onto the mobile screen.</p>
<h2>Advanced Media Query Features</h2>
<p>Media queries can do more than just check width and height.</p>
<h3>Orientation</h3>
<p>You can style elements based on whether the device is in portrait or landscape orientation.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Apply a specific background color when in landscape mode */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">@media</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> screen</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> and</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">orientation</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">landscape</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">    body</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">lightgreen</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Apply a different background color when in portrait mode */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">@media</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> screen</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> and</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">orientation</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">portrait</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">    body</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">lightblue</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This is useful for adjusting layouts that might look awkward when a device is rotated. For instance, a wide image gallery might benefit from a different layout in landscape mode compared to portrait mode.</p>
<h3>Resolution</h3>
<p>Target high-resolution screens for sharper images.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Styles for standard resolution displays */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.hero-image</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    background-image</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">url</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'images/hero-standard.jpg'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Styles for high-resolution (Retina) displays */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">@media</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> screen</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> and</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">min-resolution</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">192</span><span style="color:#D73A49">dpi</span><span style="color:#24292E">),</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">       screen</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> and</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">min-resolution</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">dppx</span><span style="color:#24292E">),</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">       screen</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> and</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (min-device-pixel-ratio: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">) { </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* -webkit-min-device-pixel-ratio for older Safari */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    .hero-image</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        background-image</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">url</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'images/hero-retina.jpg'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        background-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">cover</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Ensure image covers the area */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This allows you to serve higher quality images to devices that can display them, while providing smaller, faster-loading images to standard displays. This improves performance and user experience.</p>
<h3>Logical Operators</h3>
<p>Media queries can be combined using logical operators:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong><code>and</code></strong>: Combines multiple media features, all of which must be true.
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">@media</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> screen</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> and</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">min-width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">768</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">and</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">orientation</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">landscape</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    /* Styles for landscape tablets and desktops */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
<li><strong><code>not</code></strong>: Negates an entire media query.
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">@media</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> not</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> screen</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> and</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">color</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    /* Styles for devices that are NOT color screens */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
<li><strong><code>,</code> (comma)</strong>: Acts as an OR operator. Styles are applied if <em>any</em> of the queries separated by commas are true.
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">@media</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> screen</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> and</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">min-width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">768</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">), </span><span style="color:#005CC5">screen</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> and</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">orientation</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">landscape</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>

</ul>
<h2>Practical Examples and Demonstrations</h2>
<h3>Example 1: Navigation Bar Adjustment</h3>
<p>A common responsive challenge is handling navigation menus. On desktops, a horizontal menu is typical. On mobile, a "hamburger" menu that toggles a vertical list is preferred.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;!</span><span style="color:#22863A">DOCTYPE</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> lang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">nav</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"navbar"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"logo"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;MyBrand&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"menu-toggle"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;☰&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"#"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Home&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"#"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Contact&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">nav</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"content"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Welcome to our site!&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;This content will shift below the navigation as needed.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* nav-style.css */</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Base styles (Mobile-First) */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.navbar</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#333</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">white</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">15</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    justify-content</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">space-between</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    align-items</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">center</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.logo</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1.5</span><span style="color:#D73A49">em</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    font-weight</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">bold</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.menu-toggle</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    background</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">none</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">none</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">white</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    font-size</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1.8</span><span style="color:#D73A49">em</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    cursor</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">pointer</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">block</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Show hamburger by default on small screens */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.nav-links</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    list-style</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">none</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    margin</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">none</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Hide nav links by default for mobile */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    flex-direction</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">column</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">%</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    position</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">absolute</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    top</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">60</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Adjust based on navbar height */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    left</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#444</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.nav-links.active</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Class to toggle visibility with JavaScript */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.nav-links</span><span style="color:#22863A"> li</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    text-align</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">center</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    border-bottom</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> #555</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.nav-links</span><span style="color:#22863A"> li</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">:last-child</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    border-bottom</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">none</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.nav-links</span><span style="color:#22863A"> a</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">white</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    text-decoration</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">none</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">block</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Desktop styles */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">@media</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> screen</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> and</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">min-width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">768</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    .menu-toggle</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">none</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Hide hamburger on larger screens */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    .nav-links</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Show nav links horizontally */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        position</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">static</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Remove absolute positioning */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        flex-direction</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">row</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">auto</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">transparent</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    .nav-links</span><span style="color:#22863A"> li</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        border-bottom</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">none</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 15</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    .nav-links</span><span style="color:#22863A"> a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">:hover</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        text-decoration</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">underline</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p><em>Note: For the hamburger menu to actually toggle, you would need a small amount of JavaScript to add/remove the <code>.active</code> class on the <code>.nav-links</code> element when the <code>.menu-toggle</code> button is clicked. This is beyond the scope of this CSS lesson, but is a common practice.</em></p>
<h3>Example 2: Image Gallery Layout</h3>
<p>Imagine an image gallery that displays images in a single column on mobile, a two-column grid on tablets, and a three-column grid on desktops.</p>

<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Base styles (Mobile-First: single column) */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.gallery</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">grid</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    grid-template-columns</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Single column */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    gap</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">15</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    max-width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1200</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    margin</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> auto</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.gallery-item</span><span style="color:#22863A"> img</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    max-width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#D73A49">%</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    height</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">auto</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">block</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Remove extra space below image */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> #ddd</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    box-shadow</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 5</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> rgba</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0.1</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Tablet breakpoint: two columns */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">@media</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> screen</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> and</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">min-width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">600</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    .gallery</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        grid-template-columns</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Two columns */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Desktop breakpoint: three columns */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">@media</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> screen</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> and</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">min-width</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">992</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    .gallery</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">        grid-template-columns</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">fr</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Three columns */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This example demonstrates how <code>display: grid</code> combined with media queries can create flexible, responsive grid layouts. The <code>grid-template-columns</code> property is adjusted at different breakpoints to change the number of columns.</p>
<h2>Exercises and Practice Activities</h2>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Basic Layout Adaptation</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>Create an HTML page with a <code>&lt;div&gt;</code> for a header, a <code>&lt;div&gt;</code> for main content, and a <code>&lt;div&gt;</code> for a footer.</li>
<li>Apply base CSS to make the header background <code>lightcoral</code>, the main content background <code>lightblue</code>, and the footer background <code>lightgreen</code>.</li>
<li>Using a <em>mobile-first</em> approach, write a media query that applies when the screen width is at least <code>768px</code>. Within this media query, change the main content's background to <code>lightgoldenrodyellow</code> and increase its <code>padding</code>.</li>
<li>Add another media query for screens at least <code>1024px</code> wide. Here, change the header's text color to <code>navy</code> and add a <code>border-bottom</code>.</li>
<li>Test by resizing your browser window or using browser developer tools to simulate different screen sizes.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Responsive Card Component</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>Design a simple card component in HTML with an image, a title, and a short description.</li>
<li>Apply base CSS so that on small screens (mobile), the image is full width, and the text below it is centered.</li>
<li>Add a media query for screens at least <code>600px</code> wide (tablet). Within this query, use Flexbox to make the image appear to the left and the text content to the right, side-by-side. The card itself should have a <code>max-width</code> and be centered.</li>
<li>For screens at least <code>900px</code> wide (desktop), ensure the card components are arranged in a horizontal row if you have multiple cards, perhaps using a grid or flex container.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Orientation Toggle</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>Create an HTML page with a single <code>div</code> containing some text.</li>
<li>Apply CSS to make the <code>div</code> have a <code>width</code> of <code>80%</code> and a <code>margin: auto</code> to center it.</li>
<li>Using media queries, make the background color of the <code>div</code> <code>pink</code> when the device/viewport is in <code>portrait</code> orientation and <code>teal</code> when it's in <code>landscape</code> orientation.</li>
<li>Test this by resizing your browser window (making it taller vs. wider) or by using device emulation in developer tools.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h2>Real-World Application</h2>
<p>Responsive design using media queries is a fundamental requirement for almost all modern websites and web applications.</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>E-commerce Websites</strong>: An online store like Amazon or eBay must provide a seamless shopping experience whether a user is browsing on a desktop, tablet, or smartphone. Product listings, navigation, checkout processes, and image galleries all need to adapt their layout to fit the available screen space. On a phone, product images might stack vertically and payment buttons might take up the full width for easy tapping. On a desktop, images might be arranged in a grid, and more information or related products might be visible in sidebars. Media queries are used to switch between these layouts, adjust font sizes, hide less critical information on smaller screens, and ensure interactive elements remain usable.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>News and Content Portals</strong>: Websites like The New York Times or BBC News rely heavily on responsive design to deliver content effectively across devices. Headlines, article layouts, image sizes, and advertisement placements must all adjust. On a mobile device, a news article might present a single-column layout with larger text and images, minimizing scrolling and maximizing readability. On a desktop, the same article might feature multiple columns, related article sidebars, and embedded videos prominently. Media queries enable these distinct presentations, ensuring that content remains accessible and engaging regardless of the device.</p>
</li>
</ol>
  
</div>

</div>

<div id="chapter-3">

<div id="chapter-3.1">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Introduction to JavaScript Syntax and Data Types</h1><p>JavaScript is a powerful scripting language that adds interactivity and dynamic behavior to web pages. While HTML provides the structure and CSS handles the styling, JavaScript makes web content come alive, allowing for complex features and responsive user experiences. This lesson introduces the fundamental building blocks of JavaScript: its syntax and the different types of data it can handle.</p>
<h2>JavaScript Syntax Fundamentals</h2>
<p>JavaScript syntax refers to the set of rules that define how JavaScript programs are constructed. Just like human languages have grammar rules, programming languages have syntax rules that must be followed for the code to be correctly interpreted and executed.</p>
<h3>Statements and Semicolons</h3>
<p>A JavaScript program is a series of instructions called <strong>statements</strong>. Each statement performs a specific action. In JavaScript, statements typically end with a semicolon (<code>;</code>). While modern JavaScript engines often infer semicolons (a feature called Automatic Semicolon Insertion or ASI), explicitly including them is a best practice. It improves code readability, prevents potential bugs, and ensures consistent behavior across different environments.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// This is a single JavaScript statement</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Hello, World!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Another statement, assigning a value to a variable</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> message </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Welcome to JavaScript!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Two statements on separate lines, both ending with a semicolon</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> x </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 10</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> y </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 20</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>If a statement is not terminated by a semicolon, the JavaScript engine might try to insert one automatically. This can sometimes lead to unexpected behavior if the engine's interpretation differs from the developer's intent.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> a </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 5</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> b </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 10</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Without semicolons, ASI might interpret this correctly</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// but explicitly adding them prevents ambiguity.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(a </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#24292E"> b);</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Comments</h3>
<p>Comments are non-executable lines within the code that developers use to explain what the code does, why it was written in a particular way, or to temporarily disable parts of the code. Comments are ignored by the JavaScript engine and are solely for human readability and understanding.</p>
<p>JavaScript supports two types of comments:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Single-line comments</strong>: Start with two forward slashes (<code>//</code>). Everything from <code>//</code> to the end of the line is considered a comment.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// This is a single-line comment</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> age </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 30</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// This comment explains the 'age' variable</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Multi-line comments (or block comments)</strong>: Start with <code>/*</code> and end with <code>*/</code>. Anything between these delimiters is a comment, even if it spans multiple lines.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/*</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">This is a multi-line comment.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">It can span across several lines</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">to provide more detailed explanations.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">*/</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> firstName </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "John"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> lastName </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Doe"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/*</span></span>
