<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"> * This style is also common for multi-line comments,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"> * often seen in documentation generators.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"> */</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Comments are crucial for code maintainability, especially in larger projects where multiple developers might work on the same codebase or when revisiting code after a long time. They act as internal documentation.</p>
<h3>Case Sensitivity</h3>
<p>JavaScript is a <strong>case-sensitive</strong> language. This means that identifiers (like variable names, function names, or keywords) written in different cases are treated as distinct entities.</p>
<p>For example, <code>myVariable</code>, <code>myvariable</code>, and <code>MyVariable</code> are all considered different variables in JavaScript.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> userName </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Alice"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> username </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Bob"</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// This is a different variable from userName</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(userName); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: Alice</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(username); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: Bob</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Attempting to use a keyword with incorrect casing will result in an error</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// let If = true;</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // This would cause an error because 'if' is a keyword</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Consistency in casing (e.g., always using <code>camelCase</code> for variable names) is a vital aspect of writing readable and maintainable JavaScript code.</p>
<h2>JavaScript Data Types</h2>
<p>Data types classify the different kinds of values that can be stored and manipulated in a programming language. JavaScript is a dynamically typed language, meaning you don't explicitly declare the data type of a variable when you create it; the type is determined automatically at runtime based on the value assigned.</p>
<p>JavaScript has several fundamental (primitive) data types and one complex (non-primitive) data type.</p>
<h3>Primitive Data Types</h3>
<p>Primitive data types represent single values.</p>
<h4>Number</h4>
<p>The <code>Number</code> type represents both integer and floating-point numbers. There is no distinction between integers and floats in JavaScript; all numbers are stored as floating-point numbers internally.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> integerValue </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 42</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// An integer number</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> floatValue </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 3.14</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// A floating-point number</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> negativeValue </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> -</span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Negative number</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> bigNumber </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 123e5</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Represents 12300000 (123 * 10^5)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> smallNumber </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 5e-2</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Represents 0.05 (5 * 10^-2)</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Numerical operations include addition (<code>+</code>), subtraction (<code>-</code>), multiplication (<code>*</code>), division (<code>/</code>), and modulus (<code>%</code>).</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> sum </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 10</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 5</span><span style="color:#24292E">;     </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 15</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> product </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 7</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> *</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 3</span><span style="color:#24292E">;  </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 21</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> remainder </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 17</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> %</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 5</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 2 (remainder of 17 divided by 5)</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Special numeric values include <code>Infinity</code> (a number too big to represent) and <code>NaN</code> (Not a Number), which results from invalid arithmetic operations.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> /</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Infinity</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#D73A49">-</span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> /</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// -Infinity</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"hello"</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> /</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 2</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// NaN</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h4>String</h4>
<p>The <code>String</code> type represents sequences of characters, such as text. Strings are immutable, meaning they cannot be changed after they are created. You can create strings using single quotes (<code>''</code>), double quotes (<code>""</code>), or backticks (<code>`</code>).</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> singleQuoteString </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'Hello, JavaScript!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> doubleQuoteString </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Web development is fun."</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> mixedQuotes </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "It's a beautiful day."</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Valid, as double quotes enclose single quote</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> escapedQuote </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'He said, "Hello!"'</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Valid, escaping inner double quote if using single quotes</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Backticks (<code>``</code>) define <strong>template literals</strong>, which offer more flexibility, including multi-line strings and embedded expressions.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> name </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Alice"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> greeting </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> `Hello, ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">name</span><span style="color:#032F62">}!`</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// String interpolation</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(greeting); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: Hello, Alice!</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> multiLine </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> `This is a</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">string that</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">spans multiple lines.`</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(multiLine);</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>String concatenation uses the <code>+</code> operator.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> firstName </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Jane"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> lastName </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Doe"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> fullName </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> firstName </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#032F62"> " "</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#24292E"> lastName; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Jane Doe</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h4>Boolean</h4>
<p>The <code>Boolean</code> type represents a logical entity and can have only two possible values: <code>true</code> or <code>false</code>. Booleans are fundamental for conditional logic and control flow.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> isLoggedOn </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> true</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> hasPermission </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> false</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> isEqual </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">5</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> ===</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 5</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// true</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> isGreater </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> &gt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 20</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// false</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Boolean values are often the result of comparison operators (e.g., <code>==</code>, <code>!=</code>, <code>&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;</code>, <code>&gt;=</code>, <code>&lt;=</code>).</p>
<h4>Undefined</h4>
<p>The <code>Undefined</code> type represents a variable that has been declared but has not yet been assigned a value. It also signifies the absence of a value.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> city; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Declared but not assigned a value, so its value is undefined</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(city); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: undefined</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// If a function doesn't explicitly return a value, it implicitly returns undefined.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> doNothing</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // No return statement</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> result </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> doNothing</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(result); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: undefined</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h4>Null</h4>
<p>The <code>Null</code> type represents the intentional absence of any object value. It is a primitive value and not an object. It's often used to indicate that a variable explicitly has no value.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> car </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> null</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 'car' explicitly has no value</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(car); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: null</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// The 'typeof' operator can be misleading with null:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#D73A49">typeof</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> null</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: "object" (This is a historical bug in JavaScript)</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>While <code>undefined</code> means a variable <em>hasn't been assigned</em> a value, <code>null</code> means a variable <em>has been explicitly assigned no value</em>.</p>
<h4>Symbol (ES6)</h4>
<p>The <code>Symbol</code> type (introduced in ES6) is a unique and immutable primitive value that can be used as the key of an object property. Symbols are guaranteed to be unique, even if they have the same description, making them suitable for creating unique property keys to avoid naming collisions.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> id1</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> Symbol</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'id'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> id2</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> Symbol</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'id'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(id1 </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#24292E"> id2); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: false (Symbols with the same description are unique)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> user </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    name: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"John"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    [id1]: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">123</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // Using a Symbol as a property key</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">};</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(user[id1]); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: 123</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Symbols are not enumerable in <code>for...in</code> loops, providing a way to add properties to objects that are not easily discoverable.</p>
<h4>BigInt (ES2020)</h4>
<p>The <code>BigInt</code> type (introduced in ES2020) is a primitive data type that can represent whole numbers larger than <code>2^53 - 1</code>, which is the maximum number JavaScript's <code>Number</code> type can reliably represent. A <code>BigInt</code> is created by appending <code>n</code> to the end of an integer literal.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> largeNumber </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1234567890123456789012345678901234567890</span><span style="color:#D73A49">n</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(largeNumber);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> anotherBigInt </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> BigInt</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"9007199254740991"</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Can also be created from a string</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Arithmetic operations on <code>BigInt</code> values behave similarly to <code>Number</code> operations, but you cannot mix <code>BigInt</code> and <code>Number</code> types directly in operations without explicit conversion.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> x </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">n</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> y </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 5</span><span style="color:#D73A49">n</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> sumBigInt </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> x </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#24292E"> y; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 15n</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// let mixedSum = x + 5;</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // This would cause a TypeError</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Non-Primitive Data Type: Object</h3>
<p>The <code>Object</code> type is the only non-primitive data type in JavaScript. Objects are complex data structures that can store collections of various data types, including other objects and functions. They are fundamental to almost everything in JavaScript, including arrays and functions.</p>
<p>Objects are typically created using curly braces <code>{}</code> and consist of key-value pairs (properties).</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> person </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    firstName: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Alice"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 'firstName' is a key (property name), "Alice" is its value</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    lastName: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Smith"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    age: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">28</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    isStudent: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">false</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    hobbies: [</span><span style="color:#032F62">"reading"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"hiking"</span><span style="color:#24292E">], </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// A property can be an array</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    address: { </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// A property can be another object</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        street: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"123 Main St"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        city: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Anytown"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    greet</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#24292E">() { </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// A property can be a function (method)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Hello, my name is ${</span><span style="color:#005CC5">this</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#24292E">firstName</span><span style="color:#032F62">}.`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">};</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(person.firstName); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Accessing properties using dot notation</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(person[</span><span style="color:#032F62">"lastName"</span><span style="color:#24292E">]); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Accessing properties using bracket notation</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">person.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">greet</span><span style="color:#24292E">(); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Calling a method</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Objects are passed by reference, meaning when you assign an object to a new variable, both variables point to the same underlying object in memory. Changes made through one variable will be reflected in the other.</p>
<h2>Practical Examples and Demonstrations</h2>
<p>Let's put these syntax and data type concepts into practice with a few scenarios.</p>
<h3>Example 1: User Profile Display</h3>
<p>Imagine we're building a simple user profile section. We'll use various data types and proper syntax.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Example: User Profile Data</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Define user details using different JavaScript data types</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// String: User's name</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> userName </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Johnathon Doe"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Number: User's age</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> userAge </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 34</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Boolean: Is the user an active member?</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> isActiveMember </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> true</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Null: User's middle name, initially unknown</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> userMiddleName </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> null</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Undefined: User's favorite color, not yet set</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> favoriteColor; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Declared but no value assigned</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Object: A more complex structure for contact information</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> contactInfo </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    email: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"john.doe@example.com"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    phone: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"555-123-4567"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    address: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"123 Dev Street"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">};</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Array (which is a special type of object): List of skills</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> userSkills </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#032F62">"JavaScript"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"HTML"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"CSS"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Git"</span><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Displaying some of this information using console.log</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"--- User Profile ---"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Name: "</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#24292E"> userName); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Concatenating strings</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Age: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">userAge</span><span style="color:#032F62">} years old`</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Using a template literal for easier string formatting</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Active Member: "</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#24292E"> isActiveMember);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Middle Name: "</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#24292E"> userMiddleName); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Will output 'null'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Favorite Color: "</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#24292E"> favoriteColor); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Will output 'undefined'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Email: "</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#24292E"> contactInfo.email); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Accessing object property</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Skills: "</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#24292E"> userSkills.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">join</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">", "</span><span style="color:#24292E">)); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Array method to join elements into a string</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Demonstrating case sensitivity</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> greeting </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Hello"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// let Greeting = "Hi";</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // This would be a separate variable</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// console.log(greeting);</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // 'Hello'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// console.log(Greeting);</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // 'Hi'</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Example 2: Simple Calculation and Output</h3>
<p>This example demonstrates number operations and string interpolation.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Example: Basic Calculation and Output</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Calculate the total cost of items and display it.</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Numbers: Item prices and quantity</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> itemPrice1 </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 15.99</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Price of the first item</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> quantity1 </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 2</span><span style="color:#24292E">;      </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Quantity of the first item</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> itemPrice2 </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 5.50</span><span style="color:#24292E">;  </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Price of the second item</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> quantity2 </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 3</span><span style="color:#24292E">;      </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Quantity of the second item</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Calculate subtotal for each item</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> subtotal1 </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> itemPrice1 </span><span style="color:#D73A49">*</span><span style="color:#24292E"> quantity1; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 31.98</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> subtotal2 </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> itemPrice2 </span><span style="color:#D73A49">*</span><span style="color:#24292E"> quantity2; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 16.50</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Calculate total cost</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> totalCost </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> subtotal1 </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#24292E"> subtotal2; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 48.48</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Number: Applying a discount percentage</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> discountPercentage </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0.10</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 10% discount</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Calculate discounted amount</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> discountAmount </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> totalCost </span><span style="color:#D73A49">*</span><span style="color:#24292E"> discountPercentage; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 4.848</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Calculate final price after discount</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> finalPrice </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> totalCost </span><span style="color:#D73A49">-</span><span style="color:#24292E"> discountAmount;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Displaying results using template literals for clear formatting</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"</span><span style="color:#005CC5">\n</span><span style="color:#032F62">--- Order Summary ---"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Item 1: $${</span><span style="color:#24292E">itemPrice1</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toFixed</span><span style="color:#032F62">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#032F62">)</span><span style="color:#032F62">} x ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">quantity1</span><span style="color:#032F62">} = $${</span><span style="color:#24292E">subtotal1</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toFixed</span><span style="color:#032F62">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#032F62">)</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// .toFixed(2) formats to 2 decimal places</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Item 2: $${</span><span style="color:#24292E">itemPrice2</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toFixed</span><span style="color:#032F62">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#032F62">)</span><span style="color:#032F62">} x ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">quantity2</span><span style="color:#032F62">} = $${</span><span style="color:#24292E">subtotal2</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toFixed</span><span style="color:#032F62">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#032F62">)</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Total Cost (before discount): $${</span><span style="color:#24292E">totalCost</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toFixed</span><span style="color:#032F62">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#032F62">)</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Discount (${</span><span style="color:#032F62">(</span><span style="color:#24292E">discountPercentage</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> *</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 100</span><span style="color:#032F62">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toFixed</span><span style="color:#032F62">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#032F62">)</span><span style="color:#032F62">}%): -$${</span><span style="color:#24292E">discountAmount</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toFixed</span><span style="color:#032F62">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#032F62">)</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Final Price: $${</span><span style="color:#24292E">finalPrice</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toFixed</span><span style="color:#032F62">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#032F62">)</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Using BigInt for a very large inventory count (hypothetical)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> warehouseCapacity </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 9007199254740991</span><span style="color:#D73A49">n</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Maximum Number + 1</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> currentInventory </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 12345678901234567890</span><span style="color:#D73A49">n</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> remainingCapacity </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> warehouseCapacity </span><span style="color:#D73A49">-</span><span style="color:#24292E"> currentInventory;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// console.log(`Remaining Warehouse Capacity: ${remainingCapacity}`);</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // This would throw an error trying to mix BigInt with String concatenation without explicit conversion for template literals.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Remaining Warehouse Capacity: "</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> String</span><span style="color:#24292E">(remainingCapacity)); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Explicitly converting BigInt to String</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h2>Exercises</h2>
<p>Complete the following exercises to solidify your understanding of JavaScript syntax and data types.</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Variable Declaration and Assignment</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>Declare a variable <code>productName</code> and assign it a string value of your favorite product.</li>
<li>Declare a variable <code>productPrice</code> and assign it a number value representing its price.</li>
<li>Declare a variable <code>isInStock</code> and assign it a boolean value (either <code>true</code> or <code>false</code>).</li>
<li>Declare a variable <code>productDescription</code> but do not assign it a value.</li>
<li>Declare a variable <code>productRating</code> and explicitly set its value to <code>null</code>.</li>
<li>Print the value of each variable to the console, labeling each output (e.g., "Product Name: [value]").</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Working with Numbers and Strings</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>Create two number variables: <code>num1</code> with value <code>25</code> and <code>num2</code> with value <code>7</code>.</li>
<li>Calculate their sum, difference, product, quotient, and the remainder of their division. Store each result in a new variable.</li>
<li>Create a string variable <code>messagePart1</code> with the value "The result of calculations is: ".</li>
<li>Create a string variable <code>messagePart2</code> that concatenates <code>messagePart1</code> with a template literal containing the sum, difference, product, quotient, and remainder in a readable format. For example: "Sum: [sum], Difference: [diff], etc."</li>
<li>Print <code>messagePart2</code> to the console.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Object Creation</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>Create an object called <code>book</code> that represents a book.</li>
<li>The <code>book</code> object should have the following properties:
<ul>
<li><code>title</code> (String)</li>
<li><code>author</code> (String)</li>
<li><code>pages</code> (Number)</li>
<li><code>isPublished</code> (Boolean)</li>
<li><code>genres</code> (an Array of Strings, e.g., <code>["Fantasy", "Adventure"]</code>)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Access and print the <code>title</code> using dot notation.</li>
<li>Access and print the <code>author</code> using bracket notation.</li>
<li>Print the <code>genres</code> array.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Case Sensitivity and Comments</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>Declare a variable <code>myVariable</code> with a string value.</li>
<li>Declare another variable <code>MyVariable</code> (note the different casing) with a different string value.</li>
<li>Print both variables to the console to confirm they are treated as distinct.</li>
<li>Add a single-line comment explaining the purpose of <code>myVariable</code>.</li>
<li>Add a multi-line comment describing the difference between <code>null</code> and <code>undefined</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
  
</div>

<div id="chapter-3.2">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Variables, Operators, and Control Flow in JavaScript</h1><p>JavaScript variables store data values. Operators perform operations on these values, and control flow statements dictate the order in which instructions are executed based on conditions. These are fundamental building blocks for creating dynamic and interactive web applications.</p>
<h2>Variables in JavaScript</h2>
<p>Variables are named containers for storing data. In JavaScript, you declare variables using <code>let</code>, <code>const</code>, or <code>var</code>. Modern JavaScript primarily uses <code>let</code> and <code>const</code>.</p>
<h3>Declaring Variables with <code>let</code></h3>
<p>The <code>let</code> keyword declares a block-scoped local variable. This means the variable is only accessible within the block of code where it's defined (e.g., inside an <code>if</code> statement or a <code>for</code> loop). Variables declared with <code>let</code> can be reassigned.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> userName </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Alice"</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Declares a variable named userName and assigns it the string "Alice"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(userName); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: Alice</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">userName </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Bob"</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Reassigns the value of userName to "Bob"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(userName); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: Bob</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Example of block scope with let</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">true</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> message </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Hello from inside the block!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(message); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: Hello from inside the block!</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// console.log(message);</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // This would cause an error because 'message' is not defined outside the block</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Declaring Variables with <code>const</code></h3>
<p>The <code>const</code> keyword declares a block-scoped local variable whose value cannot be reassigned after its initial assignment. It stands for "constant." This is useful for values that should not change throughout the program's execution.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> appName</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "MyWebApp"</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Declares a constant named appName</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(appName); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: MyWebApp</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// appName = "NewAppName";</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // This would cause a TypeError: Assignment to constant variable.</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// For objects and arrays declared with const, the variable itself cannot be reassigned,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// but the *contents* of the object or array can often be modified.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> userProfile</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  name: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Charlie"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  age: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">30</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">};</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(userProfile.name); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: Charlie</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">userProfile.age </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 31</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// This is allowed: modifying a property of the object</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(userProfile.age); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: 31</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// userProfile = { name: "David", age: 25 };</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // This would cause a TypeError: Assignment to constant variable.</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Declaring Variables with <code>var</code> (Legacy)</h3>
<p>The <code>var</code> keyword declares a function-scoped or globally-scoped variable. Variables declared with <code>var</code> are hoisted to the top of their scope and can be redeclared and reassigned. While <code>var</code> still works, it's generally discouraged in modern JavaScript due to its broader scope behavior which can lead to unexpected bugs. <code>let</code> and <code>const</code> provide more predictable and safer variable declarations.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">var</span><span style="color:#24292E"> oldStyleVariable </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "I am a var"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(oldStyleVariable); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: I am a var</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">oldStyleVariable </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "I can be reassigned"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(oldStyleVariable); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: I can be reassigned</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">var</span><span style="color:#24292E"> oldStyleVariable </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "I can even be redeclared"</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// This is possible with var, but not with let/const</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(oldStyleVariable); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: I can even be redeclared</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Example of function scope with var</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> showVarScope</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  var</span><span style="color:#24292E"> functionScoped </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Inside function"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(functionScoped); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: Inside function</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">showVarScope</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// console.log(functionScoped);</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // This would cause an error, as 'functionScoped' is not defined outside the function</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Example of var's hoisting behavior (conceptually moved to top of scope)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(hoistedVar); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: undefined (no error, but value is undefined)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">var</span><span style="color:#24292E"> hoistedVar </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "I was hoisted!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(hoistedVar); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: I was hoisted!</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h2>JavaScript Operators</h2>
<p>Operators are special symbols or keywords that perform operations on one or more values (operands) and return a result.</p>
<h3>Assignment Operators</h3>
<p>Assignment operators assign a value to a variable. The most common is the simple assignment operator <code>=</code>.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>=</code> (Assignment): <code>x = 10</code></li>
<li><code>+=</code> (Addition assignment): <code>x += 5</code> is equivalent to <code>x = x + 5</code></li>
<li><code>-=</code> (Subtraction assignment): <code>x -= 5</code> is equivalent to <code>x = x - 5</code></li>
<li><code>*=</code> (Multiplication assignment): <code>x *= 5</code> is equivalent to <code>x = x * 5</code></li>
<li><code>/=</code> (Division assignment): <code>x /= 5</code> is equivalent to <code>x = x / 5</code></li>
<li><code>%=</code> (Remainder assignment): <code>x %= 5</code> is equivalent to <code>x = x % 5</code></li>
</ul>
