<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">a </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 5</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// a is now 15</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(a);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> b </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 20</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">b </span><span style="color:#D73A49">-=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 7</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// b is now 13</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(b);</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Arithmetic Operators</h3>
<p>Arithmetic operators perform mathematical calculations.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>+</code> (Addition): <code>5 + 3</code> results in <code>8</code></li>
<li><code>-</code> (Subtraction): <code>10 - 4</code> results in <code>6</code></li>
<li><code>*</code> (Multiplication): <code>6 * 2</code> results in <code>12</code></li>
<li><code>/</code> (Division): <code>15 / 3</code> results in <code>5</code></li>
<li><code>%</code> (Remainder): <code>10 % 3</code> results in <code>1</code> (the remainder after division)</li>
<li><code>**</code> (Exponentiation): <code>2 ** 3</code> results in <code>8</code> (2 to the power of 3)</li>
<li><code>++</code> (Increment): <code>x++</code> (post-increment, uses value then increments), <code>++x</code> (pre-increment, increments then uses value)</li>
<li><code>--</code> (Decrement): <code>x--</code> (post-decrement), <code>--x</code> (pre-decrement)</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> num1 </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 10</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> num2 </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 3</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(num1 </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#24292E"> num2);  </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 13</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(num1 </span><span style="color:#D73A49">-</span><span style="color:#24292E"> num2);  </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 7</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(num1 </span><span style="color:#D73A49">*</span><span style="color:#24292E"> num2);  </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 30</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(num1 </span><span style="color:#D73A49">/</span><span style="color:#24292E"> num2);  </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 3.333...</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(num1 </span><span style="color:#D73A49">%</span><span style="color:#24292E"> num2);  </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 1</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(num1 </span><span style="color:#D73A49">**</span><span style="color:#24292E"> num2); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 1000 (10 to the power of 3)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> counter </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">counter</span><span style="color:#D73A49">++</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// counter is now 1</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">++</span><span style="color:#24292E">counter; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// counter is now 2</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(counter); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: 2</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Comparison Operators</h3>
<p>Comparison operators compare two values and return a boolean (<code>true</code> or <code>false</code>).</p>
<ul>
<li><code>==</code> (Equal to): Compares value, performs type coercion. <code>5 == "5"</code> is <code>true</code>.</li>
<li><code>!=</code> (Not equal to): Compares value, performs type coercion. <code>5 != "5"</code> is <code>false</code>.</li>
<li><code>===</code> (Strict equal to): Compares value and type. <code>5 === "5"</code> is <code>false</code>. (Recommended)</li>
<li><code>!==</code> (Strict not equal to): Compares value and type. <code>5 !== "5"</code> is <code>true</code>. (Recommended)</li>
<li><code>&gt;</code> (Greater than): <code>10 &gt; 5</code> is <code>true</code>.</li>
<li><code>&lt;</code> (Less than): <code>5 &lt; 10</code> is <code>true</code>.</li>
<li><code>&gt;=</code> (Greater than or equal to): <code>10 &gt;= 10</code> is <code>true</code>.</li>
<li><code>&lt;=</code> (Less than or equal to): <code>5 &lt;= 10</code> is <code>true</code>.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> age </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 25</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> ageString </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "25"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(age </span><span style="color:#D73A49">==</span><span style="color:#24292E"> ageString);   </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// true (loose equality, type coercion)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(age </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#24292E"> ageString);  </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// false (strict equality, different types)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(age </span><span style="color:#D73A49">!=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 30</span><span style="color:#24292E">);          </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// true</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(age </span><span style="color:#D73A49">!==</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 25</span><span style="color:#24292E">);         </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// false</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(age </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&gt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 20</span><span style="color:#24292E">);           </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// true</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(age </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&lt;=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 25</span><span style="color:#24292E">);          </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// true</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Logical Operators</h3>
<p>Logical operators combine boolean expressions and return a boolean result.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>&amp;&amp;</code> (Logical AND): Returns <code>true</code> if both operands are <code>true</code>.</li>
<li><code>||</code> (Logical OR): Returns <code>true</code> if at least one operand is <code>true</code>.</li>
<li><code>!</code> (Logical NOT): Inverts the boolean value of the operand.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> isLoggedIn </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> true</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> isAdmin </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> false</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(isLoggedIn </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&amp;&amp;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> isAdmin); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// false (true AND false is false)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(isLoggedIn </span><span style="color:#D73A49">||</span><span style="color:#24292E"> isAdmin); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// true (true OR false is true)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">isLoggedIn);           </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// false (NOT true is false)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> score </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 85</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> hasPassed </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (score </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&gt;=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 60</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> &amp;&amp;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> score </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&lt;=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 100</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// true</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(hasPassed);</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h2>Control Flow in JavaScript</h2>
<p>Control flow statements determine the order in which a program executes its instructions. They allow you to make decisions and repeat actions.</p>
<h3>Conditional Statements: <code>if</code>, <code>else if</code>, <code>else</code></h3>
<p>Conditional statements execute different blocks of code based on whether a specified condition is <code>true</code> or <code>false</code>.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong><code>if</code> statement</strong>: Executes a block of code if a condition is true.</li>
<li><strong><code>else if</code> statement</strong>: Used to specify a new condition if the first condition is false.</li>
<li><strong><code>else</code> statement</strong>: Executes a block of code if all preceding conditions are false.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> temperature </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 20</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// degrees Celsius</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (temperature </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&gt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 25</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"It's hot outside!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">} </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (temperature </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&gt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 15</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"It's pleasant."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">} </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"It's a bit chilly."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: It's pleasant.</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> hour </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 14</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 2 PM</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (hour </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 12</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Good morning!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">} </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (hour </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 18</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Good afternoon!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">} </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Good evening!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: Good afternoon!</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3><code>switch</code> Statement</h3>
<p>The <code>switch</code> statement is an alternative to long <code>if-else if</code> chains when you need to choose among many different options based on the value of a single variable.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> dayOfWeek </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Wednesday"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> activity;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">switch</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (dayOfWeek) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  case</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Monday"</span><span style="color:#24292E">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    activity </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Start of the work week"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    break</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  case</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Wednesday"</span><span style="color:#24292E">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    activity </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Mid-week check-in"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    break</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  case</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Friday"</span><span style="color:#24292E">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    activity </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Weekend is coming!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    break</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  default</span><span style="color:#24292E">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    activity </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Regular day"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Today's activity: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">activity</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: Today's activity: Mid-week check-in</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> fruit </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "apple"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">switch</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (fruit) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  case</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "apple"</span><span style="color:#24292E">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  case</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "banana"</span><span style="color:#24292E">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"This is a common fruit."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    break</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  case</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "mango"</span><span style="color:#24292E">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"This is an exotic fruit."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    break</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  default</span><span style="color:#24292E">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Unknown fruit."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: This is a common fruit.</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The <code>break</code> keyword is crucial. Without it, execution "falls through" to the next <code>case</code> block, even if the condition for that <code>case</code> is not met. The <code>default</code> case is executed if none of the <code>case</code> values match the expression.</p>
<h3>Loops: <code>for</code>, <code>while</code>, <code>do...while</code></h3>
<p>Loops repeatedly execute a block of code until a certain condition is met.</p>
<h4><code>for</code> Loop</h4>
<p>The <code>for</code> loop is used when you know in advance how many times you want to loop. It typically consists of three parts: initialization, condition, and increment/decrement.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Loop from 0 to 4</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">for</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> i </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">; i </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 5</span><span style="color:#24292E">; i</span><span style="color:#D73A49">++</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Iteration number: "</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#24292E"> i);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/*</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Output:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Iteration number: 0</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Iteration number: 1</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Iteration number: 2</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Iteration number: 3</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Iteration number: 4</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">*/</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Looping through an array (will be covered more in Module 4)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> colors</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#032F62">"red"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"green"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"blue"</span><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">for</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> i </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">; i </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&lt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> colors.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">length</span><span style="color:#24292E">; i</span><span style="color:#D73A49">++</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Color at index ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">i</span><span style="color:#032F62">}: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">colors</span><span style="color:#032F62">[</span><span style="color:#24292E">i</span><span style="color:#032F62">]</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/*</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Output:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Color at index 0: red</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Color at index 1: green</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Color at index 2: blue</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">*/</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h4><code>while</code> Loop</h4>
<p>The <code>while</code> loop executes a block of code as long as a specified condition is true. It's used when the number of iterations is not known beforehand.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> count </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">while</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (count </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 3</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Count is: "</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#24292E"> count);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  count</span><span style="color:#D73A49">++</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Increment count to eventually make the condition false</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/*</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Output:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Count is: 0</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Count is: 1</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Count is: 2</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">*/</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Example: Simulating a random number until a certain value is met</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> randomNumber </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">while</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (randomNumber </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0.8</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  randomNumber </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> Math.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">random</span><span style="color:#24292E">(); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Generates a random number between 0 (inclusive) and 1 (exclusive)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Generated random number: "</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#24292E"> randomNumber);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Loop stopped when random number was &gt;= 0.8"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Be careful with <code>while</code> loops to avoid infinite loops by ensuring the condition eventually becomes false.</p>
<h4><code>do...while</code> Loop</h4>
<p>The <code>do...while</code> loop is similar to the <code>while</code> loop, but it guarantees that the loop body will execute <em>at least once</em>, because the condition is checked after the first iteration.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> i </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">do</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Do-While count: "</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#24292E"> i);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  i</span><span style="color:#D73A49">++</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">} </span><span style="color:#D73A49">while</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (i </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 3</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/*</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Output:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Do-While count: 0</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Do-While count: 1</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Do-While count: 2</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">*/</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Example demonstrating guaranteed execution</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> mustExecuteOnce </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 5</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">do</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"This will always print at least once, value: "</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#24292E"> mustExecuteOnce);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  mustExecuteOnce</span><span style="color:#D73A49">++</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">} </span><span style="color:#D73A49">while</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (mustExecuteOnce </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 3</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Condition is false initially, but loop still runs once</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: This will always print at least once, value: 5</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h2>Practical Examples and Demonstrations</h2>
<p>Here are some examples combining variables, operators, and control flow to create more dynamic logic.</p>
<h3>Calculating a Discounted Price</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> originalPrice</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 120.00</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> discountPercentage</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0.15</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 15% discount</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> minPriceForDiscount</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 100.00</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> finalPrice;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Check if the item qualifies for a discount</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (originalPrice </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&gt;=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> minPriceForDiscount) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> discountAmount </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> originalPrice </span><span style="color:#D73A49">*</span><span style="color:#24292E"> discountPercentage;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  finalPrice </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> originalPrice </span><span style="color:#D73A49">-</span><span style="color:#24292E"> discountAmount;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Original Price: $${</span><span style="color:#24292E">originalPrice</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toFixed</span><span style="color:#032F62">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#032F62">)</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Discount Applied: $${</span><span style="color:#24292E">discountAmount</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toFixed</span><span style="color:#032F62">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#032F62">)</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Final Price: $${</span><span style="color:#24292E">finalPrice</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toFixed</span><span style="color:#032F62">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#032F62">)</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">} </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  finalPrice </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> originalPrice;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Original Price: $${</span><span style="color:#24292E">originalPrice</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toFixed</span><span style="color:#032F62">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#032F62">)</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"No discount applied."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Final Price: $${</span><span style="color:#24292E">finalPrice</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toFixed</span><span style="color:#032F62">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#032F62">)</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output (for originalPrice = 120):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Original Price: $120.00</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Discount Applied: $18.00</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Final Price: $102.00</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This example uses <code>const</code> for values that shouldn't change, <code>let</code> for a value that will be assigned based on a condition, arithmetic operators (<code>*</code>, <code>-</code>), and an <code>if-else</code> statement for control flow.</p>
<h3>User Authentication Scenario</h3>
<p>This hypothetical scenario checks user credentials and role.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> storedUsername</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "adminUser"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> storedPassword</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "password123"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> storedRole</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "administrator"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> enteredUsername </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "adminUser"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> enteredPassword </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "password123"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> userRole </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "administrator"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Use logical AND to check both username and password</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (enteredUsername </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#24292E"> storedUsername </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&amp;&amp;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> enteredPassword </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#24292E"> storedPassword) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Login successful!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // Use logical OR to check for multiple allowed roles, and strict equality for comparison</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (userRole </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#24292E"> storedRole </span><span style="color:#D73A49">||</span><span style="color:#24292E"> userRole </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "editor"</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Welcome, ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">enteredUsername</span><span style="color:#032F62">}! You have access to administrative features.`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Welcome, ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">enteredUsername</span><span style="color:#032F62">}! You have standard user access.`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">} </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Invalid username or password."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Login successful!</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Welcome, adminUser! You have access to administrative features.</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This demonstrates strict equality (<code>===</code>), logical AND (<code>&amp;&amp;</code>), logical OR (<code>||</code>), and nested <code>if-else</code> statements.</p>
<h3>Countdown Timer with a Loop</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> countdown </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 5</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Starting countdown:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">while</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (countdown </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&gt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`${</span><span style="color:#24292E">countdown</span><span style="color:#032F62">}...`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  countdown</span><span style="color:#D73A49">--</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Decrement the countdown</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Lift off!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/*</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Output:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Starting countdown:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">5...</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">4...</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">3...</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">2...</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">1...</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">Lift off!</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">*/</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This example uses a <code>while</code> loop, a comparison operator (<code>&gt;</code>), and the decrement operator (<code>--</code>) to create a simple countdown.</p>

<p>Complete the following exercises to practice using variables, operators, and control flow.</p>

<li>
<p><strong>Grade Calculator:</strong>
Declare a variable <code>score</code> and assign it a number between 0 and 100.
Use <code>if</code>, <code>else if</code>, and <code>else</code> statements to determine and print the corresponding letter grade:</p>
<ul>
<li>90-100: "A"</li>
<li>80-89: "B"</li>
<li>70-79: "C"</li>
<li>60-69: "D"</li>
<li>Below 60: "F"</li>
</ul>
<p>Example: If <code>score</code> is 85, output should be "Grade: B".</p>

6
8
10</p>

<div id="chapter-3.3">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">DOM Manipulation: Selecting and Modifying Elements</h1><p>The Document Object Model (DOM) acts as a programming interface for web documents. It represents the page so that programs can change the document structure, style, and content. When a web page is loaded, the browser creates a DOM of the page, which is organized as a tree-like structure where each element, attribute, and piece of text is a node. JavaScript can then interact with this DOM to dynamically modify the webpage.</p>
<h2>Selecting Elements</h2>
<p>Before manipulating any element on a webpage, it must first be selected. JavaScript provides several methods to select single or multiple elements based on their ID, class, tag name, or CSS selectors.</p>
<h3>Selecting a Single Element</h3>
<p>To select a single element, the most common methods are <code>document.getElementById()</code> and <code>document.querySelector()</code>.</p>
<h4><code>document.getElementById()</code></h4>
<p>This method selects an element based on its unique <code>id</code> attribute. Since IDs are meant to be unique within a document, this method will always return a single element or <code>null</code> if no element with the specified ID is found.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// HTML structure: &lt;div id="myHeading"&gt;Hello World&lt;/div&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Select the div element with the id "myHeading"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> myHeading</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'myHeading'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(myHeading); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs the &lt;div&gt; element</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p><strong>Example:</strong>
Imagine a web page with a single main title. To change its text dynamically, you would first select it by its ID.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;!</span><span style="color:#22863A">DOCTYPE</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> lang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> charset</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"UTF-8"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"viewport"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> content</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;DOM Selection Example&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"mainTitle"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Welcome to My Website&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> titleElement</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'mainTitle'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Selected element by ID:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, titleElement);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
