<h4><code>document.querySelector()</code></h4>
<p>This is a more versatile method that allows selecting the <em>first</em> element that matches a specified CSS selector. It can select elements by ID, class, tag name, attributes, or any combination supported by CSS selectors.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// HTML structure:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// &lt;p class="intro"&gt;This is an introduction.&lt;/p&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// &lt;h2 id="sectionHeader"&gt;Section Title&lt;/h2&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// &lt;div&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">//     &lt;p class="intro"&gt;Another intro paragraph.&lt;/p&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// &lt;/div&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Select the first element with the class "intro"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> firstIntro</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">querySelector</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'.intro'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(firstIntro); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs the first &lt;p&gt; element with class "intro"</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Select the element with the id "sectionHeader"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> sectionHeader</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">querySelector</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'#sectionHeader'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(sectionHeader); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs the &lt;h2&gt; element</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Select the first &lt;div&gt; element</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> firstDiv</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">querySelector</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'div'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(firstDiv); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs the first &lt;div&gt; element</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Select the first &lt;p&gt; element that is a direct child of a &lt;div&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> divParagraph</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">querySelector</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'div &gt; p'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(divParagraph); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs the &lt;p class="intro"&gt;Another intro paragraph.&lt;/p&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p><strong>Example:</strong>
If a page contains multiple paragraphs, but you only need to interact with the first one that has a specific class, <code>querySelector</code> is ideal.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;!</span><span style="color:#22863A">DOCTYPE</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> lang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> charset</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"UTF-8"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"viewport"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> content</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;DOM Selection Example&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"highlight"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;This is the first highlighted paragraph.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;This is a regular paragraph.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"highlight"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;This is the second highlighted paragraph.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> firstHighlighted</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">querySelector</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'.highlight'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Selected first element with class 'highlight':"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, firstHighlighted);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Selecting Multiple Elements</h3>
<p>To select multiple elements, the primary methods are <code>document.getElementsByClassName()</code>, <code>document.getElementsByTagName()</code>, and <code>document.querySelectorAll()</code>. These methods return a collection of elements, either an <code>HTMLCollection</code> or a <code>NodeList</code>. Both are array-like objects, meaning you can iterate over them using loops, but they do not have all the methods of a true array (e.g., <code>forEach</code> is available on <code>NodeList</code> but not always on <code>HTMLCollection</code> in older browsers; it's safer to convert <code>HTMLCollection</code> to an array if you need array methods).</p>
<h4><code>document.getElementsByClassName()</code></h4>
<p>This method selects all elements that have a specific class name. It returns an <code>HTMLCollection</code> of elements.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// HTML structure:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// &lt;li class="item"&gt;Item 1&lt;/li&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// &lt;li class="item"&gt;Item 2&lt;/li&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// &lt;li&gt;Item 3&lt;/li&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Select all elements with the class "item"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> items</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementsByClassName</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'item'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(items); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs an HTMLCollection of two &lt;li&gt; elements</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// You can iterate over the collection</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">for</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> i </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">; i </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&lt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> items.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">length</span><span style="color:#24292E">; i</span><span style="color:#D73A49">++</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(items[i].textContent); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs "Item 1", then "Item 2"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p><strong>Example:</strong>
Imagine a list of products where each product item has the class <code>product</code>. To apply a change to all product items, you would select them using this method.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;!</span><span style="color:#22863A">DOCTYPE</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> lang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> charset</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"UTF-8"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"viewport"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> content</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;DOM Selection Example&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"product"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Monitor&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<h4><code>document.getElementsByTagName()</code></h4>
<p>This method selects all elements with a specified tag name (e.g., <code>p</code>, <code>div</code>, <code>a</code>). It also returns an <code>HTMLCollection</code>.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// HTML structure:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// &lt;p&gt;Paragraph one.&lt;/p&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// &lt;div&gt;Some content.&lt;/div&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// &lt;p&gt;Paragraph two.&lt;/p&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Select all &lt;p&gt; elements</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> paragraphs</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementsByTagName</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'p'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(paragraphs); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs an HTMLCollection of two &lt;p&gt; elements</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Accessing individual elements</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(paragraphs[</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">].textContent); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs "Paragraph one."</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p><strong>Example:</strong>
If you need to change the styling or content of all <code>&lt;h2&gt;</code> headings on a page, you would select them by their tag name.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Section A&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Content for section A.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Section B&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Content for section B.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`H2 text: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">h2Elements</span><span style="color:#032F62">[</span><span style="color:#24292E">i</span><span style="color:#032F62">].</span><span style="color:#24292E">textContent</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>

<h4><code>document.querySelectorAll()</code></h4>
<p>Similar to <code>querySelector()</code>, this method uses CSS selectors, but it returns <em>all</em> elements that match the selector, not just the first one. It returns a <code>NodeList</code>. <code>NodeList</code>s are generally preferred over <code>HTMLCollection</code>s for modern JavaScript because they can be directly iterated with <code>forEach</code> and can be easily converted to an array using the spread operator (<code>...</code>).</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// HTML structure:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// &lt;div class="card"&gt;Item 1&lt;/div&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// &lt;p class="card"&gt;Item 2&lt;/p&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// &lt;div id="container"&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">//     &lt;span class="card"&gt;Item 3&lt;/span&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// &lt;/div&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Select all elements with the class "card"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> cards</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">querySelectorAll</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'.card'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(cards); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs a NodeList of three elements</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Iterate using forEach</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">cards.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">forEach</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">card</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(card.textContent); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs "Item 1", "Item 2", "Item 3"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Select all &lt;p&gt; elements inside a &lt;div&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> divParagraphs</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">querySelectorAll</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'div p'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(divParagraphs); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs a NodeList of relevant &lt;p&gt; elements</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p><strong>Example:</strong>
To select all input fields with a <code>type="text"</code> attribute, you would use <code>querySelectorAll</code>.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Email:&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"email"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"userEmail"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">br</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Address:&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"text"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"userAddress"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">form</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> textInputs</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">querySelectorAll</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'input[type="text"]'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Selected all text input elements:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, textInputs);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        textInputs.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">forEach</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">input</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            input.style.border </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '2px solid blue'</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Future modification concept</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h2>Modifying Elements</h2>
<p>Once an element is selected, its properties can be modified. This includes changing its content, attributes, and styles.</p>
<h3>Modifying Content</h3>
<p>The most common ways to change an element's content are through <code>textContent</code> and <code>innerHTML</code>.</p>
<h4><code>textContent</code></h4>
<p>This property gets or sets the text content of a node and its descendants. It returns all text, even if it's hidden by CSS. When setting <code>textContent</code>, any existing HTML within the element is removed and replaced with the new plain text. It is generally safer to use <code>textContent</code> when you only need to update text and do not want to introduce new HTML, as it helps prevent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// HTML structure: &lt;p id="myParagraph"&gt;Hello &lt;strong&gt;World&lt;/strong&gt;!&lt;/p&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> paragraph</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'myParagraph'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(paragraph.textContent); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: "Hello World!"</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Change the text content</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">paragraph.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "New text content."</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(paragraph.innerHTML); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: "New text content."</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h4><code>innerHTML</code></h4>
<p>This property gets or sets the HTML content (markup) inside an element. When setting <code>innerHTML</code>, any existing HTML within the element is removed and replaced with the new HTML string. This allows for dynamic creation of new HTML elements within an existing one. However, using <code>innerHTML</code> with untrusted data can lead to security vulnerabilities.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// HTML structure: &lt;div id="myDiv"&gt;Old content&lt;/div&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> myDiv</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'myDiv'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(myDiv.innerHTML); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: "Old content"</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Change the HTML content</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">myDiv.innerHTML </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '&lt;h2&gt;New Heading&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;Some new text.&lt;/p&gt;'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(myDiv.textContent); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: "New HeadingSome new text."</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p><strong>Example of content modification:</strong>
Update a score display on a gaming website or dynamically generate a list of items.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;!</span><span style="color:#22863A">DOCTYPE</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> lang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> charset</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"UTF-8"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"viewport"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> content</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Content Modification Example&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"scoreDisplay"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Current Score: 0&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"itemList"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Existing Item 1&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> scoreElement</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'scoreDisplay'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> listElement</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'itemList'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Modify text content</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> score </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 100</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        scoreElement.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> `Current Score: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">score</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Modify inner HTML to add a new list item</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        listElement.innerHTML </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '&lt;li&gt;New Item from JS&lt;/li&gt;'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        listElement.innerHTML </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '&lt;li class="important"&gt;Another important item&lt;/li&gt;'</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Adding new element with class</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Modifying Attributes</h3>
<p>Elements often have attributes like <code>src</code> for images, <code>href</code> for links, <code>class</code> for styling, or <code>id</code> for unique identification. These can be manipulated using <code>element.attributeName</code> (for common attributes), <code>element.setAttribute()</code>, and <code>element.removeAttribute()</code>.</p>
<h4>Direct Property Access</h4>
<p>For many common attributes (like <code>id</code>, <code>class</code>, <code>src</code>, <code>href</code>, <code>value</code>, <code>style</code>), you can access and modify them directly as properties of the DOM element object.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// HTML structure: &lt;img id="myImage" src="old-image.jpg" alt="Old Image"&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">//                 &lt;a id="myLink" href="old-link.html"&gt;Click Me&lt;/a&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">//                 &lt;input id="myInput" type="text" value="Initial Value"&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> image</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'myImage'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> link</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'myLink'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> input</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'myInput'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Change src attribute</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">image.src </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'new-image.png'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Change alt attribute</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">image.alt </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'New Image Description'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Change href attribute</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">link.href </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'new-link.html'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Change value of an input</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">input.value </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'Updated Value'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Add/modify a class (using classList is often preferred for multiple classes)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">image.className </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'thumbnail active'</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Replaces all existing classes</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h4><code>element.setAttribute(name, value)</code></h4>
<p>This method sets the value of an attribute on the specified element. If the attribute already exists, its value is updated; otherwise, a new attribute is added. This is useful for custom attributes or when you need to be precise.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// HTML structure: &lt;button id="myButton"&gt;Click&lt;/button&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>

<h4><code>element.removeAttribute(name)</code></h4>
<p>This method removes an attribute with the specified <code>name</code> from the element.</p>

<h3>Modifying Styles</h3>
<p>Elements' visual styles can be changed directly through the <code>element.style</code> property or by manipulating their CSS classes using <code>element.classList</code>.</p>
<h4><code>element.style</code></h4>
<p>The <code>style</code> property allows direct access to the inline CSS styles of an element. Each CSS property is represented as a JavaScript property using camelCase (e.g., <code>background-color</code> becomes <code>backgroundColor</code>). These changes apply directly to the element's <code>style</code> attribute in the HTML.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// HTML structure: &lt;p id="styledParagraph"&gt;This text will be styled.&lt;/p&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> styledParagraph</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'styledParagraph'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Change background color</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">styledParagraph.style.backgroundColor </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'lightblue'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">styledParagraph.style.color </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'darkblue'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Change font size</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">styledParagraph.style.fontSize </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '20px'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Add margin</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">styledParagraph.style.margin </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '10px 0'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h4><code>element.classList</code></h4>
<p>Manipulating CSS classes is generally the preferred method for managing styles dynamically. <code>classList</code> is a read-only property that returns a <code>DOMTokenList</code> collection of the class attributes of the element. This collection provides methods for adding, removing, and toggling individual CSS classes. This approach separates concerns: JavaScript handles behavior, and CSS handles presentation.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>element.classList.add('className')</code>: Adds one or more classes to the element.</li>
<li><code>element.classList.remove('className')</code>: Removes one or more classes from the element.</li>
<li><code>element.classList.toggle('className')</code>: Toggles a class on or off. If the class is present, it's removed; if not, it's added.</li>
<li><code>element.classList.contains('className')</code>: Checks if the element has a specific class, returning <code>true</code> or <code>false</code>.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// CSS:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// .active { background-color: yellow; border: 1px solid orange; }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// .hidden { display: none; }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// HTML structure: &lt;div id="myBox" class="inactive"&gt;Hello&lt;/div&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> myBox</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'myBox'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Add a class</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">myBox.classList.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">add</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'active'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Now myBox has classes "inactive active"</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Remove a class</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">myBox.classList.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">remove</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'inactive'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Now myBox has class "active"</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Toggle a class (if 'hidden' is not present, it's added)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">myBox.classList.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toggle</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'hidden'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Check if a class is present</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> hasActive</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> myBox.classList.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">contains</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'active'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// true</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Style Modification Example&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">style</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .default-card</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> #ccc</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> statusMessage</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'statusMessage'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Direct style modification</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        itemCard.style.borderRadius </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '8px'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>

<span class="line"></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        itemCard.classList.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">add</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'highlighted-card'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Add highlighting</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        statusMessage.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'Item is now highlighted!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        statusMessage.classList.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">add</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'error-message'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Add a styling for the message</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Later, remove highlight and error message</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        setTimeout</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            itemCard.classList.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">remove</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'highlighted-card'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            statusMessage.classList.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">remove</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'error-message'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            statusMessage.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'Highlight removed.'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2000</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h2>Practical Examples and Demonstrations</h2>
<p>Let's consolidate the selection and modification techniques in a practical scenario: building a simple interactive to-do list.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"add-task-btn"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Add Task&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Select elements using IDs and query selectors</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> newTaskInput</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">querySelector</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'#new-task-input'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> addTaskBtn</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'add-task-btn'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>

<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Function to add a new task</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> addTask</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (taskText </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> ''</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">                alert</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Task cannot be empty!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">                return</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Stop if input is empty</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            // Create a new list item element</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> listItem</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">createElement</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'li'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Creating new elements is a future topic, but used here for completeness.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">                                                           // For this lesson, focus on the modification parts.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            // Set the innerHTML of the new list item</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            listItem.innerHTML </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> `</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">                &lt;span&gt;${</span><span style="color:#24292E">taskText</span><span style="color:#032F62">}&lt;/span&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">                &lt;div&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">                    &lt;button class="complete-btn"&gt;Complete&lt;/button&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">                    &lt;button class="delete-btn"&gt;Delete&lt;/button&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">                &lt;/div&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">            `</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            // Append the new list item to the task list</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            taskList.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">appendChild</span><span style="color:#24292E">(listItem); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Appending elements is a future topic.</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            // Clear the input field after adding the task</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            newTaskInput.value </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> ''</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            // Get the dynamically created buttons (using querySelector on the listItem itself)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> completeButton</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> listItem.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">querySelector</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'.complete-btn'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> deleteButton</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> listItem.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">querySelector</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'.delete-btn'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            // Add functionality to the 'Complete' button</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            completeButton.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">onclick</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> function</span><span style="color:#24292E">() { </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Using onclick for simplicity, event listeners are a future topic</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                listItem.classList.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toggle</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'completed'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Toggle the 'completed' class</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">                if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (listItem.classList.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">contains</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'completed'</span><span style="color:#24292E">)) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                    completeButton.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'Undo'</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Change button text</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                    completeButton.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'Complete'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            // Add functionality to the 'Delete' button</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            deleteButton.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">onclick</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> function</span><span style="color:#24292E">() { </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Using onclick for simplicity</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                taskList.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">removeChild</span><span style="color:#24292E">(listItem); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Removing elements is a future topic</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            };</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Add task when the button is clicked (event handling is a future topic)</span></span>

<span class="line"></span>
