<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Initialize existing tasks with functionality</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> existingTasks</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">querySelectorAll</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'#task-list li'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        existingTasks.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">forEach</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">task</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> span</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> task.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">querySelector</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'span'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            // Check if there are already buttons, if not, add them</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">task.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">querySelector</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'.complete-btn'</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&amp;&amp;</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> !</span><span style="color:#24292E">task.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">querySelector</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'.delete-btn'</span><span style="color:#24292E">)) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">                const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> div</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">createElement</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'div'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                div.innerHTML </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> `</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">                    &lt;button class="complete-btn"&gt;Complete&lt;/button&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">                    &lt;button class="delete-btn"&gt;Delete&lt;/button&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">                `</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                task.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">appendChild</span><span style="color:#24292E">(div);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> completeButton</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> task.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">querySelector</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'.complete-btn'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> deleteButton</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> task.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">querySelector</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'.delete-btn'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            // Set initial button text based on 'completed' class</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (task.classList.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">contains</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'completed'</span><span style="color:#24292E">)) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                completeButton.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'Undo'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                completeButton.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'Complete'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            completeButton.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">onclick</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> function</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                task.classList.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toggle</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'completed'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">                if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (task.classList.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">contains</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'completed'</span><span style="color:#24292E">)) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                    completeButton.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'Undo'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                    completeButton.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'Complete'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            deleteButton.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">onclick</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> function</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                taskList.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">removeChild</span><span style="color:#24292E">(task);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            };</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This example demonstrates:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Selecting elements</strong>: <code>querySelector</code> and <code>getElementById</code> to get the input, button, and <code>&lt;ul&gt;</code>. <code>querySelectorAll</code> to get all <code>&lt;li&gt;</code> elements initially.</li>
<li><strong>Modifying content</strong>: Setting <code>newTaskInput.value = ''</code> to clear the input. Setting <code>listItem.innerHTML</code> to add new text and buttons within the list item. Updating <code>completeButton.textContent</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Modifying attributes/styles</strong>: <code>listItem.classList.toggle('completed')</code> to apply or remove the <code>completed</code> CSS class, which changes the visual style (text-decoration and color).</li>
</ul>
<h2>Exercises and Practice Activities</h2>
<p>Practice these exercises to solidify your understanding of selecting and modifying DOM elements.</p>
<h3>Exercise 1: Update Page Title and Header</h3>
<p><strong>Goal:</strong> Select an element by ID and another by tag name, then modify their <code>textContent</code>.</p>
<ol>
<li>Create an HTML file with an <code>&lt;h1&gt;</code> tag with the ID <code>page-title</code> and a <code>&lt;h2&gt;</code> tag below it.</li>
<li>Using <code>document.getElementById()</code>, select the <code>&lt;h1&gt;</code> element and change its <code>textContent</code> to "My Dynamic Webpage".</li>
<li>Using <code>document.querySelector()</code>, select the <code>&lt;h2&gt;</code> element and change its <code>textContent</code> to "Welcome to the new content!".</li>
<li>Add a <code>console.log()</code> to display the new text of both elements after modification.</li>
</ol>
<h3>Exercise 2: Highlight List Items</h3>
<p><strong>Goal:</strong> Select multiple elements by class name and modify their style using <code>classList</code>.</p>
<ol>
<li>Create an unordered list (<code>&lt;ul&gt;</code>) with several list items (<code>&lt;li&gt;</code>).</li>
<li>Give three of the list items the class <code>important</code>.</li>
<li>Using <code>document.querySelectorAll()</code>, select all elements with the class <code>important</code>.</li>
<li>Iterate through the selected elements and use <code>classList.add('highlight')</code> to add a new class called <code>highlight</code> to each.</li>
<li>In your CSS, define the <code>.highlight</code> class to give the text a yellow background and bold font.</li>
</ol>
<h3>Exercise 3: Image and Link Changer</h3>
<p><strong>Goal:</strong> Select elements and modify their attributes (<code>src</code>, <code>alt</code>, <code>href</code>).</p>
<ol>
<li>Create an HTML file containing an <code>&lt;img&gt;</code> tag with an <code>id="main-image"</code> and a <code>&lt;a&gt;</code> tag with an <code>id="more-info-link"</code>.</li>
<li>Initially, set <code>src="placeholder.png"</code> and <code>alt="Placeholder Image"</code> for the image, and <code>href="old-link.html"</code> for the link.</li>
<li>Using JavaScript:
<ul>
<li>Select the image by its ID. Change its <code>src</code> to "new-image.jpg" and <code>alt</code> to "Beautiful Scenery".</li>
<li>Select the link by its ID. Change its <code>href</code> to "new-info.html" and its <code>textContent</code> to "View New Information".</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Verify in the browser's developer tools that the attributes and content have changed.</li>
</ol>
  
</div>

<div id="chapter-3.4">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Event Handling: Responding to User Interactions</h1><p>Web applications constantly react to user actions, such as clicks, key presses, or form submissions. This responsiveness is achieved through <em>event handling</em> in JavaScript. Events are signals that something has occurred in the browser, and event handling is the mechanism to detect these signals and execute specific code in response.</p>
<h2>Understanding Events and the Event Object</h2>
<p>An <em>event</em> represents a moment when a user interacts with an HTML element or when the browser itself performs an action. Common events include:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>click</code>: When a mouse button is pressed and released on an element.</li>
<li><code>mouseover</code>: When the mouse pointer enters an element's area.</li>
<li><code>mouseout</code>: When the mouse pointer leaves an element's area.</li>
<li><code>keydown</code>: When a keyboard key is pressed down.</li>
<li><code>keyup</code>: When a keyboard key is released.</li>
<li><code>submit</code>: When a form is submitted.</li>
<li><code>load</code>: When a page or an image has finished loading.</li>
</ul>
<p>When an event occurs, the browser creates an <em>Event object</em> that contains detailed information about the event. This object is automatically passed as an argument to the event handler function. Properties of the Event object vary depending on the event type but commonly include:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>target</code>: The HTML element that triggered the event.</li>
<li><code>type</code>: A string indicating the type of event (e.g., "click", "keydown").</li>
<li><code>clientX</code>, <code>clientY</code>: The horizontal and vertical coordinates of the mouse pointer relative to the browser window (for mouse events).</li>
<li><code>key</code>: The value of the key pressed (for keyboard events).</li>
<li><code>preventDefault()</code>: A method to stop the browser's default action for a given event (e.g., preventing a link from navigating, or a form from submitting).</li>
<li><code>stopPropagation()</code>: A method to stop the event from bubbling up the DOM tree (covered in advanced event topics).</li>
</ul>
<h3>Example: The Click Event</h3>
<p>Consider a simple button. When a user clicks it, we want something to happen.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;!</span><span style="color:#22863A">DOCTYPE</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> lang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> charset</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"UTF-8"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"viewport"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> content</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Event Handling Example&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"myButton"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Click Me&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"message"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Select the button element using its ID</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> button</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'myButton'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Select the paragraph element</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> messageParagraph</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'message'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Define a function that will be executed when the button is clicked</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleClick</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">event</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            // The 'event' object is automatically passed to this function</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Button clicked!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Event type:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, event.type); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// "click"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Target element:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, event.target); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// The button element itself</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            messageParagraph.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "You clicked the button!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Attach the handleClick function as an event listener for the 'click' event</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        button.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">addEventListener</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'click'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, handleClick);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this example, <code>handleClick</code> is the event handler. When the <code>click</code> event occurs on <code>myButton</code>, <code>handleClick</code> is executed, and the <code>event</code> object provides context about the click.</p>
<h3>Example: Keyboard Events</h3>
<p>Keyboard events allow web applications to react to user input from the keyboard. The <code>keydown</code> event fires when a key is pressed down, and <code>keyup</code> fires when a key is released. The <code>event.key</code> property provides the actual character or key name.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;!</span><span style="color:#22863A">DOCTYPE</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> lang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> charset</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"UTF-8"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"viewport"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> content</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Keyboard Event Example&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"text"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"myInput"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> placeholder</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Type something..."</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"keyDisplay"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> myInput</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'myInput'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> keyDisplay</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'keyDisplay'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleKeydown</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">event</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            // Log information about the key pressed</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Key pressed:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, event.key);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Key code (deprecated but common):"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, event.keyCode); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// For historical context, prefer event.key</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            // Display the key pressed in the paragraph</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            keyDisplay.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> `Last key pressed: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">event</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#24292E">key</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            // Example: Prevent default behavior for the 'Space' key</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (event.key </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> ' '</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">                // event.preventDefault();</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // Uncomment to stop space from appearing in input</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Spacebar pressed!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Add an event listener for the 'keydown' event</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        myInput.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">addEventListener</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'keydown'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, handleKeydown);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Here, <code>event.key</code> is used to identify which key was pressed. <code>preventDefault()</code> is shown as an option to override the browser's default actions, such as typing a character into an input field or navigating when an anchor tag is clicked.</p>
<h2>Attaching Event Listeners</h2>
<p>There are several ways to attach event listeners to elements, but the most modern and recommended approach is <code>addEventListener()</code>.</p>
<h3><code>element.addEventListener(eventType, handlerFunction, options)</code></h3>
<p>This is the preferred method for attaching event handlers because it offers flexibility and avoids overwriting existing event handlers.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>eventType</code>: A string representing the type of event to listen for (e.g., <code>'click'</code>, <code>'mouseover'</code>, <code>'submit'</code>). <em>Do not prefix with "on"</em>.</li>
<li><code>handlerFunction</code>: The function to be executed when the event occurs. This function automatically receives the <code>Event</code> object as its first argument.</li>
<li><code>options</code> (optional): An object that can specify characteristics of the listener. Common options include:
<ul>
<li><code>capture</code>: A boolean indicating whether the listener should be invoked in the capturing phase (rarely used for basic event handling).</li>
<li><code>once</code>: A boolean indicating that the listener should be invoked at most once after being added. If <code>true</code>, the listener is automatically removed after it's invoked.</li>
<li><code>passive</code>: A boolean indicating that the listener will never call <code>preventDefault()</code>. This can improve scrolling performance on some devices.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Example with <code>addEventListener</code>:</strong></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> myElement</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'someElement'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Method 1: Define function separately</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> sayHello</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Hello from myElement!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">myElement.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">addEventListener</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'click'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, sayHello);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Method 2: Use an anonymous function (or arrow function) directly</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">myElement.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">addEventListener</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'mouseover'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Mouse is over myElement!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Method 3: Use an arrow function for conciseness</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">myElement.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">addEventListener</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'mouseout'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Mouse left myElement!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Example with options - listener fires only once</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> oneTimeButton</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'oneTimeBtn'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">oneTimeButton.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">addEventListener</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'click'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"This message will only appear once."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}, { once: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">true</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Removing Event Listeners: <code>removeEventListener()</code></h3>
<p>It is good practice to remove event listeners when they are no longer needed, especially in single-page applications where elements might be added and removed dynamically. This prevents memory leaks and unintended behavior.</p>
<p><code>element.removeEventListener(eventType, handlerFunction, options)</code></p>
<p>It's crucial that the <code>handlerFunction</code> passed to <code>removeEventListener</code> is the <em>exact same function reference</em> that was passed to <code>addEventListener</code>. This means you cannot use anonymous functions directly with <code>removeEventListener</code> if you intend to remove them later, as each anonymous function is a new reference.</p>
<p><strong>Example of removing an event listener:</strong></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;!</span><span style="color:#22863A">DOCTYPE</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> lang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> charset</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"UTF-8"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"viewport"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> content</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Remove Event Listener Example&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"toggleButton"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Toggle Message&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"removeListenerBtn"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Remove Listener&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"dynamicMessage"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> toggleButton</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'toggleButton'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> removeListenerBtn</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'removeListenerBtn'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> dynamicMessage</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'dynamicMessage'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Define a named function for the event handler</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> displayToggleMessage</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (dynamicMessage.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> ""</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                dynamicMessage.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Message is now visible!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                dynamicMessage.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> ""</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Toggle button clicked!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Add the listener</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        toggleButton.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">addEventListener</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'click'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, displayToggleMessage);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Remove the listener when the 'Remove Listener' button is clicked</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        removeListenerBtn.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">addEventListener</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'click'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            toggleButton.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">removeEventListener</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'click'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, displayToggleMessage);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Listener removed for Toggle Button."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            dynamicMessage.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Toggle button listener is removed."</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Notice that <code>displayToggleMessage</code> is a named function, allowing us to reference it for both adding and removing the listener.</p>
<h3>Older Methods (Avoid for new code)</h3>
<p>While <code>addEventListener</code> is the modern standard, you might encounter older methods in existing codebases:</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>HTML Event Attributes:</strong> Directly embedding JavaScript in HTML attributes.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onclick</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">alert</span><span style="color:#032F62">('Hello!')"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Click Me&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This mixes structure (HTML) with behavior (JavaScript), making code harder to maintain and less flexible. It also only allows one handler per event.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>DOM Property <code>onevent</code>:</strong> Assigning a function directly to an element's <code>onevent</code> property.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> myButton</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'myButton'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">myButton.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">onclick</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> function</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Clicked using DOM property!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">};</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// This will overwrite the previous handler if you assign another one</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">myButton.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">onclick</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> function</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"This will be the only handler for click!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">};</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This approach also only allows one handler per event type for a given element, as assigning a new function overwrites the previous one. <code>addEventListener</code> is superior because it allows multiple handlers for the same event type on the same element.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2>Event Handling in Forms</h2>
<p>Forms are a critical area for event handling. The <code>submit</code> event, in particular, is important. When a form is submitted, the browser typically attempts to navigate to the URL specified in the form's <code>action</code> attribute. Often, we want to prevent this default behavior to handle the form data with JavaScript (e.g., sending it via an API call).</p>
<h3>Preventing Default Form Submission</h3>
<p>The <code>event.preventDefault()</code> method is essential here.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;!</span><span style="color:#22863A">DOCTYPE</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> lang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> charset</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"UTF-8"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"viewport"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> content</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Form Event Handling&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">form</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"myForm"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> for</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"username"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Username:&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"text"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"username"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"username"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> required</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">br</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> for</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"email"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Email:&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"email"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"email"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"email"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> required</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">br</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"submit"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Submit&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">form</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"formOutput"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> myForm</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'myForm'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> usernameInput</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'username'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> emailInput</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'email'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> formOutput</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'formOutput'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        myForm.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">addEventListener</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'submit'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">event</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            // Prevent the default form submission behavior (page reload)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            event.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">preventDefault</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            // Access form input values</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> username</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> usernameInput.value;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> email</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> emailInput.value;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            // Perform some validation or data processing</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (username </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> ""</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> ||</span><span style="color:#24292E"> email </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> ""</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                formOutput.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Please fill in all fields."</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                formOutput.style.color </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'red'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">                // In a real application, you would typically send this data to a server</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Form Submitted!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Username:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, username);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Email:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, email);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                formOutput.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> `Thank you, ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">username</span><span style="color:#032F62">}! Your email (${</span><span style="color:#24292E">email</span><span style="color:#032F62">}) has been received.`</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                formOutput.style.color </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'green'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">                // Optionally clear the form</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                myForm.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">reset</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this example, <code>event.preventDefault()</code> stops the browser from reloading the page after form submission. This allows JavaScript to take control, process the input, and then decide what to do next (e.g., display a success message or send data asynchronously).</p>
<h2>Practical Examples and Demonstrations</h2>
<p>Let's integrate event handling with DOM manipulation, building on concepts from the previous lesson.</p>
<h3>Interactive Image Gallery</h3>
<p>Create a simple image gallery where clicking a thumbnail displays a larger version of the image.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">img</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> src</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"https://via.placeholder.com/100x100/FF5733/FFFFFF?text=Img1"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> data-fullsrc</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"https://via.placeholder.com/600x400/FF5733/FFFFFF?text=Image+1"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> data-caption</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Caption for Image 1"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> alt</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Thumbnail 1"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"thumbnail-item"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">img</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> src</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"https://via.placeholder.com/100x100/33FF57/FFFFFF?text=Img2"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> data-fullsrc</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"https://via.placeholder.com/600x400/33FF57/FFFFFF?text=Image+2"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> data-caption</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Caption for Image 2"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> alt</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Thumbnail 2"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"thumbnail-item"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">img</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> src</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"https://via.placeholder.com/100x100/3357FF/FFFFFF?text=Img3"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> data-fullsrc</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"https://via.placeholder.com/600x400/3357FF/FFFFFF?text=Image+3"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> data-caption</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Caption for Image 3"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> alt</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Thumbnail 3"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"thumbnail-item"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">img</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> src</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"https://via.placeholder.com/100x100/FF33D4/FFFFFF?text=Img4"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> data-fullsrc</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"https://via.placeholder.com/600x400/FF33D4/FFFFFF?text=Image+4"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> data-caption</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Caption for Image 4"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> alt</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Thumbnail 4"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> displayImage</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'displayImage'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> imageCaption</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'imageCaption'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> thumbnailsContainer</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">querySelector</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'.thumbnails'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> thumbnailItems</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">querySelectorAll</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'.thumbnail-item'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Function to handle thumbnail clicks</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleThumbnailClick</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">event</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            // Get the clicked image element (the actual &lt;img&gt; tag)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> clickedThumbnail</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> event.target;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            // Ensure the clicked element is an &lt;img&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (clickedThumbnail.tagName </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'IMG'</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">                // Get the full image source and caption from data attributes</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">                const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> fullSrc</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> clickedThumbnail.dataset.fullsrc;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">                const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> caption</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> clickedThumbnail.dataset.caption;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">                // Update the main display image and its caption</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                displayImage.src </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> fullSrc;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                displayImage.alt </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> caption; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Update alt text for accessibility</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                imageCaption.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> caption;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">                // Remove 'active' class from all thumbnails</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                thumbnailItems.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">forEach</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">item</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                    item.classList.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">remove</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'active'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">                // Add 'active' class to the parent of the clicked thumbnail</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                clickedThumbnail.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">closest</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'.thumbnail-item'</span><span style="color:#24292E">).classList.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">add</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'active'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Attach a single click listener to the thumbnails container</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // This leverages event delegation (a more advanced concept, but practical here)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // For simpler cases, you could loop through each thumbnail and add a listener</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        thumbnailsContainer.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">addEventListener</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'click'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, handleThumbnailClick);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This example uses <code>data-</code> attributes to store information about the full-size image and its caption directly on the thumbnail <code>&lt;img&gt;</code> elements. When a thumbnail is clicked, the <code>handleThumbnailClick</code> function:</p>
<ol>
<li>Retrieves the <code>event.target</code> to identify the specific thumbnail clicked.</li>
<li>Extracts the <code>data-fullsrc</code> and <code>data-caption</code> values.</li>
<li>Updates the <code>src</code> and <code>alt</code> attributes of the main <code>displayImage</code> and the <code>textContent</code> of the <code>imageCaption</code> paragraph.</li>
<li>Manages an <code>active</code> class to visually highlight the currently selected thumbnail using CSS.</li>
</ol>
<h3>Dynamic Counter</h3>
<p>Create a simple counter that increments, decrements, and resets based on button clicks.</p>
