<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Dynamic Counter&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">style</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">        body</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">font-family</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">sans-serif</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#005CC5">display</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#005CC5">flex-direction</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">column</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#005CC5">align-items</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">center</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#005CC5">margin-top</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">50</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">; }</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">30</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            border-radius</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">8</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            box-shadow</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 4</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 8</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> rgba</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0.1</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        #countDisplay</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        .buttons</span><span style="color:#22863A"> button</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            padding</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 20</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            margin</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 10</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            border</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">none</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            border-radius</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">5</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            cursor</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">pointer</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">            transition</span><span style="color:#24292E">: background-color </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0.3</span><span style="color:#D73A49">s</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> ease</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        #decreaseBtn</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#dc3545</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#005CC5">color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">white</span><span style="color:#24292E">; }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        #decreaseBtn:hover</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#c82333</span><span style="color:#24292E">; }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        #resetBtn</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#ffc107</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#005CC5">color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#212529</span><span style="color:#24292E">; }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        #resetBtn:hover</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#e0a800</span><span style="color:#24292E">; }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        #increaseBtn</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#28a745</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#005CC5">color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">white</span><span style="color:#24292E">; }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        #increaseBtn:hover</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#218838</span><span style="color:#24292E">; }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">style</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"counter-container"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Simple Counter&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"countDisplay"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;0&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"buttons"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"decreaseBtn"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Decrease&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"resetBtn"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Reset&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"increaseBtn"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Increase&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> countDisplay</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'countDisplay'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> decreaseBtn</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'decreaseBtn'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> resetBtn</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'resetBtn'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> increaseBtn</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'increaseBtn'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> count </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Initialize counter variable</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Function to update the display</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> updateDisplay</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            countDisplay.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> count;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Event listener for increase button</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        increaseBtn.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">addEventListener</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'click'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            count</span><span style="color:#D73A49">++</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Increment the count</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">            updateDisplay</span><span style="color:#24292E">(); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Update the UI</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Event listener for decrease button</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        decreaseBtn.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">addEventListener</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'click'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            count</span><span style="color:#D73A49">--</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Decrement the count</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">            updateDisplay</span><span style="color:#24292E">(); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Update the UI</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Event listener for reset button</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        resetBtn.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">addEventListener</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'click'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            count </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Reset count to 0</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">            updateDisplay</span><span style="color:#24292E">(); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Update the UI</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Initial display update</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        updateDisplay</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This example demonstrates how JavaScript variables (<code>count</code>) can be updated by event handlers, and how those changes are reflected in the DOM by modifying <code>textContent</code>. Each button has its own click listener to perform a specific action, showcasing independent event handling.</p>
<h2>Exercises</h2>
<p>These exercises build on the concepts and examples presented, encouraging hands-on practice.</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Change Background Color on Hover:</strong>
Create an HTML page with a <code>&lt;div&gt;</code> element. Add an event listener to this <code>&lt;div&gt;</code> so that its background color changes to a different color (e.g., light blue) when the mouse pointer enters the <code>&lt;div&gt;</code> (<code>mouseover</code> event) and reverts to its original color (e.g., white) when the mouse pointer leaves (<code>mouseout</code> event).</p>
<p><em>Hint: You'll need to select the <code>&lt;div&gt;</code> and attach two different event listeners.</em></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Toggle Visibility:</strong>
Create an HTML page with a button and a paragraph of text. When the button is clicked, the paragraph should toggle its visibility (if visible, hide it; if hidden, show it).</p>
<p><em>Hint: You can toggle a CSS <code>display</code> property (e.g., <code>block</code> vs. <code>none</code>) or add/remove a CSS class that sets <code>display: none;</code>.</em></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Basic Character Count for Textarea:</strong>
Create an HTML page with a <code>&lt;textarea&gt;</code> and a <code>&lt;p&gt;</code> tag. Add an event listener to the <code>&lt;textarea&gt;</code> that updates the <code>&lt;p&gt;</code> tag with the current character count as the user types (<code>input</code> event).</p>
<p><em>Hint: The <code>input</code> event fires whenever the value of an <code>&lt;input&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;textarea&gt;</code>, or <code>&lt;select&gt;</code> element changes. You can access the current value using <code>event.target.value.length</code>.</em></p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2>Real-World Application</h2>
<p>Event handling is fundamental to virtually all interactive web applications.</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Online Shopping Cart:</strong> When a user clicks an "Add to Cart" button, an event handler captures this click. The handler then takes the product information (often stored as <code>data-</code> attributes on the button or within its parent elements), updates a JavaScript array representing the cart, and then dynamically modifies the DOM to show the new item count or a list of items in the cart without a full page reload. This same principle applies when a user clicks a "Remove from Cart" button or updates a quantity.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Interactive Dashboards/Data Visualizations:</strong> Many modern dashboards use JavaScript to make data interactive. Clicking on a bar in a bar chart might trigger an event handler that filters other data displays on the page, showing only details related to that specific bar. Hovering over a data point could display a tooltip with more information, driven by <code>mouseover</code> and <code>mouseout</code> events. All these interactions provide immediate feedback and allow users to explore data dynamically.</p>
</li>
</ol>
  
</div>

<div id="chapter-3.5">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Basic JavaScript Functions and Scope</h1><p>Functions are blocks of code designed to perform a particular task. They allow you to organize code, make it more reusable, and improve readability. Defining a function involves giving it a name and specifying the operations it should perform. When a function is called, the code inside its block executes.</p>
<h2>Defining and Calling Functions</h2>
<p>Functions are defined using the <code>function</code> keyword, followed by a name, a list of parameters enclosed in parentheses, and a block of code enclosed in curly braces. Parameters are placeholders for values that will be passed into the function when it is called.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Function definition</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> greetUser</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Hello, welcome!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Code inside the function</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Calling the function</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">greetUser</span><span style="color:#24292E">(); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Executes the code block above</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Functions can also accept parameters, which are values passed into the function to customize its behavior. These parameters act like local variables within the function.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> greetWithName</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">name</span><span style="color:#24292E">) { </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 'name' is a parameter</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Hello, "</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#24292E"> name </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">greetWithName</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Alice"</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Passes "Alice" as the 'name' argument</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">greetWithName</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Bob"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);   </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Passes "Bob" as the 'name' argument</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Functions can return a value using the <code>return</code> keyword. When <code>return</code> is encountered, the function immediately stops execution and sends the specified value back to the caller.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> addNumbers</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">num1</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">num2</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> sum </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> num1 </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#24292E"> num2;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> sum; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Returns the calculated sum</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> result </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> addNumbers</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">5</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Calls the function and stores the returned value</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(result); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: 8</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">addNumbers</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">20</span><span style="color:#24292E">)); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: 30</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Function Expressions and Arrow Functions</h3>
<p>Beyond the traditional function declaration, JavaScript offers other ways to define functions, which are commonly used in modern web development.</p>
<p>A <strong>function expression</strong> defines a function inside an expression. This function can be anonymous (without a name) and is often assigned to a variable.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Function expression</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> multiply</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> function</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">b</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> a </span><span style="color:#D73A49">*</span><span style="color:#24292E"> b;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">};</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">multiply</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">4</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">)); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: 8</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p><strong>Arrow functions</strong> provide a more concise syntax for writing function expressions, especially for simple functions. They are frequently used in callbacks and situations where a shorter function definition is desirable.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Arrow function with a single expression (implicit return)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> subtract</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#E36209">x</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">y</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> x </span><span style="color:#D73A49">-</span><span style="color:#24292E"> y;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">subtract</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">4</span><span style="color:#24292E">)); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: 6</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Arrow function with multiple statements (explicit return)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> calculateArea</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#E36209">width</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">height</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> area</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> width </span><span style="color:#D73A49">*</span><span style="color:#24292E"> height;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> area;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">};</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">calculateArea</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">5</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">7</span><span style="color:#24292E">)); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: 35</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Arrow functions change how <code>this</code> keyword behaves compared to regular functions, but <code>this</code> is a more advanced topic for later. For now, focus on their concise syntax.</p>
<h2>Understanding Scope</h2>
<p>Scope in JavaScript determines the accessibility of variables and other resources in different parts of your code. It dictates where a variable can be used and where it cannot. Understanding scope is crucial for writing predictable and maintainable code.</p>
<p>There are primarily two types of scope: <strong>global scope</strong> and <strong>local scope</strong>.</p>
<h3>Global Scope</h3>
<p>A variable declared in the global scope (outside of any function or block) is accessible from anywhere in the JavaScript code, including within functions.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> globalVariable </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "I am global"</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Declared in global scope</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> showGlobal</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(globalVariable); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Accessible inside the function</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">showGlobal</span><span style="color:#24292E">(); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: I am global</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(globalVariable); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Accessible outside the function too</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>While global variables can seem convenient, relying too heavily on them can lead to naming conflicts and make code harder to debug, especially in larger applications.</p>
<h3>Local Scope (Function Scope and Block Scope)</h3>
<p>Variables declared inside a function have <strong>function scope</strong>. This means they are only accessible from within that function and cannot be accessed from outside it. Each function creates its own local scope.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> calculateSum</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">b</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> result </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> a </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#24292E"> b; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 'result' has function scope</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Inside function:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, result);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> result;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">calculateSum</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">5</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: Inside function: 15</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// console.log("Outside function:", result);</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // This would cause an error: result is not defined</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>With the introduction of <code>let</code> and <code>const</code> (which we covered in <em>Variables, Operators, and Control Flow in JavaScript</em>), JavaScript also has <strong>block scope</strong>. A block is any code within curly braces <code>{}</code>. Variables declared with <code>let</code> or <code>const</code> inside a block are only accessible within that block.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">true</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> blockScopedVariable </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "I am block scoped"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(blockScopedVariable); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Accessible inside the if block</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// console.log(blockScopedVariable);</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // This would cause an error: blockScopedVariable is not defined</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">for</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> i </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">; i </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 3</span><span style="color:#24292E">; i</span><span style="color:#D73A49">++</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(i); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 'i' is only accessible within this loop block</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// console.log(i);</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // Error: i is not defined</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Variables declared with <code>var</code> do <em>not</em> have block scope; they only have function scope or global scope. This is one of the primary reasons <code>let</code> and <code>const</code> are preferred in modern JavaScript.</p>
<h3>Scope Chain</h3>
<p>When a variable is accessed, JavaScript looks for it in the current scope. If it's not found there, it moves up to the parent scope, and then to its parent, and so on, until it reaches the global scope. This hierarchy is called the <strong>scope chain</strong>.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> outerVar </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Outer"</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Global scope</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> outerFunction</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> middleVar </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Middle"</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// outerFunction's scope</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> innerFunction</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> innerVar </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Inner"</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// innerFunction's scope</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(innerVar);    </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Accessible here</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(middleVar);   </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Accessible from parent scope</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(outerVar);    </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Accessible from global scope</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">  innerFunction</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // console.log(innerVar);</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // Error: innerVar is not defined (out of innerFunction's scope)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">outerFunction</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// console.log(middleVar);</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // Error: middleVar is not defined (out of outerFunction's scope)</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This demonstrates how inner functions have access to variables declared in their outer (lexical) environment.</p>
<h2>Practical Examples and Demonstrations</h2>
<p>Let's look at more complex scenarios to solidify your understanding of functions and scope.</p>
<h3>Example 1: Calculating Discounted Price</h3>
<p>Consider an e-commerce scenario where you need to calculate the final price of a product after applying a discount.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> TAX_RATE</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0.08</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Global constant for tax rate</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> calculateFinalPrice</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">originalPrice</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">discountPercentage</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // Input validation for robustness</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (originalPrice </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&lt;=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> ||</span><span style="color:#24292E"> discountPercentage </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> ||</span><span style="color:#24292E"> discountPercentage </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&gt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 100</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Invalid input for price or discount."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    return</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> null</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Return null to indicate an error</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> discountAmount</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> originalPrice </span><span style="color:#D73A49">*</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (discountPercentage </span><span style="color:#D73A49">/</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 100</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> priceAfterDiscount</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> originalPrice </span><span style="color:#D73A49">-</span><span style="color:#24292E"> discountAmount;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> priceWithTax</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> priceAfterDiscount </span><span style="color:#D73A49">*</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> TAX_RATE</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Uses global TAX_RATE</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> priceWithTax.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toFixed</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Formats to two decimal places</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> productA_price </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 120</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> productA_discount </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 15</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> finalPriceA </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> calculateFinalPrice</span><span style="color:#24292E">(productA_price, productA_discount);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Product A final price: $${</span><span style="color:#24292E">finalPriceA</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: Product A final price: $110.16</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> productB_price </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 50</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> productB_discount </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 5</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> finalPriceB </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> calculateFinalPrice</span><span style="color:#24292E">(productB_price, productB_discount);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Product B final price: $${</span><span style="color:#24292E">finalPriceB</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: Product B final price: $52.70</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Attempting to access local variables will fail</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// console.log(discountAmount);</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // Error: discountAmount is not defined</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this example:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>TAX_RATE</code> is a global constant, accessible anywhere.</li>
<li><code>calculateFinalPrice</code> is a function that takes <code>originalPrice</code> and <code>discountPercentage</code> as parameters.</li>
<li><code>discountAmount</code>, <code>priceAfterDiscount</code>, and <code>priceWithTax</code> are local variables within <code>calculateFinalPrice</code>. They are created each time the function is called and destroyed when the function finishes.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Example 2: Event Handling with Anonymous Functions</h3>
<p>In the previous lesson <em>Event Handling: Responding to User Interactions</em>, you learned about adding event listeners. Anonymous functions and arrow functions are commonly used for event callback functions because they are defined and used in place.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">&lt;!-- index.html (example snippet) --&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"myButton"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Click Me&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"message"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// script.js</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> myButton</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'myButton'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> messageParagraph</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'message'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> clickCount </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Global variable to track clicks</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">myButton.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">addEventListener</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'click'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#24292E">() { </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Anonymous function expression as event handler</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  clickCount</span><span style="color:#D73A49">++</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Accesses and modifies the global clickCount</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  messageParagraph.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> `Button clicked ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">clickCount</span><span style="color:#032F62">} times!`</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> buttonText </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> myButton.textContent; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Local variable within this handler</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`User clicked the '${</span><span style="color:#24292E">buttonText</span><span style="color:#032F62">}' button.`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Another example using an arrow function</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">addEventListener</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'keydown'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, (</span><span style="color:#E36209">event</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Arrow function as event handler</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (event.key </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'Enter'</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Enter key was pressed globally."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // event is a local parameter</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // clickCount is still accessible here due to global scope</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Here, <code>clickCount</code> is in the global scope and is modified by the event listener. <code>buttonText</code> is a local variable within the <code>click</code> event handler function, only accessible there. The <code>event</code> object in the <code>keydown</code> listener is a parameter, making it local to that specific arrow function.</p>
