<div id="chapter-4">

<div id="chapter-4.1">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Working with Arrays and Objects in JavaScript</h1><p>JavaScript arrays and objects are fundamental data structures used to store and organize information. Arrays store ordered collections of data, while objects store unordered collections of key-value pairs. Understanding how to effectively work with both is crucial for managing data in any web application.</p>
<h2>Working with Arrays</h2>
<p>Arrays are ordered lists of values. Each value in an array is called an element, and each element has a numerical index starting from 0.</p>
<h3>Creating Arrays</h3>
<p>Arrays can be created using array literal notation or the <code>Array()</code> constructor. The literal notation is generally preferred for its conciseness.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Array literal notation (preferred)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> colors</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#032F62">"red"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"green"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"blue"</span><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Using the Array() constructor</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> numbers</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> Array</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">4</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">5</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// An empty array</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> emptyArray</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [];</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Accessing Array Elements</h3>
<p>Elements in an array are accessed using their index, enclosed in square brackets.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> fruits</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#032F62">"apple"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"banana"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"cherry"</span><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(fruits[</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">]); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: "apple"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(fruits[</span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">]); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: "banana"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(fruits[</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">]); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: "cherry"</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Accessing an out-of-bounds index returns undefined</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(fruits[</span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#24292E">]); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: undefined</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Modifying Array Elements</h3>
<p>Array elements can be modified by assigning a new value to a specific index.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> animals</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#032F62">"cat"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"dog"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"bird"</span><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(animals); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: ["cat", "dog", "bird"]</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">animals[</span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "fish"</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Change the second element</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(animals); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: ["cat", "fish", "bird"]</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Array Properties and Methods</h3>
<p>Arrays come with several built-in properties and methods for managing their content.</p>
<h4><code>length</code> Property</h4>
<p>The <code>length</code> property returns the number of elements in an array.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> products</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#032F62">"laptop"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"mouse"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"keyboard"</span><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(products.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">length</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: 3</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Changing the length property can modify the array</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">products.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">length</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 2</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(products); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: ["laptop", "mouse"]</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">products.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">length</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 5</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Adds empty slots</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(products); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: ["laptop", "mouse", undefined, undefined, undefined]</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h4>Adding and Removing Elements</h4>
<ul>
<li><strong><code>push()</code></strong>: Adds one or more elements to the end of an array and returns the new length.</li>
<li><strong><code>pop()</code></strong>: Removes the last element from an array and returns that element.</li>
<li><strong><code>unshift()</code></strong>: Adds one or more elements to the beginning of an array and returns the new length.</li>
<li><strong><code>shift()</code></strong>: Removes the first element from an array and returns that element.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> tasks</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#032F62">"clean room"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"buy groceries"</span><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// push()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">tasks.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">push</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"do laundry"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(tasks); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: ["clean room", "buy groceries", "do laundry"]</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// pop()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> lastTask</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> tasks.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">pop</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(lastTask); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: "do laundry"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(tasks);    </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: ["clean room", "buy groceries"]</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// unshift()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">tasks.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">unshift</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"plan dinner"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(tasks); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: ["plan dinner", "clean room", "buy groceries"]</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// shift()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> firstTask</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> tasks.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">shift</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(firstTask); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: "plan dinner"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(tasks);     </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: ["clean room", "buy groceries"]</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h4>Iterating Over Arrays</h4>
<p>You often need to process each element in an array. The <code>for</code> loop and <code>forEach()</code> method are common ways to do this.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> scores</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">85</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">92</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">78</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">95</span><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Using a for loop</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">for</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> i </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">; i </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&lt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> scores.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">length</span><span style="color:#24292E">; i</span><span style="color:#D73A49">++</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Score at index ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">i</span><span style="color:#032F62">}: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">scores</span><span style="color:#032F62">[</span><span style="color:#24292E">i</span><span style="color:#032F62">]</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Score at index 0: 85</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Score at index 1: 92</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Score at index 2: 78</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Score at index 3: 95</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Using forEach() (introduced in JavaScript Basics and DOM Manipulation)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">scores.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">forEach</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">score</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">index</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Score: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">score</span><span style="color:#032F62">} (Index: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">index</span><span style="color:#032F62">})`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Score: 85 (Index: 0)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Score: 92 (Index: 1)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Score: 78 (Index: 2)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Score: 95 (Index: 3)</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h2>Working with Objects</h2>
<p>Objects in JavaScript are collections of key-value pairs. Unlike arrays, objects are unordered. The keys (also known as property names) are typically strings (or symbols), and the values can be any data type, including other objects or arrays.</p>
<h3>Creating Objects</h3>
<p>Objects can be created using object literal notation or the <code>Object()</code> constructor. Object literal notation is more commonly used.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Object literal notation (preferred)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> person</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  firstName: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Alice"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  lastName: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Smith"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  age: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">30</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">};</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Using the Object() constructor</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> car</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> Object</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">car.make </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Toyota"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">car.model </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Camry"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">car.year </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 2022</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// An empty object</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> emptyObject</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {};</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Accessing Object Properties</h3>
<p>Properties in an object can be accessed using dot notation (<code>object.property</code>) or bracket notation (<code>object["property"]</code>). Bracket notation is necessary when property names contain spaces, special characters, or when the property name is stored in a variable.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> book</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  title: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"The Great Gatsby"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  author: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"F. Scott Fitzgerald"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">  "publication year"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1925</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // Property name with space</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">};</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Dot notation</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(book.title);  </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: "The Great Gatsby"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(book.author); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: "F. Scott Fitzgerald"</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Bracket notation</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(book[</span><span style="color:#032F62">"title"</span><span style="color:#24292E">]); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: "The Great Gatsby"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(book[</span><span style="color:#032F62">"publication year"</span><span style="color:#24292E">]); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: 1925</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Using a variable for property name with bracket notation</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> propertyName</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "author"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(book[propertyName]); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: "F. Scott Fitzgerald"</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Modifying and Adding Object Properties</h3>
<p>Existing properties can be modified by assigning a new value. New properties can be added similarly.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> user</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  username: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"js_dev"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  email: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"js_dev@example.com"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">};</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(user); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: { username: "js_dev", email: "js_dev@example.com" }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Modify an existing property</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">user.email </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "new_js_dev@example.com"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(user); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: { username: "js_dev", email: "new_js_dev@example.com" }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Add a new property</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">user.isOnline </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> true</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(user); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: { username: "js_dev", email: "new_js_dev@example.com", isOnline: true }</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Deleting Object Properties</h3>
<p>The <code>delete</code> operator removes a property from an object.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> settings</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  theme: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"dark"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  fontSize: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"16px"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  notifications: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">true</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">};</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(settings); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: { theme: "dark", fontSize: "16px", notifications: true }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">delete</span><span style="color:#24292E"> settings.notifications;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(settings); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: { theme: "dark", fontSize: "16px" }</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Iterating Over Object Properties</h3>
<p>Iterating over object properties is different from arrays. Common methods include <code>for...in</code> loop and <code>Object.keys()</code>, <code>Object.values()</code>, <code>Object.entries()</code>.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> student</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  name: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"John Doe"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  age: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">22</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  major: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Computer Science"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">};</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Using for...in loop</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">for</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> key</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> in</span><span style="color:#24292E"> student) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`${</span><span style="color:#24292E">key</span><span style="color:#032F62">}: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">student</span><span style="color:#032F62">[</span><span style="color:#24292E">key</span><span style="color:#032F62">]</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// name: John Doe</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// age: 22</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// major: Computer Science</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Using Object.keys() to get an array of property names</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">Object.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">keys</span><span style="color:#24292E">(student).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">forEach</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">key</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`${</span><span style="color:#24292E">key</span><span style="color:#032F62">}: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">student</span><span style="color:#032F62">[</span><span style="color:#24292E">key</span><span style="color:#032F62">]</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Same output as above</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Using Object.values() to get an array of property values</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">Object.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">values</span><span style="color:#24292E">(student).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">forEach</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">value</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(value);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// John Doe</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// 22</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Computer Science</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Using Object.entries() to get an array of [key, value] pairs</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">Object.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">entries</span><span style="color:#24292E">(student).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">forEach</span><span style="color:#24292E">(([</span><span style="color:#E36209">key</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">value</span><span style="color:#24292E">]) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`${</span><span style="color:#24292E">key</span><span style="color:#032F62">}: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">value</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Same output as for...in loop</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h2>Nested Data Structures: Arrays of Objects and Objects with Arrays</h2>
<p>Real-world data often involves more complex structures where arrays contain objects, or objects contain arrays.</p>
<h3>Array of Objects</h3>
<p>A common pattern is an array where each element is an object, representing a collection of structured records.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> users</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  { id: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">, name: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Alice"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, email: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"alice@example.com"</span><span style="color:#24292E"> },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  { id: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">, name: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Bob"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, email: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"bob@example.com"</span><span style="color:#24292E"> },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  { id: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#24292E">, name: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Charlie"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, email: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"charlie@example.com"</span><span style="color:#24292E"> }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Accessing an object in the array</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(users[</span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">]); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: { id: 2, name: "Bob", email: "bob@example.com" }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Accessing a property of an object in the array</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(users[</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">].name); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: "Alice"</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Iterating over an array of objects</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">users.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">forEach</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">user</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`User ID: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">user</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#24292E">id</span><span style="color:#032F62">}, Name: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">user</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#24292E">name</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// User ID: 1, Name: Alice</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// User ID: 2, Name: Bob</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// User ID: 3, Name: Charlie</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Object with Arrays as Properties</h3>
<p>Objects can also have properties whose values are arrays.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> company</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  name: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Tech Solutions Inc."</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  location: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Silicon Valley"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  employees: [</span><span style="color:#032F62">"John Doe"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Jane Smith"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Peter Jones"</span><span style="color:#24292E">],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  departments: [</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Engineering"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Marketing"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"HR"</span><span style="color:#24292E">]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">};</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Accessing an array property</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(company.employees); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: ["John Doe", "Jane Smith", "Peter Jones"]</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Accessing an element within an array property</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(company.departments[</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">]); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: "Engineering"</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Modifying an array property (e.g., adding an employee)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">company.employees.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">push</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Sarah Connor"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(company.employees); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: ["John Doe", "Jane Smith", "Peter Jones", "Sarah Connor"]</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h2>Practical Examples and Demonstrations</h2>
<p>Let's look at more comprehensive examples of using arrays and objects together.</p>
<h3>Managing a Shopping Cart</h3>
<p>Imagine building an e-commerce application. A shopping cart can be represented as an array of objects, where each object describes an item in the cart.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> shoppingCart </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> []; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Initialize an empty shopping cart</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Function to add an item to the cart</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> addItemToCart</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">id</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">name</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">price</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">quantity</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> existingItem</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> shoppingCart.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">find</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">item</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> item.id </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#24292E"> id); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Check if item already exists</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (existingItem) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    existingItem.quantity </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> quantity; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// If exists, update quantity</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    shoppingCart.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">push</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ id, name, price, quantity }); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Otherwise, add new item</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`${</span><span style="color:#24292E">name</span><span style="color:#032F62">} (x${</span><span style="color:#24292E">quantity</span><span style="color:#032F62">}) added to cart.`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Function to remove an item from the cart by its ID</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> removeItemFromCart</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">id</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> initialLength</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> shoppingCart.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">length</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  shoppingCart </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> shoppingCart.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">filter</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">item</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> item.id </span><span style="color:#D73A49">!==</span><span style="color:#24292E"> id); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Filter out the item</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (shoppingCart.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">length</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> &lt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> initialLength) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Item with ID ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">id</span><span style="color:#032F62">} removed.`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Item with ID ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">id</span><span style="color:#032F62">} not found in cart.`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Function to calculate the total price of items in the cart</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> calculateCartTotal</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> total </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  shoppingCart.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">forEach</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">item</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    total </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> item.price </span><span style="color:#D73A49">*</span><span style="color:#24292E"> item.quantity;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> total.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toFixed</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Format to two decimal places</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Add some items</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">addItemToCart</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">101</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Laptop"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1200.00</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">addItemToCart</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">202</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Mouse"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">25.50</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">addItemToCart</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">101</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Laptop"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1200.00</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Add another laptop, quantity should update</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Current Cart:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, shoppingCart);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Current Cart: [</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">//   { id: 101, name: 'Laptop', price: 1200, quantity: 2 },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">//   { id: 202, name: 'Mouse', price: 25.5, quantity: 2 }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// ]</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Cart Total:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#6F42C1">calculateCartTotal</span><span style="color:#24292E">()); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: "2451.00"</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Remove an item</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">removeItemFromCart</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">202</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Cart after removal:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, shoppingCart);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Cart after removal: [</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">//   { id: 101, name: 'Laptop', price: 1200, quantity: 2 }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// ]</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Cart Total after removal:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#6F42C1">calculateCartTotal</span><span style="color:#24292E">()); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Outputs: "2400.00"</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p><em>Note: The <code>find()</code> and <code>filter()</code> array methods used here are powerful tools for working with arrays, which were covered briefly in the "JavaScript Basics and DOM Manipulation" module when discussing higher-order functions.</em></p>
<h3>Representing a Blog Post</h3>
<p>A single blog post can be an object, holding various pieces of information about the post.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> blogPost</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    id: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"dev_jane"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    bio: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Passionate about web development."</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  },</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  content: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"This post covers the fundamentals of working with arrays and objects in JavaScript..."</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  comments: [</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      commentId: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      author: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Reader1"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
