<div id="chapter-4.3">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Asynchronous JavaScript: Callbacks</h1><p>JavaScript code executes line by line, sequentially. However, some operations, like fetching data from a server or reading a file, take time and would block the execution of subsequent code. Asynchronous JavaScript allows these long-running tasks to happen in the background without freezing the entire program. Callbacks are a fundamental pattern for handling asynchronous operations, enabling code to be executed after a particular task has completed.</p>
<h2>Understanding Asynchronous Operations and Blocking Code</h2>
<p>When JavaScript runs in a browser, it typically has a single thread for executing code, rendering the UI, and handling user interactions. This is often referred to as the main thread. If a long-running operation ties up this main thread, the browser becomes unresponsive – users cannot click buttons, scroll, or interact with the page. This is known as <strong>blocking code</strong>.</p>
<p>Consider a scenario where you're building an e-commerce website. When a user clicks "Add to Cart," you need to send a request to a server to update the cart. If this server request takes 5 seconds, and your code is synchronous, the user interface would freeze for those 5 seconds. The user wouldn't be able to click anything else, and the page might even show a "not responding" message. This creates a terrible user experience.</p>
<p>Asynchronous operations solve this by allowing certain tasks to run "off-thread" or in a non-blocking manner. When an asynchronous operation starts, JavaScript continues executing the rest of your code. Once the asynchronous operation completes, it signals back to the JavaScript environment that it's finished, and any associated code can then be run. Callbacks are the traditional way to provide this "associated code."</p>
<h3>How Callbacks Work</h3>
<p>A callback is a function passed as an argument to another function. The receiving function then "calls back" this argument function at a later point in time, typically after an asynchronous operation has completed.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> doSomethingAsync</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">callback</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Starting asynchronous operation..."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // Simulate an asynchronous operation (e.g., network request, file read)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">  setTimeout</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Asynchronous operation completed."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> data</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Data from async operation"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    callback</span><span style="color:#24292E">(data); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Call the callback function with the result</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2000</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Simulate a 2-second delay</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> processResult</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">result</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Processing the result:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, result);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Call the asynchronous function, passing processResult as the callback</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">doSomethingAsync</span><span style="color:#24292E">(processResult);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"This line executes immediately after doSomethingAsync is called."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this example:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>doSomethingAsync</code> is a function that simulates an asynchronous task using <code>setTimeout</code>.</li>
<li><code>setTimeout</code> is a built-in JavaScript function that executes a given function <em>after</em> a specified delay. It's inherently asynchronous.</li>
<li><code>processResult</code> is the callback function. It contains the logic that should run <em>after</em> <code>doSomethingAsync</code> has completed its task and produced a result.</li>
<li>When <code>doSomethingAsync(processResult)</code> is called, <code>Starting asynchronous operation...</code> is logged. Then, <code>setTimeout</code> is initiated, but JavaScript <em>does not wait</em> for the 2-second delay. It immediately moves on to <code>console.log("This line executes immediately...")</code>.</li>
<li>After 2 seconds, the function inside <code>setTimeout</code> executes, logs <code>Asynchronous operation completed.</code>, and then calls <code>callback(data)</code>, which in turn executes <code>processResult("Data from async operation")</code>.</li>
</ul>
<p>This demonstrates the non-blocking nature: the message <code>This line executes immediately...</code> appears before <code>Asynchronous operation completed.</code> and <code>Processing the result...</code>, even though it's written after the call to <code>doSomethingAsync</code>.</p>
<h2>Practical Examples of Callbacks</h2>
<p>Callbacks are widely used in JavaScript for various scenarios, especially when dealing with events, timers, and data fetching.</p>
<h3>Event Handling with Callbacks</h3>
<p>DOM event listeners are a prime example of callbacks in action. When a user interacts with an element (e.g., clicks a button), you want a specific function to execute. This function is the callback.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;!</span><span style="color:#22863A">DOCTYPE</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> lang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> charset</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"UTF-8"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"viewport"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> content</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Callback Event Example&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"myButton"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Click Me&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"message"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> button</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'myButton'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> messageParagraph</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'message'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // This function is the callback for the click event</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleClick</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            messageParagraph.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Button was clicked!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Button click detected."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Add an event listener, passing handleClick as the callback</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        button.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">addEventListener</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'click'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, handleClick);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Event listener attached. Waiting for user interaction."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Here:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>button.addEventListener('click', handleClick)</code> registers <code>handleClick</code> as the callback.</li>
<li>The browser monitors for a 'click' event on <code>myButton</code>.</li>
<li>When a click occurs, the browser "calls back" the <code>handleClick</code> function.</li>
<li>The <code>console.log("Event listener attached...")</code> runs immediately, and the <code>handleClick</code> function only runs much later, when the user actually clicks.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Timers with Callbacks</h3>
<p><code>setTimeout</code> and <code>setInterval</code> functions, which were briefly touched upon, are core asynchronous operations that rely on callbacks.</p>
<h4><code>setTimeout</code></h4>
<p>Executes a function once after a specified delay.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Program started."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">setTimeout</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"This message appears after 3 seconds."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">3000</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 3000 milliseconds = 3 seconds</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Continuing with other tasks..."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The anonymous function <code>function() { console.log("This message appears after 3 seconds."); }</code> is the callback. It's executed by <code>setTimeout</code> after the 3-second delay.</p>
<h4><code>setInterval</code></h4>
<p>Executes a function repeatedly at a specified interval.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> count </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// This function is the callback for setInterval</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> intervalId</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> setInterval</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  count</span><span style="color:#D73A49">++</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Interval message: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">count</span><span style="color:#032F62">} seconds passed.`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (count </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&gt;=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 5</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    clearInterval</span><span style="color:#24292E">(intervalId); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Stop the interval after 5 runs</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Interval stopped."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1000</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 1000 milliseconds = 1 second</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Interval started. Will log every second for 5 seconds."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The anonymous function passed to <code>setInterval</code> is the callback, executed every 1000ms. <code>clearInterval</code> is used to stop the repetition, preventing an infinite loop.</p>
<h3>Callbacks for Data Processing</h3>
<p>Callbacks are fundamental when dealing with array methods that iterate over elements, like <code>forEach</code>, <code>map</code>, <code>filter</code>, and <code>reduce</code>. These methods accept a callback function that is applied to each element (or a subset) of the array. While these are often synchronous, they illustrate the callback pattern clearly.</p>
<h4><code>forEach</code></h4>
<p>Executes a provided function once for each array element.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> numbers</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">4</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">5</span><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Callback function to log each number</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> logNumber</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">number</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Number:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, number);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Using forEach with the logNumber callback</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">numbers.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">forEach</span><span style="color:#24292E">(logNumber);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"--- Using an anonymous callback ---"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Using an anonymous arrow function as a callback</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">numbers.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">forEach</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">num</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">index</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Element at index ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">index</span><span style="color:#032F62">}: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">num</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h4><code>map</code></h4>
<p>Creates a new array populated with the results of calling a provided function on every element in the calling array.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> products</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  { id: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">, name: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Laptop"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, price: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1200</span><span style="color:#24292E"> },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  { id: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">, name: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Mouse"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, price: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">25</span><span style="color:#24292E"> },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  { id: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#24292E">, name: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Keyboard"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, price: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">75</span><span style="color:#24292E"> }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Callback function to get just the product names</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> getProductName</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">product</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> product.name.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toUpperCase</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Using map with the getProductName callback</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> productNames</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> products.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">map</span><span style="color:#24292E">(getProductName);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Product names:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, productNames); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: ["LAPTOP", "MOUSE", "KEYBOARD"]</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Using an anonymous callback to calculate discounted prices</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> discountedPrices</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> products.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">map</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">product</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> product.price </span><span style="color:#D73A49">*</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0.9</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 10% discount</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Discounted prices:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, discountedPrices); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: [1080, 22.5, 67.5]</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h2>Callback Hell (Pyramid of Doom)</h2>
<p>While callbacks are essential for asynchronous programming, extensive use of nested callbacks to handle sequential asynchronous operations can lead to a difficult-to-read and maintain code structure known as "Callback Hell" or "Pyramid of Doom." This occurs when you have multiple asynchronous operations that depend on the successful completion of previous ones.</p>
<p>Imagine a scenario where you need to:</p>
<ol>
<li>Fetch a user ID.</li>
<li>Use that user ID to fetch user details.</li>
<li>Use user details to fetch their orders.</li>
<li>Process those orders.</li>
</ol>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> getUserID</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">callback</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">  setTimeout</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> userID</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "user123"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"1. User ID fetched:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, userID);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    callback</span><span style="color:#24292E">(userID);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1000</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> getUserDetails</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">userID</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">callback</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">  setTimeout</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> userDetails</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { name: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Alice"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, email: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"alice@example.com"</span><span style="color:#24292E"> };</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"2. User details fetched for"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, userID, </span><span style="color:#032F62">":"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, userDetails);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    callback</span><span style="color:#24292E">(userDetails);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1500</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> getUserOrders</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">userDetails</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">callback</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">  setTimeout</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> orders</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Order A"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Order B"</span><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"3. User orders fetched for"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, userDetails.name, </span><span style="color:#032F62">":"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, orders);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    callback</span><span style="color:#24292E">(orders);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2000</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> processOrders</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">orders</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">callback</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">  setTimeout</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"4. Processing orders:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, orders);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> processedResult</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#032F62"> `Total orders processed: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">orders</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">length</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    callback</span><span style="color:#24292E">(processedResult);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">500</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// This is an example of callback hell</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">getUserID</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">userID</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">  getUserDetails</span><span style="color:#24292E">(userID, </span><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">userDetails</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    getUserOrders</span><span style="color:#24292E">(userDetails, </span><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">orders</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">      processOrders</span><span style="color:#24292E">(orders, </span><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">finalResult</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"All operations complete:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, finalResult);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Main program flow continues without waiting."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The nested indentation makes the code harder to follow, debug, and extend. As the number of sequential asynchronous operations grows, the pyramid grows deeper, increasing complexity. This issue led to the development of other asynchronous patterns, which will be explored in upcoming lessons.</p>
<h2>Exercises and Practice Activities</h2>
<p>Practice applying callbacks in different scenarios.</p>
<h3>Exercise 1: Countdown Timer</h3>
<p>Create a simple countdown timer that logs numbers from 5 down to 1, with a 1-second delay between each number. After 1, it should log "Lift Off!".</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/*</span></span>

<h3>Exercise 2: Simulate Data Fetching with UI Update</h3>
<p>Imagine you're building a profile page. You need to simulate fetching user data from a server and then updating a <code>&lt;div&gt;</code> element on your page with that data.</p>
<ol>
<li>Create an HTML file with an empty <code>div</code> having an <code>id="profile-data"</code>.</li>
<li>Write a JavaScript function <code>fetchUserProfile(userId, callback)</code> that simulates an asynchronous API call (e.g., using <code>setTimeout</code>). This function should take a <code>userId</code> and a <code>callback</code>.</li>
<li>Inside <code>fetchUserProfile</code>, after a 2-second delay, call the <code>callback</code> function with a user object like <code>{ name: "John Doe", age: 30, city: "New York" }</code>.</li>
<li>The callback function should receive this user object and update the <code>innerHTML</code> of the <code>div</code> with the user's name, age, and city.</li>
</ol>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;!</span><span style="color:#22863A">DOCTYPE</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> lang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> charset</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"UTF-8"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">meta</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"viewport"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> content</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Profile Fetcher&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">title</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">head</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;User Profile&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"profile-data"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> style</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"border: 1px solid #ccc; padding: 10px;"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        Loading profile...</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Your JavaScript code here</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        /*</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        function fetchUserProfile(userId, callback) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">          // Simulate async call</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">          setTimeout(() =&gt; {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            const userData = { name: "John Doe", age: 30, city: "New York" };</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            callback(userData);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">          }, 2000);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        function displayUserProfile(user) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">          const profileDiv = document.getElementById('profile-data');</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">          profileDiv.innerHTML = `</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Name:&lt;/strong&gt; ${user.name}&lt;/p&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Age:&lt;/strong&gt; ${user.age}&lt;/p&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;City:&lt;/strong&gt; ${user.city}&lt;/p&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">          `;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        fetchUserProfile("someUserId", displayUserProfile);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Exercise 3: Callback for Error Handling</h3>
<p>Modify Exercise 2 to include basic error handling.</p>
<ol>
<li>The <code>fetchUserProfile</code> function should now accept two callbacks: <code>successCallback</code> and <code>errorCallback</code>.</li>
<li>Randomly simulate an error (e.g., 20% chance) by calling <code>errorCallback</code> with an error message like "Failed to fetch user data."</li>
<li>If there's no error, call <code>successCallback</code> with the user data.</li>
<li>Update the UI to show either the user data or the error message.</li>
</ol>
