<div id="chapter-4.4">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Asynchronous JavaScript: Promises and Fetch API</h1><p>Asynchronous operations are fundamental in modern web development, allowing programs to perform long-running tasks without blocking the main execution thread. While callbacks provided a way to handle asynchronous code, they often led to complex and difficult-to-manage "callback hell." Promises offer a more structured and robust approach to asynchronous programming, representing the eventual completion (or failure) of an asynchronous operation and its resulting value. The Fetch API, built upon Promises, provides a modern, powerful, and flexible way to make network requests.</p>
<h2>Understanding JavaScript Promises</h2>
<p>A Promise is an object representing the eventual completion or failure of an asynchronous operation. A Promise can be in one of three states:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Pending:</strong> The initial state, neither fulfilled nor rejected. The asynchronous operation is still ongoing.</li>
<li><strong>Fulfilled (Resolved):</strong> The operation completed successfully, and the Promise has a resulting value.</li>
<li><strong>Rejected:</strong> The operation failed, and the Promise has a reason for the failure.</li>
</ul>
<p>Once a Promise is fulfilled or rejected, it is said to be <em>settled</em>. A settled Promise cannot change its state again.</p>
<h3>Creating a Promise</h3>
<p>You can create a new Promise using the <code>Promise</code> constructor, which takes a function called the <em>executor</em> as an argument. The executor function itself takes two arguments: <code>resolve</code> and <code>reject</code>.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>resolve</code> is a function that you call when the asynchronous operation successfully completes. It takes the successful result as an argument.</li>
<li><code>reject</code> is a function that you call when the asynchronous operation fails. It takes an error object or a reason for the failure as an argument.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Example 1: A basic Promise that resolves immediately</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> myFirstPromise</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> Promise</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">resolve</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">reject</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // Simulate an asynchronous operation (e.g., fetching data, a timer)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">  setTimeout</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> success</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> true</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Let's assume the operation was successful</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (success) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">      resolve</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Data successfully fetched!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Call resolve with the successful result</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">      reject</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Error: Failed to fetch data."</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Call reject with an error message</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1000</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Simulate a 1-second delay</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Promise created, waiting for resolution..."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this example, <code>myFirstPromise</code> will transition from a <em>pending</em> state to a <em>fulfilled</em> state after 1 second, providing the string "Data successfully fetched!". If <code>success</code> were <code>false</code>, it would transition to a <em>rejected</em> state.</p>
<h3>Consuming a Promise: <code>then()</code>, <code>catch()</code>, and <code>finally()</code></h3>
<p>Once a Promise is created, you use its <code>.then()</code>, <code>.catch()</code>, and <code>.finally()</code> methods to handle its eventual outcome.</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong><code>.then(onFulfilled, onRejected)</code>:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><code>onFulfilled</code> is a callback function executed when the Promise is <em>fulfilled</em>. It receives the resolved value as an argument.</li>
<li><code>onRejected</code> (optional) is a callback function executed when the Promise is <em>rejected</em>. It receives the rejection reason as an argument.</li>
<li>The <code>.then()</code> method always returns a <em>new</em> Promise, allowing for chaining.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>.catch(onRejected)</code>:</strong> This is a shorthand for <code>.then(null, onRejected)</code>. It's used specifically to handle errors (rejections) in a Promise chain.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>.finally(onFinally)</code>:</strong> The <code>onFinally</code> callback function is executed regardless of whether the Promise was fulfilled or rejected. It's useful for cleanup tasks, such as hiding a loading spinner. It does not receive any arguments and does not affect the Promise's resolved value or rejection reason.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Consuming myFirstPromise from Example 1</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">myFirstPromise</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">then</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">data</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // This runs if the Promise is fulfilled</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Success:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, data); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: Success: Data successfully fetched!</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    return</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Processed "</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#24292E"> data; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Return a new value to the next .then()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">then</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">processedData</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // This runs after the previous .then() resolves</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Further processing:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, processedData); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: Further processing: Processed Data successfully fetched!</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // This runs if any Promise in the chain is rejected</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Error handler:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, error);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">finally</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // This always runs, regardless of success or failure</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Promise operation complete."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Example 2: A Promise that rejects</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> fetchDataWithError</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> Promise</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">resolve</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">reject</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">  setTimeout</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    reject</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Network connection lost!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">500</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">fetchDataWithError</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">then</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">data</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Should not run:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, data);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Caught an error:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, error); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Output: Caught an error: Network connection lost!</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">finally</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Error scenario finished."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  });</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Promise Chaining</h3>
<p>A powerful feature of Promises is chaining. Since <code>.then()</code> always returns a new Promise, you can chain multiple <code>.then()</code> calls to perform a sequence of asynchronous operations, where each subsequent operation depends on the success of the previous one. If any Promise in the chain rejects, the control flow jumps to the nearest <code>.catch()</code> handler.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> step1</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> Promise</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">resolve</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setTimeout</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Step 1 complete."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">      resolve</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Result from Step 1"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1000</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> step2</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">prevResult</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> Promise</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">resolve</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">reject</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setTimeout</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Step 2 complete with:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, prevResult);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">      // Simulate a potential error</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">      if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (prevResult </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Result from Step 1"</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        resolve</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Result from Step 2 based on "</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#24292E"> prevResult);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        reject</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Error in Step 2: Invalid previous result."</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1000</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> step3</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">prevResult</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> Promise</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">resolve</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setTimeout</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Step 3 complete with:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, prevResult);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">      resolve</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Final result: "</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#24292E"> prevResult);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1000</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">step1</span><span style="color:#24292E">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">then</span><span style="color:#24292E">(step2) </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Pass the result of step1 to step2</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">then</span><span style="color:#24292E">(step3) </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Pass the result of step2 to step3</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">then</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">finalResult</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"All steps completed successfully:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, finalResult);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"An error occurred in the chain:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, error);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  });</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This chained structure makes complex asynchronous workflows much more readable and manageable than nested callbacks.</p>
<h2>The Fetch API</h2>
<p>The Fetch API provides a modern interface for fetching resources across the network. It's built on Promises, making it a powerful and flexible replacement for older methods like <code>XMLHttpRequest</code>. The <code>fetch()</code> method returns a <code>Promise</code> that resolves to the <code>Response</code> object representing the response to your request.</p>
<h3>Making a GET Request with Fetch</h3>
<p>The simplest use of <code>fetch()</code> is to make a GET request to a URL.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Example 3: Fetching data from a public API</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// We'll use the JSONPlaceholder API for fake online REST APIs</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> apiURL</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">fetch</span><span style="color:#24292E">(apiURL)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">then</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">response</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Check if the request was successful (status code 200-299)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">response.ok) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">      // If not successful, throw an error with the status text</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">      throw</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> Error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`HTTP error! status: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">response</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#24292E">status</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Parse the response body as JSON</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> response.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">then</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">data</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Handle the JSON data</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Fetched post data:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, data);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Expected output:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    //   "userId": 1,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    //   "id": 1,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    //   "title": "sunt aut facere repellat provident occaecati excepturi optio reprehenderit",</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    //   "body": "quia et suscipit\nsuscipit recusandae consequuntur expedita et cum\nreprehenderit molestiae ut ut quas totam\nnostrum rerum est autem sunt rem eveniet architecto"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">error</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Handle any errors that occurred during the fetch operation or parsing</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"There was a problem with the fetch operation:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, error);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  });</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Key points in the <code>fetch()</code> workflow:</p>
<ol>
<li><strong><code>fetch(url)</code>:</strong> Initiates the request. It returns a Promise that resolves with a <code>Response</code> object.</li>
<li><strong><code>response =&gt; { ... }</code>:</strong> The first <code>.then()</code> receives the <code>Response</code> object. This object contains information about the response, such as its <code>status</code> (e.g., 200 for OK, 404 for Not Found) and <code>ok</code> property (a boolean indicating if the response was successful).</li>
<li><strong><code>response.json()</code>:</strong> The <code>Response</code> object has methods to extract the body content, such as <code>json()</code>, <code>text()</code>, <code>blob()</code>, <code>formData()</code>, and <code>arrayBuffer()</code>. <code>response.json()</code> returns <em>another Promise</em> that resolves with the parsed JSON data. It's crucial to return this Promise so the next <code>.then()</code> in the chain waits for the parsing to complete.</li>
<li><strong><code>data =&gt; { ... }</code>:</strong> The second <code>.then()</code> receives the actual JSON data (or text, blob, etc.) after it's successfully parsed.</li>
<li><strong><code>.catch(error =&gt; { ... })</code>:</strong> This handles any network errors (e.g., no internet connection) or errors thrown explicitly in the <code>then()</code> blocks (like our <code>throw new Error()</code> for non-OK HTTP statuses).</li>
</ol>
<h3>Making Other Types of Requests (POST, PUT, DELETE)</h3>
<p>To make requests other than GET, or to send data with your request, you need to provide a second argument to <code>fetch()</code>, an <code>options</code> object.</p>
<p>Common <code>options</code> properties include:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong><code>method</code></strong>: HTTP method (e.g., <code>'POST'</code>, <code>'PUT'</code>, <code>'DELETE'</code>). Default is <code>'GET'</code>.</li>
<li><strong><code>headers</code></strong>: An object containing HTTP request headers (e.g., <code>{'Content-Type': 'application/json'}</code>).</li>
<li><strong><code>body</code></strong>: The request body data (e.g., <code>JSON.stringify({ name: 'Alice' })</code> for POST requests).</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Example 4: Making a POST request</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> postAPI</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> newPost</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  title: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'My New Post'</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  body: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'This is the content of my new post.'</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  userId: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">};</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">fetch</span><span style="color:#24292E">(postAPI, {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  method: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'POST'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Specify the HTTP method</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  headers: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">    'Content-Type'</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'application/json'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Indicate that we are sending JSON data</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">    'Accept'</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'application/json'</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // Indicate that we prefer JSON back</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  body: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">JSON</span><span style="color:#24292E">.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">stringify</span><span style="color:#24292E">(newPost) </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Convert the JavaScript object to a JSON string</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">})</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">then</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">response</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">response.ok) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">      throw</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> Error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`HTTP error! status: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">response</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#24292E">status</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> response.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">(); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Parse the response from the server</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">then</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">data</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Successfully created post:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, data);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Expected output will include the new post with an `id` assigned by the server</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // e.g., { title: 'My New Post', body: '...', userId: 1, id: 101 }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">error</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Error creating post:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, error);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  });</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Handling Different Response Types</h3>
<p>While <code>response.json()</code> is common for APIs, you might need to handle other types:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong><code>response.text()</code></strong>: For plain text responses.</li>
<li><strong><code>response.blob()</code></strong>: For binary data like images or files.</li>
<li><strong><code>response.arrayBuffer()</code></strong>: For low-level binary data.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Example 5: Fetching a text file</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">fetch</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1'</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// This API returns JSON, but we'll treat it as text</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">then</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">response</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">response.ok) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">      throw</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> Error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`HTTP error! status: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">response</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#24292E">status</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> response.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">text</span><span style="color:#24292E">(); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Get the response as plain text</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">then</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">textData</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Fetched as text:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, textData);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Output: {"userId": 1, "id": 1, "title": "delectus aut autem", "completed": false} (as a string)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">error</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Error fetching text:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, error);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  });</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Aborting a Fetch Request</h3>
<p>Sometimes you need to cancel a fetch request, for example, if a user navigates away from a page or makes a new request before the previous one completes. The <code>AbortController</code> API allows you to do this.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Example 6: Aborting a fetch request</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> controller</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> AbortController</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> signal</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> controller.signal; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Get the signal from the controller</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">fetch</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/photos'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, { signal }) </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Pass the signal to fetch options</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">then</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">response</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">response.ok) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">      throw</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> Error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`HTTP error! status: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">response</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#24292E">status</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> response.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">then</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">data</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Fetched photos:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, data.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">slice</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#24292E">)); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Display first 3 photos</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">error</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (error.name </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'AbortError'</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Fetch aborted successfully.'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Fetch error:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, error);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// After some time (e.g., 50ms), abort the request</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">setTimeout</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  controller.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">abort</span><span style="color:#24292E">(); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// This will trigger the 'AbortError' in the catch block</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">50</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Error Handling Best Practices with Fetch</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Check <code>response.ok</code>:</strong> Always check <code>response.ok</code> (or <code>response.status</code>) to ensure the HTTP request itself was successful. A network error (like no internet) will reject the promise, but a 404 (Not Found) or 500 (Server Error) will <em>fulfill</em> the promise with an <code>ok: false</code> response. You must explicitly throw an error in this case.</li>
<li><strong>Single <code>.catch()</code>:</strong> Place a single <code>.catch()</code> at the end of your Promise chain to handle all errors from any step in the chain. This centralizes error handling.</li>
</ul>

<li>Consume the Promise and log "Login successful!" or "Login failed: [reason]" to the console.</li>
