<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">      throw</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> Error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`HTTP error! status: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">response</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#24292E">status</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> response.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">then</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">user</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Author Name:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, user.name); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Log the author's name</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">error</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Error in chained fetch operations:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, error);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  });</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
  
</div>

<div id="chapter-4.5">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Debugging JavaScript Code</h1><p>JavaScript code often contains errors that prevent it from running as expected. Identifying, understanding, and resolving these issues is known as debugging. Effective debugging involves using tools and techniques to trace the execution flow of your code, inspect variable values, and pinpoint where and why errors occur.</p>
<h2>Understanding Common JavaScript Errors</h2>
<p>JavaScript can produce various types of errors, each indicating a different problem. Recognizing these common errors helps in quickly diagnosing issues.</p>
<h3>Syntax Errors</h3>
<p>Syntax errors occur when the code violates JavaScript's grammatical rules. The JavaScript engine cannot parse the code correctly. These errors often prevent the script from executing at all.</p>
<p><strong>Example 1: Missing Parenthesis</strong></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> greet</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">name</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Missing closing parenthesis for parameters</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E36209">    console</span><span style="color:#24292E">.</span><span style="color:#E36209">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">("</span><span style="color:#E36209">Hello</span><span style="color:#24292E">, " + </span><span style="color:#E36209">name</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E36209">greet</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Alice"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Expected error: SyntaxError: Unexpected token '{'</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this example, the JavaScript interpreter expects a closing parenthesis <code>)</code> after <code>name</code> but finds an opening curly brace <code>{</code> instead, leading to a <code>SyntaxError</code>.</p>
<p><strong>Example 2: Incorrect Keyword Usage</strong></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> myVar</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 10</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (myVar </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&gt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 5</span><span style="color:#24292E">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"myVar is greater than 5"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">els { </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Typo: should be 'else'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"myVar is 5 or less"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Expected error: SyntaxError: Unexpected token '{'</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Here, <code>els</code> is not a valid JavaScript keyword for an <code>else</code> statement, causing a <code>SyntaxError</code>. The parser encounters an unexpected <code>{</code> after <code>els</code>.</p>
<h3>Reference Errors</h3>
<p>Reference errors occur when a variable or function is used that has not been declared or is out of scope.</p>
<p><strong>Example 1: Undefined Variable</strong></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(myUndefinedVariable); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// myUndefinedVariable is not declared</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Expected error: ReferenceError: myUndefinedVariable is not defined</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The interpreter tries to access <code>myUndefinedVariable</code> before it has been defined anywhere, resulting in a <code>ReferenceError</code>.</p>
<p><strong>Example 2: Out of Scope Variable</strong></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> calculateSum</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">b</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> sum </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> a </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#24292E"> b;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(sum); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 'sum' is only accessible within the calculateSum function</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Expected error: ReferenceError: sum is not defined</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The variable <code>sum</code> is declared with <code>let</code> inside the <code>calculateSum</code> function, giving it block scope. Attempting to access <code>sum</code> outside its scope leads to a <code>ReferenceError</code>.</p>
<h3>Type Errors</h3>
<p>Type errors occur when an operation is performed on a value that is not of the expected type.</p>
<p><strong>Example 1: Calling a Non-Function</strong></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> myNumber </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 123</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">myNumber</span><span style="color:#24292E">(); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Trying to call a number as if it were a function</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Expected error: TypeError: myNumber is not a function</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The variable <code>myNumber</code> holds a numeric value. JavaScript attempts to execute it as a function, leading to a <code>TypeError</code> because numbers are not callable.</p>
<p><strong>Example 2: Accessing Properties on <code>null</code> or <code>undefined</code></strong></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> user </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> null</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(user.name); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Trying to access 'name' property on null</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Expected error: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'name')</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>When <code>user</code> is <code>null</code>, it has no properties. Attempting to access <code>user.name</code> results in a <code>TypeError</code>. The same would occur if <code>user</code> were <code>undefined</code>.</p>
<h3>Range Errors</h3>
<p>Range errors occur when a numeric variable or parameter is outside its valid range. This is less common in day-to-day JavaScript but can appear with specific built-in functions.</p>
<p><strong>Example: Invalid Array Length</strong></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> arr</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> Array</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#D73A49">-</span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Trying to create an array with a negative length</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Expected error: RangeError: Invalid array length</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The <code>Array</code> constructor expects a non-negative integer for its length. Passing a negative value results in a <code>RangeError</code>.</p>
<h2>Using Browser Developer Tools for Debugging</h2>
<p>Modern web browsers come with powerful developer tools that are essential for debugging JavaScript. The Console, Sources, and Network tabs are particularly useful.</p>
<h3>The Console</h3>
<p>The Console provides a command-line interface to interact with the JavaScript environment of the current page. It's excellent for logging messages, inspecting values, and testing small snippets of code.</p>
<p><strong>Logging Messages with <code>console.log()</code></strong></p>
<p>The <code>console.log()</code> method is a fundamental debugging tool. It prints messages and values to the Console.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> userName </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Brenda"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> age </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 30</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> getUserInfo</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Function getUserInfo started."</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Log function entry</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Current userName:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, userName);    </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Log variable value</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Current age:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, age);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> message </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> `User ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">userName</span><span style="color:#032F62">} is ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">age</span><span style="color:#032F62">} years old.`</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Final message:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, message);      </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Log result</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> message;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">getUserInfo</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>When this code runs, the Console will show:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">Function getUserInfo started.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">Current </span><span style="color:#6F42C1">userName</span><span style="color:#24292E">: Brenda</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">Current </span><span style="color:#6F42C1">age</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">30</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">Final </span><span style="color:#6F42C1">message</span><span style="color:#24292E">: User Brenda is </span><span style="color:#005CC5">30</span><span style="color:#24292E"> years old.</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This allows you to see the flow of execution and the state of variables at different points.</p>
<p><strong>Other <code>console</code> methods:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><code>console.warn('This is a warning!');</code>: Displays a warning message, often styled with a yellow background.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>console.error('Something went wrong!');</code>: Displays an error message, often styled with a red background and includes a stack trace.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>console.info('Informational message.');</code>: Displays an informational message, typically styled like <code>log</code> but can be filtered.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>console.table(data);</code>: Displays tabular data in the Console. Useful for arrays of objects.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> users</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    { id: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">, name: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Alice"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, email: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"alice@example.com"</span><span style="color:#24292E"> },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    { id: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">, name: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Bob"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, email: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"bob@example.com"</span><span style="color:#24292E"> }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">table</span><span style="color:#24292E">(users);</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This will render a formatted table in the Console, making it easy to inspect structured data.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>The Sources Panel</h3>
<p>The Sources panel is where you set breakpoints, step through code, inspect the call stack, and monitor variables. This is the most powerful part of the debugger.</p>
<p><strong>Breakpoints</strong></p>
<p>A breakpoint is an intentional stopping point or pause in a program for debugging purposes. When execution reaches a breakpoint, the program pauses, allowing you to examine the current state.</p>
<p><strong>How to set a breakpoint:</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>Open Developer Tools (usually F12 or right-click -&gt; Inspect).</li>
<li>Go to the "Sources" tab.</li>
<li>Navigate to your JavaScript file.</li>
<li>Click on the line number in the gutter where you want the execution to pause. A blue marker appears.</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Example Scenario:</strong>
Imagine you have a function that processes an array, but the output is incorrect.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// script.js</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> processNumbers</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">numbers</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> result </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [];</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    for</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> i </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">; i </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&lt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> numbers.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">length</span><span style="color:#24292E">; i</span><span style="color:#D73A49">++</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> doubled </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> numbers[i] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">*</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 2</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (doubled </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&gt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 10</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            result.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">push</span><span style="color:#24292E">(doubled </span><span style="color:#D73A49">-</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Potential error here?</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            result.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">push</span><span style="color:#24292E">(doubled);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> result;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> myNums </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">5</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">8</span><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> processed </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> processNumbers</span><span style="color:#24292E">(myNums);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(processed); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Expected: [4, 10, 15] but maybe getting something else.</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>If the <code>console.log(processed)</code> output is not what you expect, you can set a breakpoint inside the <code>processNumbers</code> loop.</p>
<ol>
<li>Set a breakpoint on <code>let doubled = numbers[i] * 2;</code></li>
<li>Refresh the page. The code will pause at this line.</li>
<li>In the right-hand panel, you'll see:
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope:</strong> Shows current local and global variables and their values.</li>
<li><strong>Call Stack:</strong> Shows the sequence of function calls that led to the current point.</li>
<li><strong>Breakpoints:</strong> Lists all active breakpoints.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Stepping Through Code:</strong></p>
<p>Once paused at a breakpoint, you can control the execution flow:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Step over next function call (F10):</strong> Executes the current line of code and moves to the next line in the current function. If the current line is a function call, it executes the entire function without stepping into it.</li>
<li><strong>Step into next function call (F11):</strong> Executes the current line. If it's a function call, it steps <em>into</em> that function, pausing at its first line.</li>
<li><strong>Step out of current function (Shift + F11):</strong> Continues execution until the current function returns, then pauses at the line after the function call.</li>
<li><strong>Resume script execution (F8):</strong> Continues running the script until the next breakpoint or the end of the script.</li>
</ul>
<p>By stepping through the <code>processNumbers</code> loop, you can observe the values of <code>i</code>, <code>numbers[i]</code>, <code>doubled</code>, and <code>result</code> at each iteration in the <strong>Scope</strong> pane. This helps identify if <code>doubled - 1</code> or <code>doubled</code> is being pushed incorrectly based on the <code>doubled &gt; 10</code> condition.</p>
<p><strong>Watch Expressions:</strong></p>
<p>In the Sources panel, you can add "Watch expressions" to constantly monitor the value of specific variables or expressions as you step through the code. This is useful for complex expressions that change frequently or when variables are not directly visible in the local scope.</p>
<h3>The Network Panel</h3>
<p>While not strictly for JavaScript code execution errors, the Network panel is crucial for debugging issues related to asynchronous operations, especially when using <code>fetch</code> or <code>XMLHttpRequest</code>. It shows all network requests made by the page, including their status, headers, and responses.</p>
<p><strong>Example Scenario (referencing previous lesson on Fetch API):</strong>
You're making a <code>fetch</code> request to an API, but your data isn't loading.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">fetch</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'https://api.example.com/data'</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Assuming this API might sometimes fail</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">then</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">response</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">response.ok) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            throw</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> Error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`HTTP error! status: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">response</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#24292E">status</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> response.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">then</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">data</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Data received:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, data);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">error</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Fetch error:"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, error);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    });</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>If the <code>.catch()</code> block is being hit, or <code>data</code> is not what you expect, open the Network panel and refresh the page:</p>
<ol>
<li>Look for the <code>data</code> request to <code>https://api.example.com/data</code>.</li>
<li>Check its <strong>Status</strong> code (e.g., 200 OK, 404 Not Found, 500 Server Error).</li>
<li>Examine the <strong>Response</strong> tab to see what the server actually sent back.</li>
<li>Check the <strong>Headers</strong> tab to ensure the request was sent correctly (e.g., correct method, headers).</li>
</ol>
<p>This helps determine if the problem is with your JavaScript <code>fetch</code> call itself (e.g., wrong URL), with the server responding incorrectly, or with your handling of the response.</p>
<h2>Common Debugging Strategies</h2>
<p>Beyond using the tools, employing strategic approaches can make debugging more efficient.</p>
<h3>Reproducing the Bug</h3>
<p>The first step in debugging is always to reliably reproduce the bug. If you cannot make the bug happen consistently, it's very difficult to fix.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Example:</strong> A user reports an issue where a form submission fails only when specific fields contain special characters. You need to replicate this exact scenario (same browser, same input, same sequence of actions) to see the error yourself.</li>
<li><strong>Hypothetical:</strong> A button click sometimes doesn't trigger an event. You need to try clicking it in various ways, different speeds, after other interactions, until you understand when and why it fails.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Isolating the Problem</h3>
<p>Once reproducible, try to narrow down the section of code causing the issue.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Comment out code:</strong> Temporarily remove sections of code until the bug disappears. The last section you commented out (or the one that caused the bug to reappear when uncommented) likely contains the problem.</li>
<li><strong>Divide and Conquer:</strong> For a large function, split it into smaller, testable parts. Debug each part individually.
<ul>
<li><strong>Example:</strong> If a complex calculation function gives the wrong result, break it down. Check the input parsing, then the first step of the calculation, then the second, and so on, until you find where the value deviates.</li>
<li><strong>Real-world:</strong> A user registration process involves front-end validation, a fetch request, and back-end processing. If registration fails, you first check if front-end validation passes. Then, use the Network tab to see the API request and response. Finally, if the request looks correct but the server responds with an error, the issue is likely on the back-end, not in your client-side JavaScript.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>Using <code>debugger</code> Statements</h3>
<p>The <code>debugger</code> statement can be inserted directly into your JavaScript code. When the browser's developer tools are open, execution will pause at this line, acting like a programmatic breakpoint.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> calculateDiscount</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">price</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">discountPercentage</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> finalPrice </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> price;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (discountPercentage </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&gt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        debugger</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Code execution will pause here if DevTools are open</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        finalPrice </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> price </span><span style="color:#D73A49">*</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> -</span><span style="color:#24292E"> discountPercentage </span><span style="color:#D73A49">/</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 100</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> finalPrice;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">calculateDiscount</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#24292E">)); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Will pause before calculating finalPrice</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">calculateDiscount</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">50</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">));   </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Will not pause</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This is useful for quickly setting a breakpoint without having to navigate to the file in the Sources panel, especially when dealing with dynamically loaded scripts or code that executes only under specific conditions. Remember to remove <code>debugger</code> statements before deploying your code to production.</p>
