<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">html</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<ol>
<li>Open the HTML file in your browser.</li>
<li>Open Developer Tools and go to the <strong>Network</strong> tab.</li>
<li>Refresh the page.</li>
<li><strong>Task:</strong>
<ul>
<li>Observe the network request made to <code>jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users/1</code>. What is its status code? What is the response?</li>
<li>Now, modify <code>const userId = 1;</code> to <code>const userId = 9999;</code> (an ID that likely does not exist).</li>
<li>Refresh the page again, keeping the Network tab open. What is the status code for the request now? How does the browser's display change? How does the Console output change?</li>
<li><strong>Explain</strong> how the Network tab helped you understand why the <code>catch</code> block was executed.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
  
</div>

</div>

<div id="chapter-5">

<div id="chapter-5.1">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Introduction to React: Components and JSX</h1><p>React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces, primarily focused on creating interactive and dynamic single-page applications. It allows developers to construct complex UIs from small, isolated pieces of code called components. This approach promotes reusability, maintainability, and efficient rendering of web pages. React introduces a declarative way to define UI, where you describe how your UI should look based on the current state, and React handles updating the DOM to match that description.</p>
<h2>The Component-Based Architecture</h2>
<p>At the core of React is the concept of a component. Components are independent, reusable pieces of UI. Think of them as custom HTML elements that encapsulate their own logic, styling, and rendering. By breaking down a UI into smaller, manageable components, development becomes more organized and scalable.</p>
<p>There are two main types of components in React:</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Functional Components:</strong> These are JavaScript functions that accept "props" (properties) as an argument and return React elements. They are simpler to write and typically used for presenting UI without complex state logic, though with React Hooks, functional components can manage state and side effects.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Example of a simple functional component</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> WelcomeMessage</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">props</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Hello, {props.name}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Another functional component rendering a static message</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> Greeting</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Welcome to our application!&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In the <code>WelcomeMessage</code> component, <code>props.name</code> is used to dynamically display a name passed to it. The <code>Greeting</code> component simply returns a static paragraph.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Class Components:</strong> These are ES6 classes that extend <code>React.Component</code> and require a <code>render()</code> method that returns React elements. Class components were traditionally used for components that needed to manage their own state or lifecycle methods. While still valid, functional components with Hooks are now the preferred way to write new components for most use cases due to their simplicity and readability.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Example of a simple class component</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">class</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> WelcomeClassMessage</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> extends</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> React</span><span style="color:#24292E">.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">Component</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">  render</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Hello from class, {</span><span style="color:#005CC5">this</span><span style="color:#24292E">.props.name}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Here, <code>this.props.name</code> is used to access the <code>name</code> property within a class component's <code>render</code> method.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>Components can be nested within each other, forming a component tree. This hierarchical structure allows for complex UIs to be built from simple building blocks. For instance, a <code>Header</code> component might contain a <code>Logo</code> component and a <code>Navigation</code> component, which in turn contains <code>NavLink</code> components.</p>
<h2>JSX: JavaScript XML</h2>
<p>JSX (JavaScript XML) is a syntax extension for JavaScript. It looks very similar to HTML but is actually JavaScript. React uses JSX to describe what the UI should look like. Instead of writing separate HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files for each component, JSX allows you to write HTML-like syntax directly within your JavaScript code. This makes component creation more intuitive and keeps related rendering logic and UI together.</p>
<h3>JSX Syntax Rules</h3>
<p>While JSX appears like HTML, there are key differences and rules to follow:</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Single Root Element:</strong> JSX expressions must have exactly one outermost element. This means you cannot return multiple sibling elements directly from a component's <code>render()</code> method or functional component's return statement. If you need to return multiple elements, you can wrap them in a single parent element, such as a <code>&lt;div&gt;</code>, or use a <code>React.Fragment</code> (which renders without adding an extra node to the DOM).</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Incorrect: Multiple root elements</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// function MyComponent() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">//   return (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">//     &lt;h1&gt;Title&lt;/h1&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">//     &lt;p&gt;Paragraph&lt;/p&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">//   );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Correct: Wrapped in a div</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> MyComponentWithDiv</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Title&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Paragraph&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Correct: Wrapped in a React.Fragment (short syntax: &lt;&gt;&lt;/&gt;)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> MyComponentWithFragment</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Title&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Paragraph&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>CamelCase for HTML Attributes:</strong> Many HTML attributes are written in camelCase in JSX to avoid conflicts with JavaScript reserved keywords. For example, <code>class</code> becomes <code>className</code>, and <code>for</code> becomes <code>htmlFor</code>. This also applies to custom data attributes like <code>data-id</code>, which remain as <code>data-id</code>.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> ButtonWithClass</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // className is used instead of class</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> className</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"primary-button"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> alert</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Clicked!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">)}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      Click Me</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> LabelExample</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* htmlFor is used for the 'for' attribute */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> htmlFor</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"myInput"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Enter your name:&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"text"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"myInput"</span><span style="color:#24292E"> /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Self-Closing Tags:</strong> If an HTML element has no children, you must close it with a forward slash (<code>/</code>) at the end of its opening tag, similar to XML. Examples include <code>&lt;img&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;input&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;br&gt;</code>, etc.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> ProfileCard</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;User Profile&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">img</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> src</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"profile.jpg"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> alt</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"User Avatar"</span><span style="color:#24292E"> /&gt; {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Self-closing img tag */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;This is a description.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"text"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> placeholder</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Enter details"</span><span style="color:#24292E"> /&gt; {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Self-closing input tag */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">br</span><span style="color:#24292E"> /&gt; {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Self-closing break tag */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Embedding JavaScript Expressions:</strong> You can embed any valid JavaScript expression inside JSX by enclosing it in curly braces <code>{}</code>. This allows for dynamic content rendering, calculations, and conditional logic directly within your UI structure.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> DynamicContent</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> userName</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Alice"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> userAge</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 30</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> isLoggedIn</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> true</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Embedding a variable */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Welcome, {userName}!&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Embedding a calculation */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Next year you will be {userAge </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#24292E">} years old.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Embedding a conditional expression */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {isLoggedIn </span><span style="color:#D73A49">?</span><span style="color:#24292E"> &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;You are logged in.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt; </span><span style="color:#D73A49">:</span><span style="color:#24292E"> &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Please log in.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Calling a function */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Current time: {</span><span style="color:#D73A49">new</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> Date</span><span style="color:#24292E">().</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toLocaleTimeString</span><span style="color:#24292E">()}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>When embedding JavaScript, be aware that you cannot directly use <code>if...else</code> statements or <code>for</code> loops inside JSX curly braces. Instead, you use ternary operators for conditionals, or map arrays for lists of elements.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3>JSX Under the Hood</h3>
<p>When a browser reads your React code, it doesn't directly understand JSX. JSX is first transformed by a transpiler like Babel into regular JavaScript function calls. For example, the JSX:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> element</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Hello, world!&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>is compiled into:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> element</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">createElement</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">"h1"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">null</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Hello, world!"</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>And a more complex example:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"https://example.com"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> className</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"link"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  Visit Example</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>becomes:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">React.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">createElement</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">  "a"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    href: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"https://example.com"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    className: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"link"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">  "Visit Example"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This <code>React.createElement()</code> function creates a JavaScript object that describes the element, its properties (props), and its children. React then uses these objects to efficiently update the actual DOM. This process is part of what makes React declarative and performant.</p>
<h2>Practical Examples of Components and JSX</h2>
<p>Let's look at more comprehensive examples of how components are built and how JSX is used within them.</p>
<h3>Example 1: Basic User Profile Card</h3>
<p>We'll create a <code>UserProfile</code> component that displays a user's name, age, and a short bio.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// UserProfile.js</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Functional component to display user profile information</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> UserProfile</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">props</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // Destructuring props for easier access</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">name</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">age</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">bio</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">imageUrl</span><span style="color:#24292E"> } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> props;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> className</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"user-profile-card"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Display user image, using alt text for accessibility (Module 1, Module 7) */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">img</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> src</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{imageUrl} </span><span style="color:#6F42C1">alt</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Profile picture of ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">name</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">} </span><span style="color:#6F42C1">className</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"profile-picture"</span><span style="color:#24292E"> /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Display user's name */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> className</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"user-name"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;{name}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Display user's bio */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> className</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"user-bio"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;{bio}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {props.isActive </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&amp;&amp;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">span</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> className</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"status-indicator"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Active&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">span</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> UserProfile;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// App.js (Root component to use UserProfile)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> UserProfile </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> './UserProfile'</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Import the component</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> App</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> userData</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    name: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"John Doe"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    age: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">28</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    imageUrl: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"https://via.placeholder.com/150"</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Placeholder image URL</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> className</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"app-container"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;My React Application&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Using the UserProfile component and passing data as props */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5">UserProfile</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        name</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{userData.name}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        age</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{userData.age}</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        imageUrl</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{userData.imageUrl}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        isActive</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{userData.isActive}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Reusing the component with different data */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5">UserProfile</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        name</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Jane Smith"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        age</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{</span><span style="color:#005CC5">34</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        bio</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Experienced project manager, transitioning into full-stack development."</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        imageUrl</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"https://via.placeholder.com/150/FF0000"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        isActive</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{</span><span style="color:#005CC5">false</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> App;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this example:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>UserProfile</code> is a functional component.</li>
<li>It accepts <code>props</code> (<code>name</code>, <code>age</code>, <code>bio</code>, <code>imageUrl</code>, <code>isActive</code>) to make it reusable.</li>
<li>JSX is used to structure the HTML-like output, including <code>img</code> (self-closing), <code>h2</code>, and <code>p</code> tags.</li>
<li>Curly braces <code>{}</code> embed JavaScript variables (<code>name</code>, <code>age</code>, <code>bio</code>, <code>imageUrl</code>) directly into the JSX.</li>
<li><code>className</code> is used instead of <code>class</code> for CSS styling (refer back to Module 2 for CSS concepts).</li>
<li><code>alt</code> attribute for <code>img</code> tags is crucial for accessibility, as discussed in Semantic HTML (Module 1) and will be further explored in Website Accessibility Considerations (Module 7).</li>
</ul>
<h3>Example 2: Simple Product Display</h3>
<p>Let's create a <code>ProductCard</code> component to display product information.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">          description</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Immersive gaming headset with virtual surround sound and a noise-cancelling microphone."</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">          inStock</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{</span><span style="color:#005CC5">true</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        /&gt;</span></span>

<p>In this <code>ProductCard</code> example:</p>
<ul>
<li>We use a ternary operator <code>inStock ? ... : ...</code> within JSX to conditionally render different text and styles for the stock status. This is a common pattern for conditional rendering in React.</li>
<li>An inline style object is used for the button for demonstration, but for more complex styling, external CSS files and <code>className</code> are typically preferred (Module 2: CSS Styling and Layout).</li>
<li>The <code>price.toFixed(2)</code> JavaScript method is used directly within JSX to format the number, showing the power of embedding expressions.</li>
</ul>
<p>These examples illustrate how functional components accept data through <code>props</code> and how JSX is used to construct the UI dynamically based on that data, creating reusable and modular elements.</p>
<h2>Exercises and Practice Activities</h2>
<p>Practice creating your own React components using JSX. These exercises will help solidify your understanding of component structure and JSX syntax.</p>
<h3>Exercise 1: Create a Blog Post Component</h3>
<p><strong>Goal:</strong> Build a functional React component that displays a single blog post.</p>
<p><strong>Instructions:</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>Create a new functional component called <code>BlogPost</code>.</li>
<li>The <code>BlogPost</code> component should accept the following props:
<ul>
<li><code>title</code> (string)</li>
<li><code>author</code> (string)</li>
<li><code>date</code> (string, e.g., "October 26, 2023")</li>
<li><code>content</code> (string)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Inside the <code>BlogPost</code> component, use JSX to render:
<ul>
<li>An <code>&lt;h2&gt;</code> tag for the <code>title</code>.</li>
<li>A <code>&lt;p&gt;</code> tag for the <code>author</code> and <code>date</code>, combined into a single line (e.g., "By Author on Date").</li>
<li>A <code>&lt;p&gt;</code> tag for the <code>content</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>In your <code>App.js</code> (or a similar root component), import <code>BlogPost</code> and render it twice, passing different data for each instance.</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Example Output Structure:</strong></p>

<h3>Exercise 2: Build a Notification Component</h3>
<p><strong>Goal:</strong> Create a reusable notification component that can display different types of messages.</p>
<p><strong>Instructions:</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>Create a new functional component called <code>Notification</code>.</li>
<li>The <code>Notification</code> component should accept the following props:
<ul>
<li><code>message</code> (string)</li>
<li><code>type</code> (string, either "success", "warning", or "error")</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Inside the <code>Notification</code> component's JSX:
<ul>
<li>Display the <code>message</code> inside a <code>&lt;div&gt;</code> tag.</li>
<li>Conditionally add a <code>className</code> to the <code>div</code> based on the <code>type</code> prop. For example, if <code>type</code> is "success", the <code>className</code> should be "notification success". If "warning", it should be "notification warning", and so on. (You won't create the CSS for these classes in this exercise, just apply the class names.)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>In your <code>App.js</code>, render the <code>Notification</code> component at least three times, demonstrating each <code>type</code> ("success", "warning", "error") with different messages.</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Example Output Structure (for <code>type="success"</code>):</strong></p>

<div id="chapter-5.2">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">React State and Props: Managing Data</h1><p>React components require mechanisms to manage data that influences their rendering and behavior. Two fundamental concepts for this in React are <code>State</code> and <code>Props</code>. These are the primary ways data flows through your React application, dictating how components interact and update.</p>
<h2>Understanding Component Data Flow</h2>
<p>In React, components are designed to be encapsulated and reusable. Data typically flows in one direction, from parent components to child components. This unidirectional data flow makes it easier to understand how changes in data affect your application's UI.</p>
<h3>Props: Passing Data Down</h3>
<p><code>Props</code> (short for properties) are how you pass data from a parent component to a child component. They are read-only, meaning a child component cannot directly modify the props it receives from its parent. This immutability ensures that components only render based on the data they are explicitly given, preventing unexpected side effects.</p>
<p>When you define a React component, you can specify what props it expects. For functional components, props are passed as the first argument to the function.</p>
<p>Consider a simple <code>WelcomeMessage</code> component that displays a greeting.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// WelcomeMessage.jsx</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> WelcomeMessage</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">props</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // props will be an object like { name: 'Alice' }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Hello, {props.name}!&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> WelcomeMessage;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>To use this component, a parent component would pass a <code>name</code> prop:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// App.jsx</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> WelcomeMessage </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> './WelcomeMessage'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> App</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5">WelcomeMessage</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Alice"</span><span style="color:#24292E"> /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5">WelcomeMessage</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> name</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Bob"</span><span style="color:#24292E"> /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> App;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this example:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>App</code> is the parent component.</li>
<li><code>WelcomeMessage</code> is the child component.</li>
<li><code>App</code> passes different <code>name</code> props ("Alice" and "Bob") to two instances of <code>WelcomeMessage</code>.</li>
<li><code>WelcomeMessage</code> receives these <code>name</code> props and uses them to render the greeting.</li>
</ul>
<p>Props can be of any JavaScript data type: strings, numbers, booleans, arrays, objects, and even functions.</p>
<p><strong>Example with multiple props:</strong></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// ProductCard.jsx</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> ProductCard</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">props</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> style</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{{ border: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'1px solid gray'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, padding: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'10px'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, margin: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'10px'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> }}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;{props.productName}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Price: ${props.price.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toFixed</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">)}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;In Stock: {props.inStock </span><span style="color:#D73A49">?</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'Yes'</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> :</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'No'</span><span style="color:#24292E">}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> ProductCard;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Parent component using <code>ProductCard</code>:</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5">ProductCard</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> productName</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Keyboard"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> price</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{</span><span style="color:#005CC5">75.00</span><span style="color:#24292E">} </span><span style="color:#6F42C1">inStock</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{</span><span style="color:#005CC5">true</span><span style="color:#24292E">} /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
