<p>Here, <code>ProductCard</code> receives <code>productName</code>, <code>price</code>, and <code>inStock</code> as props, allowing it to display varied product information without needing to manage that data itself. It's simply <em>displaying</em> the data it receives.</p>
<h3>State: Managing Component-Specific Data</h3>
<p><code>State</code> refers to data that is managed <em>within</em> a component and can change over time. Unlike props, which are passed down from a parent and are read-only, state is internal to a component and can be updated by the component itself. When a component's state changes, React re-renders that component and its children that depend on the changed state.</p>
<p>In modern React, state is typically managed in functional components using the <code>useState</code> Hook. (We will cover <code>useState</code> in detail in an upcoming lesson, but we'll use it here to demonstrate state concepts.)</p>
<p>Consider a <code>Counter</code> component that needs to keep track of a number that can be incremented or decremented. This number is specific to the <code>Counter</code> instance and can change.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Counter.jsx</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React, { useState } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Import useState hook</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> Counter</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // Declare a state variable 'count' and a function to update it 'setCount'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // Initial value of count is 0</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">count</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setCount</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> increment</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // setCount updates the 'count' state</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setCount</span><span style="color:#24292E">(count </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> decrement</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setCount</span><span style="color:#24292E">(count </span><span style="color:#D73A49">-</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Count: {count}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{increment}&gt;Increment&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{decrement}&gt;Decrement&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> Counter;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this <code>Counter</code> component:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>count</code> is a state variable initialized to <code>0</code>.</li>
<li><code>setCount</code> is the function used to update the <code>count</code>.</li>
<li>When the "Increment" button is clicked, <code>setCount(count + 1)</code> is called, updating the <code>count</code> state.</li>
<li>When the "Decrement" button is clicked, <code>setCount(count - 1)</code> is called, updating the <code>count</code> state.</li>
<li>Each time <code>setCount</code> is called, React re-renders the <code>Counter</code> component, displaying the new <code>count</code> value.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>State vs. Props Summary:</strong></p>
<table><thead><tr><th style="text-align: left;">Feature</th><th style="text-align: left;">Props</th><th style="text-align: left;">State</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Data Source</strong></td><td style="text-align: left;">Passed from a parent component</td><td style="text-align: left;">Managed internally by the component</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Mutability</strong></td><td style="text-align: left;">Read-only; cannot be changed by child</td><td style="text-align: left;">Can be updated by the component itself</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Purpose</strong></td><td style="text-align: left;">Configuration, static data, callbacks</td><td style="text-align: left;">Dynamic data that changes over time</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Ownership</strong></td><td style="text-align: left;">Owned by the parent component</td><td style="text-align: left;">Owned by the component itself</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Flow</strong></td><td style="text-align: left;">Unidirectional (parent to child)</td><td style="text-align: left;">Internal to the component</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h2>Practical Examples</h2>
<p>Let's combine <code>State</code> and <code>Props</code> in a more complex scenario. Imagine building a simple "Todo List" application.</p>
<p>We'll have an <code>App</code> component that manages the list of todos (state) and an individual <code>TodoItem</code> component that displays each todo (props).</p>
<h3>Example 1: Basic Todo List</h3>
<p>First, define the <code>TodoItem</code> component. It will receive the <code>todoText</code> and <code>isCompleted</code> status as props.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// TodoItem.jsx</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> TodoItem</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">props</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // Destructure props for cleaner code</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">todoText</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">isCompleted</span><span style="color:#24292E"> } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> props;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> style</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{{ textDecoration: isCompleted </span><span style="color:#D73A49">?</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'line-through'</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> :</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'none'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> }}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {todoText} {isCompleted </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&amp;&amp;</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '(Completed)'</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> TodoItem;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Next, the <code>TodoList</code> component will manage the array of todo items in its state. It will render multiple <code>TodoItem</code> components, passing the relevant data as props to each.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// TodoList.jsx</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React, { useState } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> TodoItem </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> './TodoItem'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    { id: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">, text: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Understand React Props'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, completed: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">true</span><span style="color:#24292E"> },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    { id: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#24292E">, text: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Build a simple component'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, completed: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">false</span><span style="color:#24292E"> },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  ]);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;My Todo List&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Map over the 'todos' array in state to render TodoItem components */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        {todos.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">map</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">todo</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        ))}</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> TodoList;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this setup:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>TodoList</code> component holds the array of <code>todos</code> in its internal <code>state</code>.</li>
<li>It iterates over this <code>todos</code> array using <code>map</code>.</li>
<li>For each <code>todo</code> object in the array, it creates a <code>TodoItem</code> component.</li>
<li>The <code>text</code> and <code>completed</code> properties of each <code>todo</code> object are passed down as <code>todoText</code> and <code>isCompleted</code> <code>props</code> to the <code>TodoItem</code> component.</li>
<li><code>TodoItem</code> simply renders the data it receives via <code>props</code>. It doesn't know or care about the overall list of todos; it just displays one item.</li>
</ul>
<p>This demonstrates a clear separation of concerns: <code>TodoList</code> manages the collection of data (state), and <code>TodoItem</code> is responsible for presenting individual pieces of data (props).</p>
<h3>Example 2: Interactive User Profile Card</h3>
<p>Let's create a <code>UserProfile</code> component that displays user information. The <code>UserProfile</code> component will manage its own internal state for an "edit mode," while receiving the actual user data as props.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// UserProfile.jsx</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React, { useState } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // State to toggle edit mode</span></span>

<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // Destructure user data from props</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">name</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">email</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">bio</span><span style="color:#24292E"> } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> props;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleEditToggle</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setIsEditing</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">isEditing); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Toggle the state of isEditing</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> style</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{{ border: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'1px solid #ccc'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, padding: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'20px'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, margin: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'20px'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, borderRadius: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'8px'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> }}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {isEditing </span><span style="color:#D73A49">?</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Name: &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"text"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> defaultValue</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{name} /&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{handleEditToggle}&gt;Save&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      ) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">:</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Render display mode when not editing</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;{name}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Email: {email}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Bio: {bio}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{handleEditToggle}&gt;Edit Profile&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      )}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> UserProfile;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Now, a parent component can use <code>UserProfile</code> and pass different user data to it.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Dashboard.jsx</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> UserProfile </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> './UserProfile'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    name: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Jane Smith"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Welcome to your Dashboard!&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5">UserProfile</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span><span style="color:#D73A49">...</span><span style="color:#24292E">currentUser} /&gt; {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Spread operator to pass all properties as props */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5">UserProfile</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span><span style="color:#D73A49">...</span><span style="color:#24292E">anotherUser} /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<p>In this example:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>UserProfile</code> receives <code>name</code>, <code>email</code>, and <code>bio</code> as <code>props</code> from <code>Dashboard</code>. This data <em>comes from outside</em> the <code>UserProfile</code> component.</li>
<li><code>UserProfile</code> manages its own <code>isEditing</code> <code>state</code>. This state dictates whether the component shows the user's details or an editable form. This data is <em>internal</em> to <code>UserProfile</code>.</li>
<li>When the "Edit Profile" or "Save" button is clicked, the <code>isEditing</code> state is toggled, causing <code>UserProfile</code> to re-render and switch between its display and edit modes. Notice that changing <code>isEditing</code> state does not affect the <code>name</code>, <code>email</code>, or <code>bio</code> props received.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Exercises</h2>
<p>Complete the following exercises to solidify your understanding of React State and Props. You will build upon the previous examples.</p>
<h3>Exercise 1: Extend the Todo List with an "Add Todo" Feature</h3>
<p>Modify the <code>TodoList</code> component to include an input field and a button to add new todo items to the list.</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Create a new state variable</strong> in <code>TodoList</code> to store the text of the new todo item currently being typed into the input field.</li>
<li><strong>Add an input element</strong> to <code>TodoList</code> and bind its <code>value</code> to this new state variable.</li>
<li><strong>Add an <code>onChange</code> handler</strong> to the input field to update the new todo text state as the user types.</li>
<li><strong>Add a button</strong> with an <code>onClick</code> handler. When clicked, this handler should:
<ul>
<li>Create a new todo object using the text from the input state.</li>
<li>Generate a unique <code>id</code> for the new todo (e.g., <code>Date.now()</code>).</li>
<li>Add this new todo object to the <code>todos</code> array in state (remember to create a <em>new</em> array and then call <code>setTodos</code>).</li>
<li>Clear the input field by resetting its corresponding state.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Hint:</strong> When updating state that depends on the previous state (like adding to an array), it's best practice to pass a function to the state setter: <code>setTodos(prevTodos =&gt; [...prevTodos, newTodo]);</code></p>
<h3>Exercise 2: Make Todo Items Toggleable</h3>
<p>Modify the <code>TodoItem</code> component and <code>TodoList</code> to allow toggling the <code>completed</code> status of individual todo items.</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Modify <code>TodoItem.jsx</code></strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>Add a checkbox input next to the todo text.</li>
<li>The <code>checked</code> attribute of the checkbox should reflect the <code>isCompleted</code> prop.</li>
<li>Add an <code>onChange</code> handler to the checkbox. This handler will need to <em>communicate up</em> to the parent (<code>TodoList</code>) that its <code>completed</code> status should change. To do this, <code>TodoItem</code> will need to receive a <em>function</em> as a prop from <code>TodoList</code>. Let's call this prop <code>onToggleComplete</code>.</li>
<li>When the checkbox is clicked, call <code>props.onToggleComplete</code> and pass the <code>id</code> of the todo item back to the parent.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Modify <code>TodoList.jsx</code></strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>Define a new function, e.g., <code>handleToggleComplete</code>, within <code>TodoList</code>. This function will receive the <code>id</code> of the todo item to be toggled.</li>
<li>Inside <code>handleToggleComplete</code>, use <code>setTodos</code> to update the <code>todos</code> array. Find the todo item with the matching <code>id</code> and <em>create a new todo object</em> with its <code>completed</code> status flipped. Remember to create a <em>new</em> array for <code>setTodos</code>.</li>
<li>Pass this <code>handleToggleComplete</code> function down to each <code>TodoItem</code> as the <code>onToggleComplete</code> prop. You'll also need to pass the <code>id</code> of each todo item as a prop to <code>TodoItem</code> so it can communicate back which item was clicked.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
  
</div>

<div id="chapter-5.3">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Handling Events in React Components</h1><p>React components need to respond to user interactions like clicks, keyboard input, or form submissions to create dynamic and interactive user interfaces. This involves handling events, which are actions or occurrences that happen in the system being programmed. React uses a synthetic event system that wraps browser native events, providing a consistent cross-browser interface.</p>
<h2>Understanding React's Synthetic Event System</h2>
<p>React implements its own event system, known as the Synthetic Event system. This system normalizes events across different browsers, meaning that events behave identically in Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and other browsers, even if their native implementations differ. When an event occurs on a DOM element in a React application, React doesn't attach event listeners directly to the DOM elements themselves. Instead, it attaches a single event listener to the root of the document. This listener then delegates events to the appropriate component based on the event's origin.</p>
<p>The event objects passed to event handlers in React are instances of <code>SyntheticEvent</code>, not native browser event objects. These <code>SyntheticEvent</code> objects have the same interface as the browser's native event objects (e.g., <code>stopPropagation()</code>, <code>preventDefault()</code>), but they are pooled for performance. This means that a <code>SyntheticEvent</code> object might be reused across multiple events, and its properties will be nullified after the event handler has been executed. If an event object's properties are needed asynchronously (e.g., inside a <code>setTimeout</code> callback), <code>event.persist()</code> must be called to prevent the object from being pooled and its properties cleared.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> ButtonClicker</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#E36209">event</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // event is a SyntheticEvent object</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Button clicked!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, event.target.tagName);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Native event:'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, event.nativeEvent); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Access the underlying native browser event</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // event.preventDefault() stops the default browser action (e.g., form submission)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // event.stopPropagation() prevents the event from bubbling up to parent elements</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{handleClick}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      Click Me</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In the example above, <code>handleClick</code> receives a <code>SyntheticEvent</code> object. We can access standard event properties like <code>target</code> and also the underlying <code>nativeEvent</code> if needed, although it's generally best practice to work with the <code>SyntheticEvent</code>.</p>
<h2>Attaching Event Handlers</h2>
<p>In React, event handlers are attached directly to JSX elements using camelCase attribute names, similar to how inline event handlers work in HTML, but with a JavaScript function reference instead of a string. This differs from standard HTML where event names are typically lowercase (e.g., <code>onclick</code>). React's event names follow the camelCase convention (e.g., <code>onClick</code>, <code>onChange</code>, <code>onSubmit</code>).</p>
<p>When you assign an event handler, you pass a function reference, not a function call. For example, <code>onClick={handleClick}</code> passes the <code>handleClick</code> function itself, so React can call it when the event occurs. If you write <code>onClick={handleClick()}</code>, the function would be called immediately during rendering, and its return value (if any) would be assigned as the event handler, which is usually not the desired behavior.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> MyComponent</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // Define the event handler function</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleButtonClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    alert</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Button was clicked!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleInputChange</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#E36209">event</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Access the value of the input field from event.target.value</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Input value changed:'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, event.target.value);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleFormSubmit</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#E36209">event</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    event.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">preventDefault</span><span style="color:#24292E">(); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Prevent default form submission behavior (page reload)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Form submitted!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Attaching a click handler to a button */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{handleButtonClick}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        Click Me</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Attaching a change handler to an input field */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"text"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onChange</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{handleInputChange} </span><span style="color:#6F42C1">placeholder</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Type something..."</span><span style="color:#24292E"> /&gt;</span></span>
