<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">form</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onSubmit</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{handleFormSubmit}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"text"</span><span style="color:#24292E"> /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"submit"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Submit Form&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">form</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> MyComponent;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In the example:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>handleButtonClick</code> is called when the button is clicked.</li>
<li><code>handleInputChange</code> is called every time the value of the input field changes. The event object provides access to the new value via <code>event.target.value</code>.</li>
<li><code>handleFormSubmit</code> is called when the form is submitted. <code>event.preventDefault()</code> is crucial here to stop the browser's default behavior of reloading the page upon form submission.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Passing Arguments to Event Handlers</h3>
<p>Sometimes, an event handler needs access to additional data beyond the <code>SyntheticEvent</code> object itself. This can be achieved by using an arrow function or <code>Function.prototype.bind()</code> within the JSX.</p>
<h4>Using Arrow Functions (Recommended)</h4>
<p>Using an arrow function in JSX is the most common and readable way to pass extra arguments. The arrow function creates a new function on each render, which then calls the actual event handler with the desired arguments.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> ItemList</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> items</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Apple'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Banana'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Cherry'</span><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleDeleteItem</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#E36209">itemName</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">event</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // The itemName is passed as the first argument, event as the second</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Deleting item: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">itemName</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Event type:'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, event.type); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// e.g., 'click'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {items.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">map</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">item</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> key</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{item}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          {item}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Arrow function passes `item` first, then the `event` object */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{(</span><span style="color:#E36209">event</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleDeleteItem</span><span style="color:#24292E">(item, event)}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            Delete</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      ))}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this example, when the "Delete" button for an item is clicked, the <code>handleDeleteItem</code> function is called with the specific <code>item</code> name and the <code>SyntheticEvent</code> object.</p>
<h4>Using <code>Function.prototype.bind()</code></h4>
<p>Another way to pass arguments is using <code>bind()</code>. <code>bind()</code> creates a new function that, when called, has its <code>this</code> keyword set to a provided value, with a given sequence of arguments preceding any provided when the new function is called.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> ItemListWithBind</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> items</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Apple'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Banana'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Cherry'</span><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleDeleteItem</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#E36209">itemName</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">event</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Deleting item (bind): ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">itemName</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Event type (bind):'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, event.type);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {items.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">map</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">item</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> key</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{item}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          {item}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Using .bind(): null is for `this` context (not needed in functional components),</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">              then `item` as the first argument, event will be appended */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{handleDeleteItem.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">bind</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">null</span><span style="color:#24292E">, item)}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            Delete (Bind)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      ))}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>While <code>bind()</code> works, the arrow function approach is generally preferred in modern React functional components for its clarity and because it avoids potential issues with <code>this</code> context that <code>bind()</code> is primarily designed to address in class components.</p>
<h2>Common Event Types</h2>
<p>React supports a wide range of event types, mirroring standard DOM events. Some of the most frequently used event types include:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Mouse Events:</strong> <code>onClick</code>, <code>onDoubleClick</code>, <code>onMouseDown</code>, <code>onMouseUp</code>, <code>onMouseEnter</code>, <code>onMouseLeave</code>, <code>onMouseMove</code>, <code>onMouseOver</code>, <code>onMouseOut</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Keyboard Events:</strong> <code>onKeyDown</code>, <code>onKeyPress</code>, <code>onKeyUp</code>. These events have properties like <code>event.key</code> (the key pressed, e.g., 'Enter', 'a') and <code>event.keyCode</code> (deprecated) or <code>event.which</code> (deprecated).</li>
<li><strong>Form Events:</strong> <code>onChange</code>, <code>onInput</code>, <code>onSubmit</code>, <code>onFocus</code>, <code>onBlur</code>. <code>onChange</code> is especially important for controlled components to update state.</li>
<li><strong>Touch Events:</strong> <code>onTouchStart</code>, <code>onTouchMove</code>, <code>onTouchEnd</code>, <code>onTouchCancel</code>. Useful for mobile interactions.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Example: Handling Different Event Types</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React, { useState } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> EventExamples</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">inputValue</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setInputValue</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">''</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">keyPressCount</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setKeyPressCount</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleInputChange</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#E36209">event</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setInputValue</span><span style="color:#24292E">(event.target.value);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleKeyDown</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#E36209">event</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Key Down:'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, event.key);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setKeyPressCount</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">prevCount</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> prevCount </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (event.key </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'Enter'</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">      alert</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`You pressed Enter! Current input: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">inputValue</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleFocus</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Input focused!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleBlur</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Input blurred!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleMouseEnterDiv</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Mouse entered the div!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleMouseLeaveDiv</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Mouse left the div!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Input Field Interaction&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        type</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"text"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        value</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{inputValue}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        onChange</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{handleInputChange} </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Fires on every value change</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        onKeyDown</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{handleKeyDown}     </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Fires when a key is pressed down</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        onFocus</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{handleFocus}         </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Fires when the element gains focus</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        onBlur</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{handleBlur}           </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Fires when the element loses focus</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        placeholder</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Type here..."</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Current Input: {inputValue}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Total Key Presses (in this input): {keyPressCount}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Mouse Over/Out Example&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        onMouseEnter</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{handleMouseEnterDiv}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        onMouseLeave</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{handleMouseLeaveDiv}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        style</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{{</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          width: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'200px'</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          height: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'100px'</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          backgroundColor: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'lightblue'</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          marginTop: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'20px'</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          display: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'flex'</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          alignItems: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'center'</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          justifyContent: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'center'</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          border: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'1px solid gray'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        Hover over me!</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> EventExamples;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This example demonstrates how to use <code>onChange</code>, <code>onKeyDown</code>, <code>onFocus</code>, <code>onBlur</code> with an input field, and <code>onMouseEnter</code>, <code>onMouseLeave</code> with a <code>div</code>. The <code>useState</code> hook, introduced in a later lesson, is used here for managing component state (the <code>inputValue</code> and <code>keyPressCount</code>), which is a common practice when handling events to update the UI.</p>
<h2>Preventing Default Behavior</h2>
<p>Many native DOM events have default behaviors. For instance, clicking a link (<code>&lt;a&gt;</code> tag) navigates to a new URL, submitting a form (<code>&lt;form&gt;</code>) reloads the page, and right-clicking typically opens a context menu. In React, you can prevent these default behaviors by calling <code>event.preventDefault()</code> inside your event handler. This is a common and important practice, especially when dealing with forms.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> FormWithPreventDefault</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleSubmit</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#E36209">event</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    event.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">preventDefault</span><span style="color:#24292E">(); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Prevents the browser from reloading the page</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Form submission prevented and handled by React!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Here you would typically send form data to a server or update state</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleAnchorClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#E36209">event</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    event.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">preventDefault</span><span style="color:#24292E">(); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Prevents the browser from navigating to the link</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    alert</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Link click prevented! You would typically perform a React Router navigation here.'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Anchor click prevented!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Form Example&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">form</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onSubmit</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{handleSubmit}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          Name:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"text"</span><span style="color:#24292E"> /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"submit"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Submit&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">form</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Link Example&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"https://example.com"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{handleAnchorClick}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        Click this link (but don't leave this page)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> FormWithPreventDefault;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In the <code>handleSubmit</code> function, <code>event.preventDefault()</code> stops the default HTML form submission, allowing the React component to take control and handle the submission logic (e.g., sending data via an API call). Similarly, <code>handleAnchorClick</code> prevents the browser from navigating away when the link is clicked, which is useful when building Single Page Applications (SPAs) where navigation is handled by a client-side router (like React Router, which you might explore in more advanced courses).</p>
<h2>Exercises</h2>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Simple Click Counter:</strong>
Create a React component named <code>ClickCounter</code>. This component should display a number and a button. When the button is clicked, the number should increment.</p>
<ul>
<li>Initialize a state variable for the count (you can use <code>useState</code> for this, even if it's introduced in the next lesson, consider it a sneak peek and use it for this exercise).</li>
<li>Attach an <code>onClick</code> handler to the button.</li>
<li>Inside the handler, update the state to increment the count.</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Hint:</em></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React, { useState } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>

<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> incrementCount</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setCount</span><span style="color:#24292E">(count </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{incrementCount}&gt;Increment&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> ClickCounter;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Toggle Visibility:</strong>
Create a <code>ToggleMessage</code> component. It should display a button and a paragraph of text. Initially, the paragraph should be hidden. When the button is clicked, the paragraph's visibility should toggle (if hidden, show it; if visible, hide it).</p>
<ul>
<li>Use a state variable (<code>useState</code>) to keep track of the message's visibility (e.g., a boolean <code>isVisible</code>).</li>
<li>Conditionally render the paragraph based on the <code>isVisible</code> state (using an <code>&amp;&amp;</code> operator or a ternary operator in JSX).</li>
<li>Attach an <code>onClick</code> handler to the button to toggle the <code>isVisible</code> state.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Dynamic Item Remover:</strong>
Building on the "Passing Arguments to Event Handlers" section:
Create a component called <code>RemovableList</code>. It should display a list of initial items (e.g., <code>['Task 1', 'Task 2', 'Task 3']</code>). Next to each item, there should be a "Remove" button. When a "Remove" button is clicked, that specific item should be removed from the list.</p>
<ul>
<li>Use <code>useState</code> to manage the list of items.</li>
<li>Map over the items array to render each <code>li</code> and its corresponding "Remove" button.</li>
<li>Attach an <code>onClick</code> handler to each "Remove" button, passing the item's identifier (e.g., its index or name) to the handler.</li>
<li>Inside the handler, filter the current items array to create a new array without the removed item, then update the state with the new array.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>

<div id="chapter-5.4">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">React Hooks: useState and useEffect</h1><p>React Hooks are functions that let you "hook into" React state and lifecycle features from function components. Prior to Hooks, these features were primarily available in class components. <code>useState</code> and <code>useEffect</code> are two fundamental Hooks that enable functional components to manage local state and perform side effects, respectively. This allows for more concise and readable code, especially when dealing with complex component logic.</p>
<h2>Understanding <code>useState</code></h2>
<p><code>useState</code> is a Hook that allows functional components to manage internal, local state. When the state changes, the component re-renders to reflect the new state. It takes an initial state value as an argument and returns an array containing two elements: the current state value and a function to update that state.</p>
<h3>Basic <code>useState</code> Usage</h3>
<p>To use <code>useState</code>, you first import it from the <code>react</code> library.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React, { useState } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> Counter</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // Declare a state variable called 'count' and a function to update it called 'setCount'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // Initialize 'count' with a value of 0</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">count</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setCount</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;You clicked {count} times&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> setCount</span><span style="color:#24292E">(count </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#24292E">)}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        Click me</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> Counter;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this example:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>useState(0)</code> initializes <code>count</code> to <code>0</code>.</li>
<li><code>count</code> holds the current value of the state.</li>
<li><code>setCount</code> is a function that you call to update <code>count</code>. When <code>setCount</code> is called, React re-renders the <code>Counter</code> component with the new <code>count</code> value.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Updating State with <code>useState</code></h3>
<p>When updating state with the setter function, you can pass either the new state value directly or a function that receives the previous state and returns the new state. Using a function is recommended when the new state depends on the previous state, as it guarantees you are working with the most up-to-date state value.</p>
<h4>Direct Value Update</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React, { useState } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> ThemeSwitcher</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">theme</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setTheme</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'light'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Initial theme is 'light'</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> toggleTheme</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Directly set the new theme based on the current theme</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setTheme</span><span style="color:#24292E">(theme </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'light'</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> ?</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'dark'</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> :</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'light'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> style</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{{ background: theme </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'light'</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> ?</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '#fff'</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> :</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '#333'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, color: theme </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'light'</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> ?</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '#000'</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> :</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '#fff'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> }}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Current Theme: {theme}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{toggleTheme}&gt;Toggle Theme&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> ThemeSwitcher;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this scenario, <code>setTheme(theme === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light')</code> directly assigns the new theme. While this works, it can sometimes lead to issues if multiple state updates are batched together by React, especially in highly interactive components.</p>
<h4>Functional Update</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React, { useState } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> ItemQuantity</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">quantity</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setQuantity</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> incrementQuantity</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Use a functional update to ensure we always get the latest 'prevQuantity'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setQuantity</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">prevQuantity</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> prevQuantity </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> decrementQuantity</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Ensure quantity doesn't go below 1</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setQuantity</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">prevQuantity</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> Math.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">max</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">, prevQuantity </span><span style="color:#D73A49">-</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#24292E">));</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Item Quantity: {quantity}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{decrementQuantity}&gt;-&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{incrementQuantity}&gt;+&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> ItemQuantity;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Here, <code>setQuantity(prevQuantity =&gt; prevQuantity + 1)</code> uses a function. React will pass the most recent state (<code>prevQuantity</code>) to this function, ensuring accurate updates even if they are asynchronous or batched. This is a best practice for updates that depend on the previous state.</p>
<h3><code>useState</code> with Objects and Arrays</h3>
<p>When state is an object or an array, you must create a new object or array when updating to trigger a re-render. Directly modifying the existing state object/array will not cause a re-render because React performs a shallow comparison to detect changes.</p>
<h4>Updating an Object</h4>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> UserProfileEditor</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">user</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setUser</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">({</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    age: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">30</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    email: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'jane.doe@example.com'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> newName</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> e.target.value;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Create a *new* object by spreading the old properties and overriding 'name'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setUser</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">prevUser</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> ({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">      ...</span><span style="color:#24292E">prevUser, </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Copy all existing properties from prevUser</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      name: newName </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Update the 'name' property</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }));</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Name: {user.name}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Age: {user.age}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Email: {user.email}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"text"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> value</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{user.name} </span><span style="color:#6F42C1">onChange</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{handleNameChange} /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<p>The spread syntax (<code>...prevUser</code>) is crucial here. It creates a new object with all the existing <code>user</code> properties and then overrides only the <code>name</code> property. Without this, React would not detect a change in the <code>user</code> object's reference and thus would not re-render.</p>
<h4>Updating an Array</h4>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (newTodoText.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">trim</span><span style="color:#24292E">() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> ''</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">return</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> newTodo</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      id: todos.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">length</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> ?</span><span style="color:#24292E"> Math.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">max</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#D73A49">...</span><span style="color:#24292E">todos.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">map</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">todo</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> todo.id)) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> :</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setNewTodoText</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">''</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Map over the array to create a *new* array with the updated todo item</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setTodos</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">prevTodos</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      prevTodos.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">map</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">todo</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        todo.id </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#24292E"> id </span><span style="color:#D73A49">?</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#D73A49">...</span><span style="color:#24292E">todo, completed: </span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">todo.completed } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">:</span><span style="color:#24292E"> todo</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">              type</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"checkbox"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">              checked</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{todo.completed}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">              onChange</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> toggleTodoCompletion</span><span style="color:#24292E">(todo.id)}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            {todo.text}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        ))}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<p>Similar to objects, when updating an array, you must provide a new array. Methods like <code>map</code>, <code>filter</code>, and <code>concat</code> return new arrays, making them suitable for state updates. Directly using <code>push</code> or <code>splice</code> on the existing array reference will not trigger a re-render.</p>
<h2>Introducing <code>useEffect</code></h2>
<p><code>useEffect</code> is a Hook that lets you perform side effects in functional components. Side effects are operations that interact with the "outside world" or have observable effects beyond rendering the component itself. Common side effects include data fetching, manually changing the DOM, setting up subscriptions, or logging. <code>useEffect</code> runs after every render, but you can control when it runs using its dependency array.</p>
<h3>Basic <code>useEffect</code> Usage</h3>
<p><code>useEffect</code> takes two arguments: a function containing the side effect logic and an optional dependency array.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React, { useState, useEffect } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> DocumentTitleUpdater</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">count</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setCount</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // This effect runs after every render</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">  useEffect</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Side effect: update the document title</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    document.title </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62"> `You clicked ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">count</span><span style="color:#032F62">} times`</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// No dependency array: runs after every render</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;You clicked {count} times&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> setCount</span><span style="color:#24292E">(count </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#24292E">)}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        Click me</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>

<p>In this example, the <code>useEffect</code> hook updates the browser's document title. Because no dependency array is provided, this effect will run after <em>every</em> render of the <code>DocumentTitleUpdater</code> component, including the initial render and subsequent re-renders when <code>count</code> changes.</p>
<h3>Controlling <code>useEffect</code> with the Dependency Array</h3>
<p>The second argument to <code>useEffect</code> is an array of dependencies. React will re-run the effect only if any of the values in this array have changed between renders.</p>
<h4>Effect Runs Only Once (Empty Dependency Array)</h4>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">message</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setMessage</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Loading...'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>

<p>An empty dependency array (<code>[]</code>) tells React that the effect does not depend on any values from the component's scope that change over time. Therefore, the effect will only run <em>once</em> after the initial render, mimicking <code>componentDidMount</code> in class components. This is useful for initial data fetching, setting up event listeners, or other one-time operations.</p>

<p>Here, the <code>useEffect</code> hook fetches user data. The dependency array <code>[userId]</code> ensures that the effect runs initially and <em>again whenever the <code>userId</code> prop changes</em>. If <code>userId</code> remains the same between renders, the effect is skipped, preventing unnecessary API calls. This is a common pattern for data fetching based on props or state.</p>
<h3>Cleanup Functions in <code>useEffect</code></h3>
<p>Some side effects, like setting up subscriptions or event listeners, require cleanup to prevent memory leaks or unwanted behavior. The function returned by <code>useEffect</code> is a cleanup function. It runs before the component unmounts and before the effect re-runs due to a dependency change.</p>
