<p>In this example:</p>
<ul>
<li>The effect adds a <code>resize</code> event listener when the component mounts.</li>
<li>The returned cleanup function (<code>return () =&gt; { ... }</code>) removes the event listener. This ensures that the listener is properly detached when the component unmounts, preventing memory leaks.</li>
<li>Since the dependency array is empty, the listener is added once and removed once when the component is removed from the DOM. If there were dependencies, the cleanup would run <em>before</em> the effect re-runs with new dependencies.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Common <code>useEffect</code> Patterns</h3>
<h4>Fetching Data</h4>
<p>This is one of the most common use cases for <code>useEffect</code>. It ensures data is fetched when the component mounts or when specific dependencies change.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React, { useState, useEffect } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> PostList</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">posts</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setPosts</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">([]);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">loading</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setLoading</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">true</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setError</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">null</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">  useEffect</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> fetchPosts</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> async</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">      try</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> response</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> await</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> fetch</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">response.ok) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">          throw</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> Error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`HTTP error! status: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">response</span><span style="color:#032F62">.</span><span style="color:#24292E">status</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> data</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> response.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        setPosts</span><span style="color:#24292E">(data);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (err) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        setError</span><span style="color:#24292E">(err.message);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">finally</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        setLoading</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">false</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    fetchPosts</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }, []); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Empty dependency array means this effect runs only once after initial render</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (loading) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Loading posts...&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (error) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Error: {error}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Blog Posts&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        {posts.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">map</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">post</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">          &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> key</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{post.id}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">strong</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;{post.title}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">strong</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;{post.body.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">substring</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">100</span><span style="color:#24292E">)}...&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>

<p>This example uses <code>async/await</code> within an immediately invoked async function inside <code>useEffect</code> to fetch data from a public API. The empty dependency array ensures the data is fetched only once when the component mounts. Error handling and loading states are also included, which are crucial for user experience.</p>
<h4>Timers and Intervals</h4>
<p>Setting up and clearing timers is another common side effect.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React, { useState, useEffect } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> Timer</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">seconds</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setSeconds</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">  useEffect</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> intervalId</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> setInterval</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">      setSeconds</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">prevSeconds</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> prevSeconds </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1000</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Cleanup function to clear the interval when the component unmounts</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">      clearInterval</span><span style="color:#24292E">(intervalId);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    };</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }, []); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Empty dependency array: interval starts once, clears once</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Timer: {seconds} seconds&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> Timer;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Here, <code>setInterval</code> is used to update the <code>seconds</code> state every second. The cleanup function returned by <code>useEffect</code> calls <code>clearInterval</code> to stop the timer when the component unmounts, preventing it from continuing to run in the background and causing memory leaks or errors.</p>
<h2>Exercises</h2>
<p>Complete the following exercises to practice using <code>useState</code> and <code>useEffect</code>.</p>
<h3>Exercise 1: Click Tracker with <code>useState</code></h3>
<p>Create a component that displays a button and a count. Each time the button is clicked, increment the count. Additionally, add a second button that resets the count to 0.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Start with this basic structure</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React, { useState } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> ClickTracker</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // Your state and logic here</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">count</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setCount</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> increment</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setCount</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">prevCount</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> prevCount </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> reset</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setCount</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Clicks: {count}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{increment}&gt;Click Me&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>

<h3>Exercise 2: User Input Display with <code>useState</code></h3>
<p>Create a component with an input field and a paragraph. As the user types into the input field, the text in the paragraph should update in real-time to display the current input value.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React, { useState } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> UserInputDisplay</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>

<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Start with this basic structure</span></span>

<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> SimpleLogger</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">count</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setCount</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">  useEffect</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Component rendered. Current count: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">count</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// No dependency array</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Count: {count}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> setCount</span><span style="color:#24292E">(count </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#24292E">)}&gt;Increment&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">  useEffect</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>

<h2>Practical Demonstrations</h2>
<p>We'll continue with the theme of building dynamic user interfaces that respond to user actions and external data.</p>
<h3>Dynamic Shopping Cart Item Counter</h3>
<p>Imagine building an e-commerce site where users can adjust the quantity of an item in their cart. <code>useState</code> is perfect for managing the local quantity of an individual item.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React, { useState } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> ShoppingCartItem</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ </span><span style="color:#E36209">initialQuantity</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">itemName</span><span style="color:#24292E"> }) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">quantity</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setQuantity</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">(initialQuantity);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setQuantity</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">prevQuantity</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> prevQuantity </span><span style="color:#D73A49">+</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> decrementQuantity</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setQuantity</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">prevQuantity</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> Math.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">max</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">, prevQuantity </span><span style="color:#D73A49">-</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 1</span><span style="color:#24292E">)); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Quantity cannot go below 1</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> style</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{{ border: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'1px solid #ccc'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, padding: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'10px'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, margin: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'10px'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> }}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h4</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;{itemName}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h4</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Quantity: {quantity}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{decrementQuantity}&gt;-&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{incrementQuantity}&gt;+&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> ShoppingCartItem;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// To use this component in your App.js:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// &lt;ShoppingCartItem itemName="React T-Shirt" initialQuantity={2} /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// &lt;ShoppingCartItem itemName="JS Mug" /&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This component demonstrates <code>useState</code> managing the <code>quantity</code> for a single cart item. The <code>incrementQuantity</code> and <code>decrementQuantity</code> functions use the functional update form of <code>setQuantity</code> to ensure updates are based on the latest state.</p>
<h3>User Status Indicator (Online/Offline) with <code>useEffect</code></h3>
<p>Consider a chat application where you want to show a user's online status. <code>useEffect</code> can be used to simulate subscription to an external service and clean it up.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React, { useState, useEffect } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Imagine this is an external library or API simulating a user status service</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> userStatusService</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">  subscribe</span><span style="color:#24292E">: (</span><span style="color:#E36209">userId</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">callback</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Subscribing to user ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">userId</span><span style="color:#032F62">} status...`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Simulate async status update</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> intervalId</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> setInterval</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">      const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> isOnline</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> Math.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">random</span><span style="color:#24292E">() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&gt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0.5</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Randomly switch status</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">      callback</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ userId, isOnline });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">3000</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> intervalId; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Return ID to clear later</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">  unsubscribe</span><span style="color:#24292E">: (</span><span style="color:#E36209">intervalId</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Unsubscribing from status service (ID: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">intervalId</span><span style="color:#032F62">}).`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    clearInterval</span><span style="color:#24292E">(intervalId);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">};</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> UserStatus</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ </span><span style="color:#E36209">userId</span><span style="color:#24292E"> }) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">isOnline</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setIsOnline</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">false</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">statusMessage</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setStatusMessage</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Checking status...'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">  useEffect</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Effect for User ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">userId</span><span style="color:#032F62">} running.`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleStatusChange</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#E36209">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">      setIsOnline</span><span style="color:#24292E">(status.isOnline);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">      setStatusMessage</span><span style="color:#24292E">(status.isOnline </span><span style="color:#D73A49">?</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'Online'</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> :</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'Offline'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Subscribe to the service</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> subscriptionId</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> userStatusService.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">subscribe</span><span style="color:#24292E">(userId, handleStatusChange);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Return cleanup function</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Cleaning up subscription for User ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">userId</span><span style="color:#032F62">}.`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      userStatusService.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">unsubscribe</span><span style="color:#24292E">(subscriptionId);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    };</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }, [userId]); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Re-subscribe if userId changes</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> style</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{{ border: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'1px solid #ddd'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, padding: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'10px'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, margin: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'10px'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, backgroundColor: isOnline </span><span style="color:#D73A49">?</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '#e6ffe6'</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> :</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '#ffeeee'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> }}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h4</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;User ID: {userId}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h4</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Status: &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">strong</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> style</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{{ color: isOnline </span><span style="color:#D73A49">?</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'green'</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> :</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'red'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> }}&gt;{statusMessage}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">strong</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> UserStatus;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// To use this component in your App.js:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// &lt;UserStatus userId={123} /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// &lt;UserStatus userId={456} /&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This <code>UserStatus</code> component uses <code>useEffect</code> to simulate subscribing to a user status service. When the <code>userId</code> prop changes, the component first unsubscribes from the old user's status and then subscribes to the new user's status. The cleanup function (<code>return () =&gt; { ... }</code>) is crucial here to prevent multiple subscriptions or memory leaks.</p>
<h2>Summary and Next Steps</h2>
<p>This lesson provided a comprehensive introduction to two of the most fundamental React Hooks: <code>useState</code> and <code>useEffect</code>. We explored how <code>useState</code> allows functional components to manage local, reactive state, including handling primitive values, objects, and arrays. We also delved into <code>useEffect</code>, understanding its role in performing side effects, how to control its execution with a dependency array, and the importance of cleanup functions for managing resources like event listeners and timers.</p>
<p>You should now be comfortable with:</p>
<ul>
<li>Declaring and updating state in functional components using <code>useState</code>.</li>
<li>Performing side effects like DOM manipulation, data fetching, and subscriptions with <code>useEffect</code>.</li>
<li>Controlling when <code>useEffect</code> runs using its dependency array (empty array for mount, specific dependencies for updates, no array for every render).</li>
<li>Implementing cleanup functions in <code>useEffect</code> to prevent memory leaks and manage resources.</li>
</ul>
  
</div>

<div id="chapter-5.5">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Conditional Rendering and Lists in React</h1><p>In React, applications often need to display different UI elements or entire sections based on certain conditions, or render lists of items dynamically. This lesson covers how to achieve these fundamental patterns using conditional rendering techniques and how to efficiently display collections of data using lists.</p>
<h2>Conditional Rendering</h2>
<p>Conditional rendering in React allows components to render different output based on the current state, props, or other conditions. This is a core concept for building dynamic user interfaces where elements appear or disappear, or change their content, based on user interactions, data availability, or application logic.</p>
<h3>Using <code>if</code> Statements</h3>
<p>The most straightforward way to implement conditional rendering is by using standard JavaScript <code>if</code> statements inside your functional components or within the render method of class components.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> UserGreeting</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">props</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> isLoggedIn</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> props.isLoggedIn; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Assuming isLoggedIn is a boolean prop</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (isLoggedIn) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Welcome back!&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Render this if true</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Please sign up.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Render this if false</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> LoginControl</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">isLoggedIn</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setIsLoggedIn</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">false</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Using useState hook</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleLoginClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setIsLoggedIn</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">true</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleLogoutClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setIsLoggedIn</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">false</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> button;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (isLoggedIn) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    button </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{handleLogoutClick}&gt;Logout&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    button </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{handleLoginClick}&gt;Login&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5">UserGreeting</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> isLoggedIn</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{isLoggedIn} /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {button}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> LoginControl;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In the <code>UserGreeting</code> component, an <code>if</code> statement checks the <code>isLoggedIn</code> prop. Based on its value, it returns one of two different <code>&lt;h2&gt;</code> elements. In the <code>LoginControl</code> component, an <code>if/else</code> block determines which button (<code>Login</code> or <code>Logout</code>) to assign to the <code>button</code> variable, and then that variable is rendered.</p>
<h3>Conditional Rendering with Logical <code>&amp;&amp;</code> Operator</h3>
<p>You can embed JavaScript expressions within JSX using curly braces <code>{}</code>. The JavaScript logical <code>&amp;&amp;</code> (AND) operator can be used for concisely rendering an element or component <em>only if</em> a condition is true. If the condition before <code>&amp;&amp;</code> is <code>true</code>, the element after <code>&amp;&amp;</code> will be rendered. If the condition is <code>false</code>, React ignores and skips the element.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> messages</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#032F62">'React'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Re: React'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Re:Re: React'</span><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>

If <code>unreadMessages</code> is an empty array, the condition <code>unreadMessages.length &gt; 0</code> evaluates to <code>false</code>, and the <code>&lt;h2&gt;</code> element is not rendered. This is a common pattern for showing or hiding notifications or alerts.</p>
<h3>Conditional Rendering with Ternary Operator (<code>condition ? true : false</code>)</h3>
<p>The ternary operator is another concise way to express conditional rendering directly within JSX. It allows you to choose between two expressions based on a condition.</p>

<h3>Preventing Component Rendering</h3>
<p>In some cases, you might want to prevent a component from rendering at all. Returning <code>null</code> from a component's render method (or directly from a functional component) will cause it to render nothing.</p>

<p>The <code>WarningBanner</code> component checks its <code>warn</code> prop. If <code>warn</code> is <code>false</code>, it returns <code>null</code>, and nothing is rendered on the screen for that component. <h2>Rendering Lists</h2>
<p>React provides an efficient way to render lists of items. When rendering lists, it's crucial to assign a unique <code>key</code> prop to each list item. Keys help React identify which items have changed, been added, or been removed, making the rendering process more efficient and preventing unexpected behavior, especially when the order of items changes or items are added/deleted.</p>
<h3>Basic List Rendering</h3>
<p>To render a collection of items, you typically use the JavaScript <code>map()</code> array method. The <code>map()</code> method iterates over an array and returns a new array containing the results of calling a provided function on every element in the original array. In React, you use <code>map()</code> to transform an array of data into an array of JSX elements.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">jsx</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">import</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React </span><span style="color:#D73A49">from</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'react'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> NumberList</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">props</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> numbers</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> props.numbers; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Array of numbers from props</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> listItems</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> numbers.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">map</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">number</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // Map each number to a list item</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> key</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{number.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toString</span><span style="color:#24292E">()}&gt; {</span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Assign a unique key */</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      {number}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;{listItems}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Render the unordered list</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> App</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> myNumbers</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">4</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">5</span><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5">NumberList</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> numbers</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{myNumbers} /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>

<p>In this example, <code>NumberList</code> takes an array <code>numbers</code> as a prop. The <code>map()</code> method iterates through <code>numbers</code>, and for each <code>number</code>, it returns an <code>&lt;li&gt;</code> element. The <code>key</code> prop is assigned <code>number.toString()</code> because each number in <code>myNumbers</code> is unique. The resulting array of <code>&lt;li&gt;</code> elements is then rendered inside a <code>&lt;ul&gt;</code>.</p>
<h3>Understanding Keys</h3>
<p>Keys are not passed to your component as props. React uses them internally to manage the rendering process. Each item in a list must have a unique, stable key.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Uniqueness</strong>: Keys must be unique <em>among siblings</em>. It's okay to use the same key in different arrays if they are not siblings in the React tree.</li>
<li><strong>Stability</strong>: Keys should not change between re-renders. Using <code>Math.random()</code> for keys is a bad practice because a new random key would be generated on every render, making it impossible for React to efficiently track items.</li>
<li><strong>What to use for keys</strong>:
<ul>
<li><strong>Stable IDs from your data</strong>: The best practice is to use a unique ID from your data source (e.g., a database ID).</li>
<li><strong>Item index (as a last resort)</strong>: Using the array index as a key (<code>index</code> parameter in <code>map()</code>) is generally discouraged, especially if the list items can be reordered, filtered, or added/removed. This can lead to performance issues and subtle bugs with component state. However, it can be acceptable if:
<ul>
<li>The list is static and will never change.</li>
<li>The items in the list have no stable IDs.</li>
<li>The list will never be reordered or filtered.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Let's illustrate the potential issue with using <code>index</code> as a key:</p>

<span class="line"></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;{props.text}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> TodoList</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span><span style="color:#005CC5">todos</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">setTodos</span><span style="color:#24292E">] </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> React.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">useState</span><span style="color:#24292E">([</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    { id: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">, text: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Learn React'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    { id: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">, text: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Build a project'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    { id: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#24292E">, text: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Deploy to Netlify'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  ]);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> removeFirstTodo</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">    setTodos</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">prevTodos</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> prevTodos.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">slice</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">)); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Remove the first item</span></span>

<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // Scenario 1: Using item.id as key (GOOD)</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5">TodoItem</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> key</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{item.id} </span><span style="color:#6F42C1">text</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{item.text} /&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Good Todo List (using item.id as key)&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;{goodTodoList}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Bad Todo List (using index as key)&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;{badTodoList}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{removeFirstTodo}&gt;Remove First Todo&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>

<p>In <code>TodoList</code>, if you remove the first item, and were using <code>index</code> as a key, React might get confused about which component corresponds to which data item, especially if the <code>TodoItem</code> component held internal state or contained input fields. Using a stable <code>id</code> ensures React correctly identifies and updates the right component instance.</p>
<h3>Extracting Components for Lists</h3>
<p>When your list items become complex, it's a good practice to extract them into their own components. This makes your code more readable, reusable, and easier to maintain. Remember to pass the <code>key</code> to the list item element itself (e.g., <code>&lt;li&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;div&gt;</code>), not to the component that renders it.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;{props.post.content}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> content</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> props.posts.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">map</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">post</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5">BlogPost</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> key</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{post.id} </span><span style="color:#6F42C1">post</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{post} /&gt; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Key on the BlogPost component</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
