<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> posts</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  {id: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">, title: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Hello React'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, content: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Welcome to learning React!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">},</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  {id: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">, title: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Installation Guide'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, content: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'How to set up your first React project.'</span><span style="color:#24292E">},</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  {id: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#24292E">, title: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'State and Props Deep Dive'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, content: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Understanding data flow in React components.'</span><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> App</span><span style="color:#24292E">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#005CC5">Blog</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> posts</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{posts} /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> App;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Here, <code>BlogPost</code> is a separate component responsible for rendering a single post's title and content. The <code>Blog</code> component then maps over the <code>posts</code> array, rendering a <code>BlogPost</code> component for each item. Notice that the <code>key</code> is passed directly to the <code>&lt;li&gt;</code> element in the <code>sidebar</code> and to the <code>BlogPost</code> component instance in the <code>content</code>.</p>
<h2>Exercises and Practice Activities</h2>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Dynamic User Status</strong>:
Create a component called <code>UserProfile</code>. This component should accept two props: <code>userName</code> (string) and <code>isOnline</code> (boolean).</p>
<ul>
<li>If <code>isOnline</code> is <code>true</code>, render the <code>userName</code> followed by "(Online)" in green text.</li>
<li>If <code>isOnline</code> is <code>false</code>, render the <code>userName</code> followed by "(Offline)" in gray text.</li>
<li>Use the ternary operator for the conditional rendering of the status text.</li>
<li>In a parent component, render <code>UserProfile</code> twice, once for an online user and once for an offline user.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Toggleable Message</strong>:
Build a component <code>AlertMessage</code> that displays a warning message.</p>
<ul>
<li>It should have an internal state <code>showMessage</code> initialized to <code>true</code>.</li>
<li>Render a <code>div</code> containing the message "Important: You have unaddressed issues!" <em>only if</em> <code>showMessage</code> is <code>true</code>. Use the logical <code>&amp;&amp;</code> operator.</li>
<li>Include a button that, when clicked, toggles the <code>showMessage</code> state. The button text should change between "Hide Warning" and "Show Warning" using a ternary operator.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Product List Display</strong>:
Create a component <code>ProductCatalog</code> that receives an array of product objects as a prop. Each product object should have <code>id</code>, <code>name</code>, and <code>price</code> properties.</p>
<ul>
<li>Map over the <code>products</code> array and render an <code>&lt;li&gt;</code> for each product.</li>
<li>Each <code>&lt;li&gt;</code> should display the product <code>name</code> and <code>price</code>.</li>
<li>Ensure each <code>&lt;li&gt;</code> has a unique <code>key</code> using the product's <code>id</code>.</li>
<li>In a parent component, define an array of at least three product objects and pass it to <code>ProductCatalog</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Filtered To-Do List</strong>:
Create a <code>TodoList</code> component.</p>
<ul>
<li>It should manage an array of to-do items in its state, where each item is an object like <code>{ id: 1, text: 'Buy groceries', completed: false }</code>.</li>
<li>Render the list of to-do items. Each item should display its <code>text</code>.</li>
<li>Add a checkbox next to each to-do item. When the checkbox is clicked, it should toggle the <code>completed</code> status of that item in the state. (Hint: you'll need to update the <code>todos</code> array in an immutable way).</li>
<li>Above the list, add a button labeled "Show Completed" and another labeled "Show Active". When these buttons are clicked, filter the displayed list to only show completed items or only show active (uncompleted) items, respectively. If no filter is active, show all items.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
  
</div>

</div>

<div id="chapter-6">

<div id="chapter-6.1">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Introduction to Node.js and npm</h1><p>Node.js is a server-side JavaScript runtime environment that allows developers to execute JavaScript code outside of a web browser. It uses the V8 JavaScript engine, the same engine that powers Google Chrome, making it very fast. Node.js enables full-stack JavaScript development, meaning the same language can be used for both front-end (browser-based) and back-end (server-based) applications. This consistency simplifies development workflows and allows for code sharing between the client and server. npm, which stands for Node Package Manager, is the default package manager for Node.js. It is used to install, share, and manage project dependencies. Think of npm as a vast repository of reusable code modules that other developers have published, ready for you to incorporate into your own projects.</p>
<h2>Understanding Node.js Architecture and Event Loop</h2>
<p>Node.js operates on a non-blocking, event-driven architecture, making it highly efficient for I/O-intensive operations such as data streaming, real-time applications, and handling many concurrent connections. Unlike traditional server-side languages that might create a new thread for each client request, Node.js uses a single-threaded event loop. This loop continuously monitors for events (like an incoming HTTP request or a database query completion) and processes them in a non-blocking manner.</p>
<p>When an operation that might take time (e.g., reading a file from disk or querying a database) is initiated, Node.js offloads this operation to the operating system or a worker pool. Instead of waiting for the operation to complete, Node.js continues processing other tasks. Once the time-consuming operation finishes, it places a "completion event" back into the event queue. The event loop then picks up this event and executes the associated callback function. This approach prevents the server from becoming blocked and ensures high throughput.</p>
<p>Consider a web server built with Node.js that needs to serve images to many users.
<strong>Traditional blocking approach:</strong> If a user requests an image, the server might dedicate a thread to read that image from disk. While that thread is busy, other users' requests might have to wait for an available thread, potentially leading to slowdowns.
<strong>Node.js non-blocking approach:</strong> When a user requests an image, Node.js initiates the file read operation but immediately moves on to process other users' requests. Once the image is fully read, Node.js triggers a callback function to send the image back to the requesting user. This way, the server remains responsive even under heavy load, improving overall user experience.</p>
<p>Another example is a chat application. When a user sends a message, Node.js doesn't wait for the message to be fully delivered to all recipients before allowing the sender to type another message or other users to send their messages. It processes the send request, initiates the delivery (which might involve network I/O), and immediately becomes available for other tasks. The message delivery is handled asynchronously, and once complete, any necessary acknowledgments or updates are processed by the event loop.</p>
<h2>Installing Node.js and npm</h2>
<p>Installing Node.js typically includes npm automatically. The recommended way to install Node.js is to download the official installer from the Node.js website (nodejs.org). There are installers for Windows, macOS, and Linux. For many Linux distributions and macOS, a version manager like <code>nvm</code> (Node Version Manager) is a popular choice, allowing you to easily switch between different Node.js versions.</p>
<p>Once Node.js is installed, you can verify the installation and check the versions of Node.js and npm using your command line interface (CLI).</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"># Check the Node.js version</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">node</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> -v</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"># Check the npm version</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">npm</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> -v</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The output should display the installed versions, for example:
<code>v18.17.1</code> (for Node.js)
<code>9.6.7</code> (for npm)</p>
<p>If you need to update npm to the latest version independently of Node.js, you can do so using npm itself:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"># Update npm to the latest version</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">npm</span><span style="color:#032F62"> install</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> -g</span><span style="color:#032F62"> npm@latest</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The <code>-g</code> flag means "global," installing npm so it's available system-wide.</p>
<h2>Initializing a Node.js Project with npm</h2>
<p>Every Node.js project typically starts with initializing it using npm. This creates a <code>package.json</code> file, which is crucial for managing project metadata, scripts, and dependencies.</p>
<p>Navigate to an empty directory where you want to create your project using your terminal.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"># Create a new directory for your project</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">mkdir</span><span style="color:#032F62"> my-first-node-project</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"># Navigate into the new directory</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">cd</span><span style="color:#032F62"> my-first-node-project</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>Once inside your project directory, run the <code>npm init</code> command.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">npm</span><span style="color:#032F62"> init</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This command will prompt you to answer several questions about your project, such as:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>package name:</strong> (e.g., <code>my-first-node-project</code>)</li>
<li><strong>version:</strong> (e.g., <code>1.0.0</code>)</li>
<li><strong>description:</strong> (e.g., <code>A simple introduction to Node.js and npm.</code>)</li>
<li><strong>entry point:</strong> (e.g., <code>index.js</code> - this is the main file of your application)</li>
<li><strong>test command:</strong> (e.g., empty or a command to run tests)</li>
<li><strong>git repository:</strong> (if you have one)</li>
<li><strong>keywords:</strong> (for searchability)</li>
<li><strong>author:</strong> (your name)</li>
<li><strong>license:</strong> (e.g., <code>ISC</code> or <code>MIT</code>)</li>
</ul>
<p>After answering these questions, npm will display a preview of the <code>package.json</code> file and ask for confirmation. Type <code>yes</code> or press Enter to create the file.</p>
<p>Alternatively, you can skip the interactive prompts and generate a default <code>package.json</code> file by running:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">npm</span><span style="color:#032F62"> init</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> -y</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This command will create a <code>package.json</code> file with default values for all fields. You can then edit this file manually.</p>
<p>Here's an example of a <code>package.json</code> file:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">json</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">{</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "name"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"my-first-node-project"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "version"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"1.0.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "description"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"A simple Node.js project demonstrating npm initialization."</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "main"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"index.js"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "scripts"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    "test"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"echo </span><span style="color:#005CC5">\"</span><span style="color:#032F62">Error: no test specified</span><span style="color:#005CC5">\"</span><span style="color:#032F62"> &amp;&amp; exit 1"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    "start"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"node index.js"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "author"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Your Name"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "license"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"ISC"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "dependencies"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: {}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The <code>package.json</code> file is a central configuration file for your Node.js project. It describes your project, lists its dependencies, and defines scripts to automate common tasks. The <code>dependencies</code> object will store a list of all external packages your project relies on.</p>
<h2>Managing Dependencies with npm</h2>
<p>npm is primarily used for managing project dependencies. Dependencies are external libraries or packages that your project needs to function. For example, if you want to perform HTTP requests easily in Node.js, you might install a package like <code>axios</code>.</p>
<h3>Installing Packages</h3>
<p>To install a package, you use the <code>npm install</code> command followed by the package name.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"># Install a package, for example, 'lodash'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">npm</span><span style="color:#032F62"> install</span><span style="color:#032F62"> lodash</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>When you run this command:</p>
<ol>
<li>npm downloads the <code>lodash</code> package from the npm registry.</li>
<li>It places the package and its own dependencies into a <code>node_modules</code> directory in your project root.</li>
<li>It adds <code>lodash</code> and its version to the <code>dependencies</code> object in your <code>package.json</code> file.</li>
<li>It creates or updates a <code>package-lock.json</code> file. This file records the exact versions of all installed packages, including their sub-dependencies, ensuring consistent installations across different environments.</li>
</ol>
<p>After installing <code>lodash</code>, your <code>package.json</code> might look like this:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">json</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">{</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "name"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"my-first-node-project"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "version"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"1.0.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "description"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"A simple Node.js project demonstrating npm initialization."</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "main"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"index.js"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "scripts"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    "test"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"echo </span><span style="color:#005CC5">\"</span><span style="color:#032F62">Error: no test specified</span><span style="color:#005CC5">\"</span><span style="color:#032F62"> &amp;&amp; exit 1"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "author"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Your Name"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "license"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"ISC"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "dependencies"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    "lodash"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"^4.17.21"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The <code>^</code> before the version number (e.g., <code>^4.17.21</code>) is a <em>caret</em> symbol. It tells npm to install the latest minor or patch version available for <code>lodash</code> that is compatible with version <code>4.17.21</code> (i.e., any version from <code>4.17.21</code> up to, but not including, <code>5.0.0</code>). This is a common practice to allow for patch and minor updates without breaking changes. Other common symbols include <code>~</code> (tilde) for patch versions only, and no symbol for an exact version match.</p>
<h3>Installing Development Dependencies</h3>
<p>Sometimes, packages are only needed during development or for testing, not in the final production application. These are called development dependencies. Examples include testing frameworks (like Jest) or build tools (like Webpack).</p>
<p>To install a package as a development dependency, use the <code>--save-dev</code> or <code>-D</code> flag:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"># Install a development dependency, for example, 'jest'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">npm</span><span style="color:#032F62"> install</span><span style="color:#032F62"> jest</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> --save-dev</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"># Or the shorthand</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">npm</span><span style="color:#032F62"> install</span><span style="color:#032F62"> jest</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> -D</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This adds <code>jest</code> to a <code>devDependencies</code> object in your <code>package.json</code>:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">json</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">{</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "name"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"my-first-node-project"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "version"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"1.0.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "description"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"A simple Node.js project demonstrating npm initialization."</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "main"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"index.js"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "scripts"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    "test"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"echo </span><span style="color:#005CC5">\"</span><span style="color:#032F62">Error: no test specified</span><span style="color:#005CC5">\"</span><span style="color:#032F62"> &amp;&amp; exit 1"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "author"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Your Name"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "license"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"ISC"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "dependencies"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    "lodash"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"^4.17.21"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "devDependencies"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    "jest"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"^29.7.0"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>When deploying your application to a production environment, you can install only regular dependencies (and skip <code>devDependencies</code>) by running <code>npm install --production</code>.</p>
<h3>Uninstalling Packages</h3>
<p>To remove a package from your project and its <code>package.json</code>, use <code>npm uninstall</code>:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"># Uninstall a package</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">npm</span><span style="color:#032F62"> uninstall</span><span style="color:#032F62"> lodash</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This command removes the package from <code>node_modules</code> and also from your <code>package.json</code> (either <code>dependencies</code> or <code>devDependencies</code>).</p>
<h3>Using Installed Packages</h3>
<p>Once a package is installed, you can use it in your Node.js code by importing it using the <code>require</code> function (CommonJS module system, common in Node.js) or <code>import</code> statement (ES Modules, becoming more common).</p>
<p>Create a file named <code>index.js</code> in your <code>my-first-node-project</code> directory:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// index.js</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Import the lodash library</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> _</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'lodash'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Use a lodash function to capitalize the first letter of each word</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> greeting</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "hello node and npm"</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> transformedGreeting</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> _.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">startCase</span><span style="color:#24292E">(_.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toLower</span><span style="color:#24292E">(greeting));</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(transformedGreeting); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Expected output: "Hello Node And Npm"</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Example of a simple server (will be covered in detail in the next lesson)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// This just demonstrates that Node.js can run server-side code</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> http</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'http'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> server</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> http.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">createServer</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  res.statusCode </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 200</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">setHeader</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Content-Type'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#032F62">'text/plain'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">end</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Welcome to Node.js!</span><span style="color:#005CC5">\n</span><span style="color:#032F62">'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> port</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 3000</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">server.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">listen</span><span style="color:#24292E">(port, () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Server running at http://localhost:${</span><span style="color:#24292E">port</span><span style="color:#032F62">}/`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>To run this Node.js script, execute the following command in your terminal within the project directory:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">node</span><span style="color:#032F62"> index.js</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>You will see the output <code>Hello Node And Npm</code> and <code>Server running at http://localhost:3000/</code>. If you open <code>http://localhost:3000/</code> in your browser, you will see <code>Welcome to Node.js!</code>.</p>
<h2>npm Scripts</h2>
<p>The <code>scripts</code> object in <code>package.json</code> allows you to define custom commands to automate tasks. These commands can be anything from running tests to starting your application or building front-end assets.</p>
<p>In your <code>package.json</code>, you might have a <code>start</code> script:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">json</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">{</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "name"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"my-first-node-project"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "version"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"1.0.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "description"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"A simple Node.js project demonstrating npm initialization."</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "main"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"index.js"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "scripts"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    "test"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"echo </span><span style="color:#005CC5">\"</span><span style="color:#032F62">Error: no test specified</span><span style="color:#005CC5">\"</span><span style="color:#032F62"> &amp;&amp; exit 1"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    "start"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"node index.js"</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // This script runs our index.js file</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "author"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Your Name"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "license"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"ISC"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "dependencies"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    "lodash"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"^4.17.21"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>To run this script, use <code>npm run</code> followed by the script name:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">npm</span><span style="color:#032F62"> run</span><span style="color:#032F62"> start</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>For a few standard scripts like <code>start</code>, <code>test</code>, <code>install</code>, and <code>stop</code>, you can omit <code>run</code>:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">npm</span><span style="color:#032F62"> start</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This will execute <code>node index.js</code>, starting your server. This is very useful for abstracting complex commands and making it easy for anyone working on the project to run common tasks.</p>
<h2>Practical Examples and Demonstrations</h2>
<p>Let's expand on our <code>my-first-node-project</code> to demonstrate more npm functionality and basic Node.js execution.</p>
<h3>Example 1: Creating a Utility Script</h3>
<p>We'll create a script that reads a list of names from a file, shuffles them using <code>lodash</code>, and prints them.</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Ensure you are in <code>my-first-node-project</code> directory.</strong> If not, navigate there: <code>cd my-first-node-project</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Install <code>lodash</code> if you haven't already:</strong>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">npm</span><span style="color:#032F62"> install</span><span style="color:#032F62"> lodash</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
<li><strong>Create a file named <code>names.txt</code>:</strong>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">Alice</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">Bob</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">David</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">Eve</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
<li><strong>Create a new file named <code>shuffleNames.js</code>:</strong>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// shuffleNames.js</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> _</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'lodash'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Import lodash</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> fs</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'fs'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);   </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Node.js built-in file system module</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> path</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'path'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Node.js built-in path module</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Define the path to the names.txt file</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> namesFilePath</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> path.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">join</span><span style="color:#24292E">(__dirname, </span><span style="color:#032F62">'names.txt'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">fs.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">readFile</span><span style="color:#24292E">(namesFilePath, </span><span style="color:#032F62">'utf8'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, (</span><span style="color:#E36209">err</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">data</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (err) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Error reading the file:'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, err);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    return</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // Split the data into an array of names, filtering out empty lines</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> names</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> data.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">split</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'</span><span style="color:#005CC5">\n</span><span style="color:#032F62">'</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">filter</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">name</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> name.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">trim</span><span style="color:#24292E">() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">!==</span><span style="color:#032F62"> ''</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // Shuffle the names using lodash</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> shuffledNames</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> _.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">shuffle</span><span style="color:#24292E">(names);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Original Names:'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, names);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Shuffled Names:'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, shuffledNames);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
