<h3>Example 2: Adding a Custom npm Script</h3>
<p>Let's add a script to <code>package.json</code> to easily run our <code>shuffleNames.js</code>.</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Open <code>package.json</code></strong> and add a new entry to the <code>scripts</code> object:
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">json</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">{</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "name"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"my-first-node-project"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "version"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"1.0.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "description"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"A simple Node.js project demonstrating npm initialization."</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "main"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"index.js"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "scripts"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    "test"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"echo </span><span style="color:#005CC5">\"</span><span style="color:#032F62">Error: no test specified</span><span style="color:#005CC5">\"</span><span style="color:#032F62"> &amp;&amp; exit 1"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    "start"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"node index.js"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    "shuffle"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"node shuffleNames.js"</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // Our new custom script</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "author"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"Your Name"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "license"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"ISC"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "dependencies"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    "lodash"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"^4.17.21"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
<li><strong>Run the custom script:</strong>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">npm</span><span style="color:#032F62"> run</span><span style="color:#032F62"> shuffle</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
This will execute <code>node shuffleNames.js</code> just like before, but now it's accessible through an npm command, making it part of your project's defined tasks.</li>
</ol>
<h2>Exercises</h2>
<p>These exercises build on the <code>my-first-node-project</code> you've been working with.</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Install a new package and use it:</strong>
<ul>
<li>Find a small utility package on npmjs.com (e.g., <code>moment</code> for date formatting, or <code>chalk</code> for terminal styling).</li>
<li>Install it as a regular dependency in your <code>my-first-node-project</code>.</li>
<li>Create a new JavaScript file (e.g., <code>dateFormatter.js</code> or <code>coloredOutput.js</code>).</li>
<li>Use the newly installed package in this file to perform a simple task (e.g., format the current date, or print a colored message to the console).</li>
<li>Run your new JavaScript file using <code>node</code>.</li>
<li>Verify that the package is listed in <code>package.json</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Add another custom npm script:</strong>
<ul>
<li>Add a new script to your <code>package.json</code> named <code>greet</code>.</li>
<li>This script should simply execute a command like <code>echo "Hello from npm script!"</code>.</li>
<li>Run your new <code>greet</code> script using <code>npm run greet</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Experiment with <code>npm uninstall</code>:</strong>
<ul>
<li>Uninstall the <code>lodash</code> package from your <code>my-first-node-project</code>.</li>
<li>Verify that <code>lodash</code> is no longer listed in your <code>package.json</code> and the <code>node_modules</code> directory no longer contains <code>lodash</code>.</li>
<li>Try running <code>npm run shuffle</code> again. What happens and why? (Hint: The script relies on <code>lodash</code>).</li>
<li>Reinstall <code>lodash</code> to make the <code>shuffle</code> script work again.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
  
</div>

<div id="chapter-6.2">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Building a Simple Web Server with Node.js</h1><p>Node.js allows JavaScript to run on the server side, making it a powerful tool for building web servers. Understanding how to create a basic web server with Node.js is fundamental for full-stack development, enabling the server to handle incoming requests and send responses. This involves setting up a listener for specific ports and managing basic HTTP interactions.</p>
<h2>Setting Up a Node.js Project</h2>
<p>Before building a web server, a Node.js project must be initialized. This process creates a <code>package.json</code> file, which manages project metadata and dependencies.</p>
<h3>Initializing a Project with npm</h3>
<p>The Node Package Manager (npm) is used to initialize new Node.js projects. The <code>npm init</code> command guides you through creating the <code>package.json</code> file.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Navigate to your project directory in the terminal</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// mkdir my-web-server</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// cd my-web-server</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Initialize the project</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">npm init </span><span style="color:#D73A49">-</span><span style="color:#24292E">y</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// The '-y' flag answers "yes" to all prompts, creating a default package.json.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// If you omit '-y', npm will ask for project details like name, version, description, etc.</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This command creates a <code>package.json</code> file resembling this:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">json</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">{</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "name"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"my-web-server"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "version"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"1.0.0"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "description"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">""</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "main"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"index.js"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "scripts"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    "test"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"echo </span><span style="color:#005CC5">\"</span><span style="color:#032F62">Error: no test specified</span><span style="color:#005CC5">\"</span><span style="color:#032F62"> &amp;&amp; exit 1"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "keywords"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: [],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "author"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">""</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "license"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"ISC"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The <code>"main": "index.js"</code> field indicates the entry point for the application. By default, Node.js will look for <code>index.js</code> to start the server.</p>
<h3>Creating the Server File</h3>
<p>After initializing the project, create the main server file. Typically, this file is named <code>index.js</code> or <code>app.js</code> in the root of your project directory.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// In your project directory, create a file named index.js</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// touch index.js</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This <code>index.js</code> file will contain the code for our web server.</p>
<h2>The <code>http</code> Module</h2>
<p>Node.js comes with a built-in <code>http</code> module that provides functionalities to create both HTTP clients and servers. This module is essential for handling HTTP requests and responses.</p>
<h3>Importing the <code>http</code> Module</h3>
<p>To use the <code>http</code> module, it must be imported into your JavaScript file using the <code>require</code> function.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// index.js</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> http</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'http'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Imports the built-in http module</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Creating an HTTP Server</h3>
<p>The <code>http.createServer()</code> method is used to create an HTTP server object. This method takes a callback function that executes every time the server receives a request. This callback function receives two arguments: <code>request</code> (often <code>req</code>) and <code>response</code> (often <code>res</code>).</p>
<ul>
<li><strong><code>req</code> (request object):</strong> Contains information about the incoming HTTP request, such as the URL, HTTP method (GET, POST, etc.), headers, and request body.</li>
<li><strong><code>res</code> (response object):</strong> Used to send data back to the client, including the HTTP status code, headers, and the response body.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// index.js</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> http</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'http'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Create a server object</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> server</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> http.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">createServer</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // This function runs every time a request comes to the server</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Request received!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Log to the server console</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">writeHead</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#24292E">, { </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Content-Type'</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'text/plain'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> }); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Set HTTP header for a successful response (200 OK)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">end</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Hello, Node.js Server!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Send "Hello, Node.js Server!" as the response body</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Listening for Incoming Requests</h3>
<p>Once the server object is created, the <code>server.listen()</code> method is used to start the server and make it listen for incoming connections on a specified port and optionally an IP address.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Port:</strong> A numerical address that identifies a specific application or service on a network. Common ports for web servers are 80 (HTTP) and 443 (HTTPS), but for development, higher ports like 3000, 8080, or 5000 are often used to avoid conflicts.</li>
<li><strong>Callback function (optional):</strong> Executes once the server successfully starts listening.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// index.js</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> http</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'http'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> server</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> http.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">createServer</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>

<p>To run this server, save the file as <code>index.js</code> and execute it from your terminal:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">node</span><span style="color:#032F62"> index.js</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>You will see the message <code>Server running at http://localhost:3000/</code>. If you then open your web browser and navigate to <code>http://localhost:3000/</code>, you will see "Hello, Node.js Server!" displayed in the browser.</p>
<h2>Handling Different Routes and Request Methods</h2>
<p>A web server often needs to respond differently based on the requested URL (route) and the HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE). The <code>req</code> object provides <code>req.url</code> and <code>req.method</code> properties for this purpose.</p>
<h3>Routing Based on URL</h3>
<p>The <code>req.url</code> property contains the path of the requested URL. Conditional statements can be used to direct requests to different logic blocks.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// index.js</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> http</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'http'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> server</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> http.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">createServer</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (req.url </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '/'</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Handle requests to the root URL "/"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">writeHead</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#24292E">, { </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Content-Type'</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'text/html'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> }); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Set content type to HTML</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">end</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'&lt;h1&gt;Welcome to the Homepage!&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;This is the root route.&lt;/p&gt;'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (req.url </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '/about'</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Handle requests to "/about"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">writeHead</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#24292E">, { </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Content-Type'</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'text/html'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">end</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'&lt;h1&gt;About Us&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;We are learning Node.js web development.&lt;/p&gt;'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Handle all other URLs (404 Not Found)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">writeHead</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">404</span><span style="color:#24292E">, { </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Content-Type'</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'text/html'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">end</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'&lt;h1&gt;404 Not Found&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;The page you requested does not exist.&lt;/p&gt;'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> PORT</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 3000</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">server.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">listen</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">PORT</span><span style="color:#24292E">, () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Server running at http://localhost:${</span><span style="color:#005CC5">PORT</span><span style="color:#032F62">}/`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>With this server:</p>
<ul>
<li>Navigating to <code>http://localhost:3000/</code> displays "Welcome to the Homepage!".</li>
<li>Navigating to <code>http://localhost:3000/about</code> displays "About Us".</li>
<li>Navigating to <code>http://localhost:3000/contact</code> displays "404 Not Found".</li>
</ul>
<h3>Routing Based on HTTP Method</h3>
<p>The <code>req.method</code> property contains the HTTP method of the incoming request (e.g., 'GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE'). This allows the server to perform different actions for the same URL based on the method.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// index.js</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">end</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">JSON</span><span style="color:#24292E">.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">stringify</span><span style="color:#24292E">(data)); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Send JSON data</span></span>

<p>To test the POST request, you would typically use a tool like Postman, <code>curl</code>, or a client-side JavaScript <code>fetch</code> request.</p>
<p>Example <code>curl</code> command for POST:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">curl</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> -X</span><span style="color:#032F62"> POST</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> -H</span><span style="color:#032F62"> "Content-Type: application/json"</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> -d</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '{"item": "Node.js course"}'</span><span style="color:#032F62"> http://localhost:3000/data</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The server console would output <code>Received POST data: {"item": "Node.js course"}</code> and the client would receive <code>{"message":"Data received successfully!","receivedData":"{\"item\": \"Node.js course\"}"}</code>.</p>
<h2>Practical Examples and Demonstrations</h2>
<p>Let's combine these concepts into a slightly more sophisticated basic server that serves different types of content and handles a simple data submission.</p>
<h3>Serving HTML, JSON, and Handling a Form Submission</h3>
<p>Consider a scenario where a simple application needs to:</p>
<ol>
<li>Serve an HTML page for the root route.</li>
<li>Provide a JSON API endpoint for product data.</li>
<li>Process a simple form submission.</li>
</ol>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// app.js</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> http</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'http'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> url</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'url'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Built-in module for URL parsing</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> querystring</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'querystring'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Built-in module for parsing query strings</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> products</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> [</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  { id: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">, name: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Laptop'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, price: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">1200</span><span style="color:#24292E"> },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  { id: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#24292E">, name: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Mouse'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, price: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">25</span><span style="color:#24292E"> },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  { id: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">3</span><span style="color:#24292E">, name: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Keyboard'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, price: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">75</span><span style="color:#24292E"> }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">];</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> server</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> http.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">createServer</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> parsedUrl</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> url.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">parse</span><span style="color:#24292E">(req.url, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">true</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Parse URL, 'true' to parse query string into an object</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> path</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> parsedUrl.pathname;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> method</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> req.method;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Request received: ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">method</span><span style="color:#032F62">} ${</span><span style="color:#24292E">path</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (path </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '/'</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Serve the homepage HTML</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">writeHead</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#24292E">, { </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Content-Type'</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'text/html'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">end</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">      &lt;head&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">          &lt;meta charset="UTF-8"&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">          &lt;meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">          &lt;title&gt;Node.js Server&lt;/title&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">      &lt;/head&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">      &lt;body&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">          &lt;p&gt;Go to &lt;a href="/api/products"&gt;/api/products&lt;/a&gt; to see our product list.&lt;/p&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">          &lt;h2&gt;Submit a New Item&lt;/h2&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">          &lt;form action="/submit-item" method="POST"&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">              &lt;label for="itemName"&gt;Item Name:&lt;/label&gt;&lt;br&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">              &lt;input type="text" id="itemName" name="itemName" required&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">              &lt;button type="submit"&gt;Submit Item&lt;/button&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">          &lt;/form&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">      &lt;/body&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">      &lt;/html&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#032F62">    `</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (path </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '/api/products'</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> &amp;&amp;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> method </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'GET'</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Serve product data as JSON</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">writeHead</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#24292E">, { </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Content-Type'</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'application/json'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">end</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">JSON</span><span style="color:#24292E">.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">stringify</span><span style="color:#24292E">(products));</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (path </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> '/submit-item'</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> &amp;&amp;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> method </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'POST'</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
