<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Route to get all products</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Handles GET /products</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">get</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'/products'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, (</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Access query parameters for filtering</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> filteredProducts </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> products;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        filteredProducts </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> filteredProducts.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">filter</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E36209">            product</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> product.category.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toLowerCase</span><span style="color:#24292E">() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#24292E"> category.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">toLowerCase</span><span style="color:#24292E">()</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (minPrice) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Ensure minPrice is a number for comparison</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        filteredProducts </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> filteredProducts.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">filter</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E36209">            product</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> product.price </span><span style="color:#D73A49">&gt;=</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> parseFloat</span><span style="color:#24292E">(minPrice)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Send a 200 OK status with the filtered products as JSON</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">(filteredProducts);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Route to get a single product by ID</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Handles GET /products/:id</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">get</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'/products/:id'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, (</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Access route parameters</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> productId</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> parseInt</span><span style="color:#24292E">(req.params.id);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (product) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // If product found, send 200 OK with product data</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">(product);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // If not found, send 404 Not Found</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">404</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ message: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Product not found'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<ul>
<li>When a client sends a <code>GET</code> request to <code>/products</code>, the server responds with a list of all products (or filtered products if query parameters like <code>category</code> or <code>minPrice</code> are provided).</li>
<li>When a client sends a <code>GET</code> request to <code>/products/1</code>, the server looks for the product with <code>id: 1</code> and responds with its data or a 404 error if not found.</li>
</ul>
<h3>POST Requests: Creating Resources</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// app.js (continued)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Route to create a new product</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Handles POST /products</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">post</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'/products'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, (</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Access the request body (parsed by express.json() middleware)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">name</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">price</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">category</span><span style="color:#24292E"> } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> req.body;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Basic validation</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">name </span><span style="color:#D73A49">||</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> !</span><span style="color:#24292E">price </span><span style="color:#D73A49">||</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> !</span><span style="color:#24292E">category) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // If data is missing, send 400 Bad Request</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">400</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ message: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Name, price, and category are required'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> newProduct</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        id: nextProductId</span><span style="color:#D73A49">++</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Assign a unique ID</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        name,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        price: </span><span style="color:#6F42C1">parseFloat</span><span style="color:#24292E">(price), </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Ensure price is a number</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        category</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    products.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">push</span><span style="color:#24292E">(newProduct); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Add the new product to our store</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Send a 201 Created status with the newly created product</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">201</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">(newProduct);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<ul>
<li>When a client sends a <code>POST</code> request to <code>/products</code> with a JSON body like <code>{ "name": "Webcam", "price": 50, "category": "Electronics" }</code>, the server creates a new product, adds it to the <code>products</code> array, and responds with a <code>201 Created</code> status code along with the new product's data.</li>
<li>If the request body is missing required fields, it responds with <code>400 Bad Request</code>.</li>
</ul>
<h3>PUT Requests: Updating Resources (Full Replacement)</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// app.js (continued)</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Route to update an existing product (full replacement)</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Basic validation for replacement</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">name </span><span style="color:#D73A49">||</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> !</span><span style="color:#24292E">price </span><span style="color:#D73A49">||</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> !</span><span style="color:#24292E">category) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">400</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ message: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'All fields (name, price, category) are required for PUT updates.'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Replace the existing product with new data</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            id: productId, </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Ensure ID remains the same</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            name,</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            category</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        };</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Send 200 OK with the updated product</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">(products[productIndex]);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">else</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // If product not found, send 404 Not Found</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">404</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ message: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Product not found'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>

<h3>DELETE Requests: Removing Resources</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// app.js (continued)</span></span>

<h3>Error Handling</h3>
<p>While Express handles some basic errors, robust error handling is crucial. Middleware can be used to catch errors that occur during request processing.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// app.js (continued)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Basic error handling middleware (should be placed at the very end of your middleware stack)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">use</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">err</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">next</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(err.stack); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Log the error stack for debugging</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">500</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ message: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Something went wrong on the server.'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Catch-all for undefined routes (404 Not Found)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">use</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">next</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">404</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ message: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Resource not found'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This error handling middleware catches any errors propagated through <code>next(err)</code> calls in your routes and sends a <code>500 Internal Server Error</code>. The <code>app.use</code> without a path at the very end acts as a fallback for any requests that didn't match previous routes, returning a <code>404 Not Found</code>.</p>
<h2>Exercises and Practice Activities</h2>
<p>Using the <code>app.js</code> file from the practical examples:</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Implement a User Management API (GET and POST):</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Create a new array <code>users</code> with a few initial user objects (e.g., <code>{ id: 1, name: 'Alice', email: 'alice@example.com' }</code>).</li>
<li>Add a <code>GET /users</code> route that returns all users.</li>
<li>Add a <code>GET /users/:id</code> route that returns a single user by ID, or a 404 if not found.</li>
<li>Add a <code>POST /users</code> route that allows creating a new user. It should validate that <code>name</code> and <code>email</code> are provided, assign a unique <code>id</code>, and respond with <code>201 Created</code> and the new user's data. If validation fails, respond with <code>400 Bad Request</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Enhance Product Filtering (GET with Multiple Query Params):</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Modify the <code>GET /products</code> route to also allow filtering by <code>maxPrice</code>. If both <code>minPrice</code> and <code>maxPrice</code> are provided, filter products within that price range.</li>
<li>Test your implementation by making requests like <code>/products?minPrice=50&amp;maxPrice=100</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Implement a Specific Product Field Update (PATCH for Price Adjustment):</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Refine the <code>PATCH /products/:id</code> route to specifically handle a scenario where <em>only</em> the <code>price</code> is being updated. If the request body only contains <code>price</code>, ensure the <code>price</code> is a valid number.</li>
<li>Consider an edge case: What if <code>updates</code> in the <code>PATCH</code> request body contains an <code>id</code>? Your current implementation might allow changing the <code>id</code> itself, which is generally not desirable for a primary key. Add logic to prevent <code>id</code> from being updated via a <code>PATCH</code> request.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
  
</div>

<div id="chapter-6.5">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Connecting to a Database (MongoDB)</h1><p>Connecting to a database from a Node.js application allows for persistent storage and retrieval of data, which is fundamental for dynamic web applications. This lesson focuses on establishing a connection to a MongoDB database using Mongoose, an Object Data Modeling (ODM) library for Node.js.</p>
<h2>Introduction to MongoDB and NoSQL Databases</h2>
<p>MongoDB is a popular NoSQL database, meaning it doesn't use the traditional table-based relational model found in SQL databases like MySQL or PostgreSQL. Instead, MongoDB stores data in flexible, JSON-like documents. This document-oriented approach provides several advantages, especially for web applications with rapidly evolving data structures:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Flexibility:</strong> Documents can have different fields, unlike rows in a relational table which must conform to a strict schema. This is beneficial when data structures change frequently or when different documents of the same type have varying fields.</li>
<li><strong>Scalability:</strong> MongoDB is designed for horizontal scaling, meaning it can distribute data across multiple servers. This allows it to handle large amounts of data and high traffic loads efficiently.</li>
<li><strong>Performance:</strong> For many types of applications, especially those dealing with hierarchical or semi-structured data, MongoDB can offer faster read and write operations compared to relational databases.</li>
</ul>
<p>A real-world example of MongoDB's use is for content management systems where articles, comments, and user profiles might have varied attributes. Another example is e-commerce product catalogs where different product types (e.g., electronics, clothing) have unique sets of specifications. Hypothetically, an online learning platform could use MongoDB to store diverse student data, course information, and progress tracking, where each student or course might have a unique set of associated data points.</p>
<h2>Installing Mongoose</h2>
<p>Mongoose simplifies interaction with MongoDB by providing a schema-based solution to model application data. It handles the complexities of direct MongoDB driver interactions, allowing developers to work with a more intuitive JavaScript object interface.</p>
<p>To integrate Mongoose into a Node.js project, it must be installed as a dependency. Assuming a Node.js project has already been initialized (as covered in previous lessons on Node.js and npm), open the terminal in the project's root directory and run the following command:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">npm</span><span style="color:#032F62"> install</span><span style="color:#032F62"> mongoose</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This command downloads the Mongoose package and adds it to the <code>dependencies</code> section of the <code>package.json</code> file. The <code>node_modules</code> directory will also be updated with the Mongoose library and its own dependencies.</p>
<h2>Establishing a Database Connection</h2>
<p>Connecting to a MongoDB database using Mongoose involves importing the <code>mongoose</code> package and calling its <code>connect</code> method. The <code>connect</code> method takes a MongoDB connection URI as its primary argument. This URI specifies the location of the MongoDB server and the database to connect to.</p>
<p>A typical MongoDB connection URI looks like this: <code>mongodb://localhost:27017/mydatabase</code>.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>mongodb://</code>: The protocol for connecting to MongoDB.</li>
<li><code>localhost</code>: The hostname where the MongoDB server is running. If connecting to a remote server, this would be its IP address or domain name.</li>
<li><code>27017</code>: The default port number for MongoDB.</li>
<li><code>mydatabase</code>: The name of the database to connect to. If this database does not exist, MongoDB will create it upon the first data insertion.</li>
</ul>
<p>Here's how to establish a basic connection in a Node.js application:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Import the Mongoose library</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> mongoose</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'mongoose'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Define the MongoDB connection URI</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// 'mongodb://localhost:27017/webdev_course' specifies:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// - mongodb://: the protocol</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// - localhost: the host where MongoDB is running (your local machine)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// - 27017: the default port for MongoDB</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// - webdev_course: the name of the database to connect to</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> mongoURI</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'mongodb://localhost:27017/webdev_course'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Connect to MongoDB using Mongoose</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">mongoose.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">connect</span><span style="color:#24292E">(mongoURI)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">then</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // This block executes if the connection is successful</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Successfully connected to MongoDB!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // This block executes if the connection fails</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'MongoDB connection error:'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, error);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Optionally, you can set up event listeners for connection status</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// 'connection' event fires when the connection is established</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">mongoose.connection.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">on</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'connected'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Mongoose default connection open to '</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#24292E"> mongoURI);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// 'error' event fires if there's an error after the initial connection attempt</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">mongoose.connection.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">on</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'error'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, (</span><span style="color:#E36209">err</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Mongoose default connection error: '</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> +</span><span style="color:#24292E"> err);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// 'disconnected' event fires when the connection is lost</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">mongoose.connection.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">on</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'disconnected'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Mongoose default connection disconnected'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// To gracefully close the Mongoose connection when the Node.js application terminates</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">process.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">on</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'SIGINT'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  mongoose.connection.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">close</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Mongoose default connection disconnected through app termination'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    process.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">exit</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Exit the process</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// You can also use async/await for a more modern syntax:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/*</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">async function connectToDatabase() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  try {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    await mongoose.connect(mongoURI);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    console.log('Successfully connected to MongoDB with async/await!');</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  } catch (error) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    console.error('MongoDB connection error with async/await:', error);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">connectToDatabase();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">*/</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>It is a common practice to keep the connection logic separate, for example, in a <code>db.js</code> file, and then import this file into the main application entry point (e.g., <code>app.js</code> or <code>server.js</code>). This promotes modularity and keeps the main application file cleaner.</p>
<p>Consider the Express.js application from previous lessons. The connection logic would typically be placed before the server starts listening for requests, ensuring the database is available when routes are handled.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// server.js (Example integrating with Express.js)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> express</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'express'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> mongoose</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'mongoose'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Import Mongoose</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> app</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> express</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> PORT</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 3000</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Middleware to parse JSON bodies from requests</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">use</span><span style="color:#24292E">(express.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">());</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// MongoDB Connection URI</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> mongoURI</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'mongodb://localhost:27017/express_web_app'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Connect to MongoDB</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">mongoose.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">connect</span><span style="color:#24292E">(mongoURI)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">then</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'MongoDB Connected Successfully!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Start the Express server ONLY AFTER successful database connection</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">listen</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">PORT</span><span style="color:#24292E">, () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Server running on port ${</span><span style="color:#005CC5">PORT</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  .</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">err</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Database connection error:'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, err);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    process.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">exit</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Exit the process if database connection fails</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Basic route (for demonstration purposes, actual routes would be more complex)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">get</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'/'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, (</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">send</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Welcome to the Express App with MongoDB!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Error handling middleware (basic example)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">use</span><span style="color:#24292E">((</span><span style="color:#E36209">err</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">next</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(err.stack);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">500</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">send</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Something broke!'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this setup, the Express server will only start listening for requests once the connection to MongoDB is successfully established. This prevents the application from attempting database operations before a connection is available.</p>
<h2>Mongoose Schema and Model</h2>
<p>Once connected, Mongoose introduces the concepts of <strong>Schemas</strong> and <strong>Models</strong>.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Schema:</strong> A Mongoose schema defines the structure of the documents within a collection, including field names, their data types, default values, and validators. It provides data validation and type casting. While MongoDB itself is schemaless, Mongoose schemas enforce a structure on your application's data.</li>
<li><strong>Model:</strong> A Mongoose model is a constructor compiled from a schema definition. An instance of a model represents a document in the database. Models are used to query, create, update, and delete documents.</li>
</ul>
<p>Let's define a simple schema for a "Task" in a to-do list application:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// task.js (Defining a Mongoose Schema and Model)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> mongoose</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'mongoose'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// 1. Define the Schema for a Task</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> taskSchema</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#24292E"> mongoose.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">Schema</span><span style="color:#24292E">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // 'description' field:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // - type: String (ensures it's always a string)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // - required: true (ensures this field must be present)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // - trim: true (removes whitespace from both ends of the string)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  description: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    type: String,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    required: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">true</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    trim: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">true</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // 'completed' field:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // - type: Boolean (ensures it's a boolean)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // - default: false (if not provided, defaults to false)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  completed: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    type: Boolean,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    default: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">false</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // 'createdAt' field:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // - type: Date</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // - default: Date.now (sets the default value to the current date/time when created)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  createdAt: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    type: Date,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    default: Date.now</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// 2. Create a Model from the Schema</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// 'Task' is the name of the model. Mongoose will automatically</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// create a collection named 'tasks' (pluralized, lowercase) in MongoDB.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> Task</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> mongoose.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">model</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Task'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, taskSchema);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Export the Task model to be used in other files</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">module</span><span style="color:#24292E">.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">exports</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> Task;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This <code>Task</code> model can now be used in an Express route to interact with the database.</p>
<h2>Performing Basic CRUD Operations</h2>
<p>Once the database is connected and a model is defined, you can perform Create, Read, Update, and Delete (CRUD) operations.</p>
<h3>Creating Documents</h3>
<p>To create a new document, instantiate a model with the desired data and then call its <code>save()</code> method.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// In a route handler or service file (e.g., server.js)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> Task</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'./task'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Import the Task model</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Example: Creating a new task</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">post</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'/tasks'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#D73A49">async</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  try</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> task</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> Task</span><span style="color:#24292E">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      description: req.body.description, </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Get description from request body</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      completed: req.body.completed </span><span style="color:#D73A49">||</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> false</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // Optionally set completed status</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> task.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">save</span><span style="color:#24292E">(); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Save the new task to the database</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">201</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">send</span><span style="color:#24292E">(task); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Send back the created task with 201 status</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (error) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">400</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">send</span><span style="color:#24292E">(error); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Send error if creation fails</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Reading Documents</h3>
<p>Mongoose models provide several static methods for querying the database:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>find()</code>: Retrieves all documents matching a query. If no query is provided, it returns all documents in the collection.</li>
<li><code>findOne()</code>: Retrieves the first document that matches a query.</li>
<li><code>findById()</code>: Retrieves a document by its unique <code>_id</code>.</li>
</ul>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// In a route handler (e.g., server.js)</span></span>

<h3>Updating Documents</h3>
<p>To update documents, you can use methods like <code>findByIdAndUpdate()</code> or <code>findOneAndUpdate()</code>. These methods find a document and then apply updates to it.</p>
