<h3>Deleting Documents</h3>
<p>To delete documents, use methods like <code>findByIdAndDelete()</code> or <code>findOneAndDelete()</code>.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// In a route handler (e.g., server.js)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> Task</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'./task'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Import the Task model</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Example: Delete a task by ID</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">delete</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'/tasks/:id'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#D73A49">async</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  try</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> task</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> Task.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">findByIdAndDelete</span><span style="color:#24292E">(req.params.id); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Find and delete task by ID</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">task) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">      return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">404</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">send</span><span style="color:#24292E">(); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// If task not found, send 404</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">200</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">send</span><span style="color:#24292E">(task); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Send the deleted task (or a success message)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (error) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">500</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">send</span><span style="color:#24292E">(error); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Send error if deletion fails</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h2>Exercises and Practice Activities</h2>
<p>These exercises build on the concepts of connecting to MongoDB and performing basic CRUD operations using Mongoose and Express.</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Set up Database Connection for an Existing Express App:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Take the simple Express.js web server from a previous lesson.</li>
<li>Install Mongoose (<code>npm install mongoose</code>).</li>
<li>Create a <code>db/mongoose.js</code> file (or similar) that contains the MongoDB connection logic using <code>mongoose.connect()</code>.</li>
<li>Import and call this connection logic in your main <code>server.js</code> (or <code>app.js</code>) file. Ensure the Express server only starts listening <em>after</em> a successful database connection.</li>
<li>Verify the connection by checking console logs when starting your server.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Define a Simple User Schema and Model:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>In your project, create a new file (e.g., <code>models/User.js</code>).</li>
<li>Define a Mongoose schema for a <code>User</code> with the following fields:
<ul>
<li><code>name</code>: String, required, trim</li>
<li><code>email</code>: String, required, trim, lowercase, unique (Mongoose schema validation)</li>
<li><code>age</code>: Number, default 0, validate (ensure age is not negative)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Create a Mongoose model named <code>User</code> from this schema and export it.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Implement User Creation API Endpoint:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>In your <code>server.js</code>, import the <code>User</code> model.</li>
<li>Create a <code>POST /users</code> endpoint.</li>
<li>This endpoint should accept JSON data in the request body (e.g., <code>{ "name": "Alice", "email": "alice@example.com", "age": 30 }</code>).</li>
<li>Use the <code>User</code> model to create a new user document from <code>req.body</code> and save it to the database.</li>
<li>Handle success (respond with the created user and status 201) and error cases (respond with status 400 and the error message).</li>
<li>Test this endpoint using a tool like Postman or Insomnia. Try creating a user with valid data, then try with missing required fields or an invalid age.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Implement Read All Users API Endpoint:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Create a <code>GET /users</code> endpoint.</li>
<li>This endpoint should retrieve all <code>User</code> documents from the database using <code>User.find({})</code>.</li>
<li>Respond with an array of user objects and status 200. Handle potential errors with status 500.</li>
<li>Test this endpoint.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
  
</div>

</div>

<div id="chapter-7">

<div id="chapter-7.1">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Project Setup: Integrating Front-End and Back-End</h1><p>Setting up a full-stack project involves configuring both the front-end (user interface) and back-end (server and database logic) components to work together seamlessly. This integration allows the client-side application to communicate with the server, send and receive data, and ultimately provide a dynamic user experience.</p>
<h2>Project Structure and Initialization</h2>
<p>A common approach to structuring a full-stack project is to separate the front-end and back-end into distinct directories within a single main project folder. This promotes modularity, easier management, and allows for independent development and deployment of each part.</p>
<h3>Main Project Folder</h3>
<p>Begin by creating a parent directory for the entire project. This directory will house both your client-side and server-side codebases.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"># Create the main project directory</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">mkdir</span><span style="color:#032F62"> fullstack-app-project</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"># Navigate into the new directory</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">cd</span><span style="color:#032F62"> fullstack-app-project</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h3>Front-End Setup with React</h3>
<p>The front-end will be a React application. You can initialize a new React project using Create React App or Vite. Create React App is a well-established tool for setting up single-page React applications without manual configuration, while Vite offers a faster development experience. For this project, we will use Create React App as it aligns with previous lessons covering React.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"># Create the client-side React application</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">npx</span><span style="color:#032F62"> create-react-app</span><span style="color:#032F62"> client</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"># Navigate into the client directory</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">cd</span><span style="color:#032F62"> client</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>After creation, the <code>client</code> directory will contain all the necessary files for a React application, including <code>package.json</code> for managing dependencies, <code>src</code> for your component files, and <code>public</code> for static assets.</p>
<h3>Back-End Setup with Node.js and Express</h3>
<p>The back-end will be built with Node.js and Express.js. We'll set up a new Node.js project within a <code>server</code> directory.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"># Navigate back to the root of the fullstack project</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">cd</span><span style="color:#032F62"> ..</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"># Create the server-side Node.js application directory</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">mkdir</span><span style="color:#032F62"> server</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"># Navigate into the server directory</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">cd</span><span style="color:#032F62"> server</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"># Initialize a new Node.js project</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">npm</span><span style="color:#032F62"> init</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> -y</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The <code>npm init -y</code> command creates a <code>package.json</code> file with default settings, which is essential for managing server-side dependencies. Next, install Express.js, a fast, unopinionated, minimalist web framework for Node.js, and <code>cors</code>, a middleware to enable Cross-Origin Resource Sharing.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"># Install Express and CORS</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">npm</span><span style="color:#032F62"> install</span><span style="color:#032F62"> express</span><span style="color:#032F62"> cors</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h2>Configuring Front-End and Back-End Communication</h2>
<p>The front-end and back-end will run on different ports, typically <code>3000</code> for React (development server) and a custom port like <code>5000</code> for the Express server. For them to communicate, specific configurations are needed.</p>
<h3>Enabling CORS on the Back-End</h3>
<p>Since the front-end and back-end will originate from different ports (and potentially different domains in production), the browser's security model (Same-Origin Policy) will block requests from the front-end to the back-end unless the back-end explicitly permits it. This is where CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) comes into play.</p>
<p>In your <code>server</code> directory, create a file named <code>server.js</code> (or <code>app.js</code>) and set up a basic Express server that uses the <code>cors</code> middleware.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// server/server.js</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> express</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'express'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> cors</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'cors'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Import the cors middleware</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> app</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> express</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> PORT</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> process.env.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">PORT</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> ||</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 5000</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Define the port for the server</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Use cors middleware to allow requests from the front-end</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// By default, cors() without arguments allows all origins.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// For production, it's better to specify allowed origins for security.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">use</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">cors</span><span style="color:#24292E">());</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Middleware to parse JSON request bodies</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">use</span><span style="color:#24292E">(express.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">());</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// A simple route to test the server</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">get</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'/api/message'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, (</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ message: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Hello from the back-end!'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Start the server</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">listen</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">PORT</span><span style="color:#24292E">, () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Server is running on port ${</span><span style="color:#005CC5">PORT</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>This configuration tells the browser that requests from other origins (like your React app on <code>localhost:3000</code>) are allowed to interact with this Express server.</p>
<h3>Making API Requests from the Front-End</h3>
<p>On the front-end, your React application will use the <code>fetch</code> API (or a library like Axios) to make HTTP requests to the Express back-end.</p>
<p>In your <code>client</code> directory, open <code>src/App.js</code> and modify it to fetch data from the back-end.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// client/src/App.js</span></span>

<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">  useEffect</span><span style="color:#24292E">(() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Function to fetch data from the back-end</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> fetchMessage</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> async</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">header</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> className</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"App-header"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Full-Stack Application&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Message from Back-End: {message}&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<p>This React component now makes a request to <code>http://localhost:5000/api/message</code> when it first renders. The <code>fetch</code> API is a modern, promise-based API for making network requests. If the back-end is running and configured correctly with CORS, the front-end will successfully retrieve the message.</p>
<h2>Running Both Applications</h2>
<p>To see the integration in action, you need to run both the front-end and back-end servers concurrently.</p>
<h3>Starting the Back-End Server</h3>
<p>First, navigate to your <code>server</code> directory and start the Node.js application.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"># Navigate to the server directory</span></span>

<p>You should see <code>Server is running on port 5000</code> logged in your terminal.</p>
<h3>Starting the Front-End Development Server</h3>
<p>In a separate terminal window, navigate to your <code>client</code> directory and start the React development server.</p>

<p>This will typically open your React application in your browser at <code>http://localhost:3000</code>. You should now see the "Hello from the back-end!" message displayed, indicating successful communication.</p>
<h2>Real-World Application</h2>
<p>Consider a simple e-commerce website. When a user views a product page (front-end), the front-end application sends a request to the back-end to fetch the product details (name, description, price, inventory). The back-end then queries its database, retrieves the information, and sends it back to the front-end, which then renders it on the page.</p>
<p>Another example is a social media application. When a user scrolls through their feed, the front-end continuously makes requests to the back-end to load new posts. The back-end retrieves these posts from the database, potentially processes them (e.g., adding user-specific preferences), and sends them back to the front-end to be displayed. This constant communication between the client (front-end) and server (back-end) is fundamental to dynamic web applications.</p>
<p>For a hypothetical scenario, imagine building an online recipe sharing platform. When a user searches for "pasta recipes" on the front-end, the React application sends this search query to the Node.js/Express back-end. The back-end then takes this query, searches its database of recipes, and returns a list of matching pasta recipes. The front-end receives this data and displays it to the user in an organized, visually appealing format.</p>

<div id="chapter-7.2">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Implementing User Authentication</h1><p>User authentication is the process of verifying the identity of a user, ensuring that only legitimate users can access protected resources or perform specific actions within an application. In a full-stack application, this typically involves both the client-side (front-end) handling user input and session management, and the server-side (back-end) validating credentials, issuing tokens, and protecting API endpoints.</p>
<h2>Authentication Strategies</h2>
<p>Various strategies exist for implementing user authentication, each with its own advantages and use cases.</p>
<h3>Session-Based Authentication</h3>
<p>Session-based authentication relies on storing user session information on the server. When a user logs in, the server creates a unique session ID and sends it back to the client, usually as a cookie. The client then includes this cookie with every subsequent request. The server uses the session ID to identify the user and retrieve their session data.</p>
<p><strong>Example: How Session-Based Authentication Works</strong></p>
<ol>
<li><strong>User Login:</strong> A user submits their username and password to the server.</li>
<li><strong>Server Verification:</strong> The server verifies the credentials against its database.</li>
<li><strong>Session Creation:</strong> If credentials are valid, the server creates a session object (e.g., storing user ID, roles) and a unique session ID. This session data is often stored in a database or in-memory cache on the server.</li>
<li><strong>Cookie Generation:</strong> The server sends a <code>Set-Cookie</code> header in the HTTP response, containing the session ID.</li>
<li><strong>Subsequent Requests:</strong> The client's browser automatically includes the session ID cookie with all future requests to the server.</li>
<li><strong>Server Session Retrieval:</strong> The server receives the cookie, extracts the session ID, and uses it to look up the user's session data to determine if they are authenticated and authorized.</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Pros:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Simple to implement for basic web applications.</li>
<li>Session data can be easily managed and revoked on the server.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Cons:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scalability Issues:</strong> Requires session state to be managed, which can be challenging in distributed systems (e.g., multiple server instances). Sticky sessions or a shared session store (like Redis) are needed.</li>
<li><strong>CSRF Vulnerability:</strong> Susceptible to Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks if not properly protected.</li>
<li><strong>Requires Cookies:</strong> Relies heavily on cookies, which can be problematic for API-only services or mobile applications that don't inherently use cookies.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Token-Based Authentication</h3>
<p>Token-based authentication, particularly using JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), is a stateless approach. Instead of a server-side session, the server generates a cryptographically signed token after successful login. This token contains information about the user and is sent to the client. The client stores this token (e.g., in local storage) and includes it in the <code>Authorization</code> header of every subsequent request. The server then verifies the token's signature and payload to authenticate the user.</p>
<p><strong>Example: How Token-Based Authentication Works with JWT</strong></p>
<ol>
<li><strong>User Login:</strong> A user sends their username and password to the server.</li>
<li><strong>Server Verification:</strong> The server validates the credentials.</li>
<li><strong>JWT Generation:</strong> If valid, the server generates a JWT. This token typically consists of three parts:
<ul>
<li><strong>Header:</strong> Contains the token type (JWT) and the signing algorithm (e.g., HS256).</li>
<li><strong>Payload:</strong> Contains claims, which are statements about an entity (usually the user) and additional data. Common claims include <code>sub</code> (subject, usually user ID), <code>name</code>, <code>exp</code> (expiration time), and <code>iat</code> (issued at time).</li>
<li><strong>Signature:</strong> Created by taking the encoded header, encoded payload, a secret key, and signing them with the algorithm specified in the header.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Token Response:</strong> The server sends the JWT back to the client.</li>
<li><strong>Client Storage:</strong> The client stores the JWT (e.g., in <code>localStorage</code> or <code>sessionStorage</code>).</li>
<li><strong>Subsequent Requests:</strong> For protected routes, the client includes the JWT in the <code>Authorization</code> header, typically as <code>Bearer &lt;token&gt;</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Server Token Verification:</strong> The server receives the token, decodes it, and <em>verifies its signature</em> using the same secret key. If the signature is valid and the token has not expired, the user is authenticated. The server can then access the payload data (e.g., user ID) without needing to query a database for session information.</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Pros:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Stateless:</strong> The server does not need to store session information, making it highly scalable for distributed systems.</li>
<li><strong>Cross-Domain/CORS Friendly:</strong> Tokens can be sent across different domains, suitable for microservices or when the API is on a different domain than the front-end.</li>
<li><strong>Mobile/API Friendly:</strong> Easily used by mobile applications or other API consumers that don't rely on browser cookies.</li>
<li><strong>Security:</strong> Cryptographically signed tokens prevent tampering.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Cons:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Token Revocation:</strong> Revoking a JWT before its expiration can be complex, as the server doesn't "store" the token's state. Blacklisting mechanisms are often required.</li>
<li><strong>Token Size:</strong> JWTs can become large if too much data is put into the payload, increasing request overhead.</li>
<li><strong>Security of Secret Key:</strong> If the secret key used to sign the tokens is compromised, an attacker can forge tokens.</li>
<li><strong>Storage on Client:</strong> Storing JWTs in <code>localStorage</code> can be vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks. <code>HttpOnly</code> cookies can mitigate this, but then some of the benefits of statelessness are reduced.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Implementing User Authentication with Node.js and Express</h2>
<p>For our full-stack project, we will use token-based authentication with JWTs because it offers better scalability and flexibility for modern web applications, especially when integrating with a React front-end. We will leverage <code>bcrypt.js</code> for password hashing and <code>jsonwebtoken</code> for JWT management.</p>
<h3>Password Hashing with <code>bcrypt.js</code></h3>
<p>Storing plain-text passwords in a database is a significant security risk. Password hashing transforms a password into a fixed-size string of characters using a one-way cryptographic function. <code>bcrypt</code> is a popular password hashing algorithm designed to be computationally intensive, making brute-force attacks difficult even with powerful hardware.</p>
<p><strong>Steps:</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Install <code>bcrypt.js</code>:</strong></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">npm</span><span style="color:#032F62"> install</span><span style="color:#032F62"> bcryptjs</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Hash Password during User Registration:</strong>
When a new user registers, hash their password <em>before</em> saving it to the database.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// In your user registration route handler (e.g., POST /api/register)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> bcrypt</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'bcryptjs'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> User</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'../models/User'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Assuming you have a User Mongoose model</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">async</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> registerUser</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">username</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">email</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">password</span><span style="color:#24292E"> } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> req.body;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    try</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Check if user already exists</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> user </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> User.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">findOne</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ email });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (user) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">400</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ msg: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'User already exists'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Generate a salt and hash the password</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> salt</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> bcrypt.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">genSalt</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// 10 is the number of rounds, a common value</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> hashedPassword</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> bcrypt.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">hash</span><span style="color:#24292E">(password, salt);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Create new user instance</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        user </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> User</span><span style="color:#24292E">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            username,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            email,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            password: hashedPassword </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Store the hashed password</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> user.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">save</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">201</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ msg: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'User registered successfully'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (err) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(err.message);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">500</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">send</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Server Error'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<ul>
<li><code>bcrypt.genSalt(10)</code>: Generates a unique salt for each password. A salt is a random string that is added to the password before hashing, making it harder for attackers to use precomputed hash tables (rainbow tables). The <code>10</code> indicates the cost factor; higher values increase the computational cost and security but also slow down the hashing process.</li>
<li><code>bcrypt.hash(password, salt)</code>: Hashes the provided <code>password</code> using the generated <code>salt</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Compare Password during User Login:</strong>
When a user attempts to log in, compare the provided password with the hashed password stored in the database.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// In your user login route handler (e.g., POST /api/login)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> bcrypt</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'bcryptjs'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> User</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'../models/User'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">async</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> loginUser</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">email</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">password</span><span style="color:#24292E"> } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> req.body;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Check if user exists</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> user </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> User.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">findOne</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ email });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">user) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">400</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ msg: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Invalid credentials'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Compare provided password with hashed password</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>

<ul>
<li><code>bcrypt.compare(password, user.password)</code>: This function compares the plain-text <code>password</code> provided by the user with the <code>user.password</code> (the hashed password from the database). It internally re-hashes the provided password with the salt extracted from the stored hash and checks if they match. It returns a boolean.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h3>JSON Web Tokens (JWT) with <code>jsonwebtoken</code></h3>
<p>After successfully verifying user credentials, the server generates a JWT and sends it to the client.</p>
<p><strong>Steps:</strong></p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Install <code>jsonwebtoken</code>:</strong>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">bash</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">npm</span><span style="color:#032F62"> install</span><span style="color:#032F62"> jsonwebtoken</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
<li><strong>Generate JWT on Login:</strong>
Once a user's password is confirmed, generate a JWT.
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// In your user login route handler, after successful password comparison</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> jwt</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'jsonwebtoken'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> config</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'config'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Assuming you use the 'config' package for secrets</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">async</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> loginUser</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">email</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">password</span><span style="color:#24292E"> } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> req.body;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    try</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> user </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> User.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">findOne</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ email });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">user) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">400</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ msg: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Invalid credentials'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> isMatch</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> bcrypt.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">compare</span><span style="color:#24292E">(password, user.password);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">isMatch) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">400</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ msg: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Invalid credentials'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // User is authenticated, generate JWT</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> payload</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            user: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                id: user.id </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Store user ID in the token payload</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Sign the token</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        jwt.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">sign</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            payload,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            config.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">get</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'jwtSecret'</span><span style="color:#24292E">), </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// A secret key for signing tokens, stored securely (e.g., in a config file or environment variable)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            { expiresIn: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'1h'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> }, </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Token expires in 1 hour</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            (</span><span style="color:#E36209">err</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">token</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">                if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (err) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">throw</span><span style="color:#24292E"> err;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ token }); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Send the token back to the client</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        );</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (err) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(err.message);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">500</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">send</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Server Error'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<ul>
<li><code>payload</code>: An object containing the data you want to store in the token. It's good practice to keep this minimal, typically just the user ID.</li>
<li><code>config.get('jwtSecret')</code>: This accesses a secret string from your configuration. <em>Never hardcode your JWT secret in your code.</em> Use environment variables or a configuration management tool like <code>node-config</code>.</li>
<li><code>{ expiresIn: '1h' }</code>: Specifies the token's expiration time. Short expiration times enhance security by limiting the window an attacker has if they compromise a token.</li>
<li><code>res.json({ token })</code>: The generated token is sent back to the client, which will store it and include it in future requests.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h3>Protecting Routes with JWT Middleware</h3>
<p>To protect specific API routes, you'll create a middleware function that verifies the incoming JWT from the client.</p>
<p><strong>Steps:</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Create Middleware File:</strong>
Create a file (e.g., <code>middleware/auth.js</code>) to house your authentication middleware.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// middleware/auth.js</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> jwt</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'jsonwebtoken'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> config</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'config'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> auth</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">next</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Get token from header</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> token</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> req.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">header</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'x-auth-token'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Or 'Authorization' with 'Bearer ' prefix</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Check if no token</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">token) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">401</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ msg: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'No token, authorization denied'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Verify token</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    try</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> decoded</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> jwt.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">verify</span><span style="color:#24292E">(token, config.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">get</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'jwtSecret'</span><span style="color:#24292E">));</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        req.user </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> decoded.user; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Attach the user payload to the request object</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        next</span><span style="color:#24292E">(); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Proceed to the next middleware/route handler</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (err) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">401</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ msg: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Token is not valid'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">module</span><span style="color:#24292E">.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">exports</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> auth;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<ul>
<li><code>req.header('x-auth-token')</code>: This is a common practice for custom authentication tokens. Alternatively, you might use <code>req.header('Authorization')</code> and then extract the token after the "Bearer " prefix.</li>
<li><code>jwt.verify(token, config.get('jwtSecret'))</code>: This function verifies the token using the secret key. If valid, it decodes the token and returns its payload. If invalid (e.g., wrong signature, expired), it throws an error.</li>
<li><code>req.user = decoded.user</code>: If the token is valid, the user's ID (or other payload data) is attached to the <code>req</code> object. This makes the user's information available in subsequent route handlers.</li>
<li><code>next()</code>: Calls the next middleware function in the stack, allowing the request to proceed to the intended route handler.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Apply Middleware to Protected Routes:</strong>
Apply the <code>auth</code> middleware to any routes that require authentication.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// In your API route file (e.g., routes/api/users.js or routes/api/items.js)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> express</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'express'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> router</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> express.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">Router</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> auth</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'../../middleware/auth'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Import the auth middleware</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> User</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'../../models/User'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Assuming you need user data for a profile</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// @route   GET api/auth/user</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// @desc    Get authenticated user (example of a protected route)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// @access  Private</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">router.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">get</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'/user'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, auth, </span><span style="color:#D73A49">async</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    try</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // req.user.id is available because our middleware added it</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> user</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> User.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">findById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(req.user.id).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">select</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'-password'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Exclude password from response</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">(user);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (err) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(err.message);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">500</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">send</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Server Error'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">module</span><span style="color:#24292E">.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">exports</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> router;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<ul>
<li>By placing <code>auth</code> as the second argument in <code>router.get('/user', auth, ...)</code> it ensures that the <code>auth</code> middleware runs <em>before</em> the route handler. If <code>auth</code> determines the user is not authenticated, it will send an error response and not call <code>next()</code>, thus preventing the route handler from executing.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h2>Practical Examples and Demonstrations</h2>
<p>Let's integrate these concepts into a simple Express application.</p>
<p><strong>1. Project Structure:</strong></p>

<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">json</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">{</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "mongoURI"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"mongodb://localhost:27017/my_app_db"</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">  "jwtSecret"</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#032F62">"supersecretjwtkey"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<ul>
<li><em>Security Note:</em> In a production environment, <code>jwtSecret</code> should be an environment variable, not stored directly in <code>default.json</code> or committed to version control. The <code>config</code> package allows you to use <code>custom-environment-variables.json</code> to map config keys to env vars.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>3. <code>backend/models/User.js</code> (Mongoose Model):</strong></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> mongoose</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'mongoose'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
