<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    unique: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">true</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  password: {</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    required: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">true</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  date: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    type: Date,</span></span>

<p><strong>4. <code>backend/routes/api/users.js</code> (User Registration Route):</strong></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> express</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'express'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> router</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> express.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">Router</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> bcrypt</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'bcryptjs'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> User</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'../../models/User'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Import the User model</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// @route   POST api/users/register</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// @desc    Register a new user</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// @access  Public</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">router.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">post</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'/register'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#D73A49">async</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">username</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">email</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">password</span><span style="color:#24292E"> } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> req.body;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    try</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Check if user already exists by email</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> user </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> User.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">findOne</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ email });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (user) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">400</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ msg: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'User with this email already exists'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Check if username is taken</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        user </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> User.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">findOne</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ username });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (user) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">400</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ msg: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Username is already taken'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Hash password</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> salt</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> bcrypt.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">genSalt</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">10</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> hashedPassword</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> bcrypt.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">hash</span><span style="color:#24292E">(password, salt);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Create and save new user</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        user </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> new</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> User</span><span style="color:#24292E">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            username,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            email,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            password: hashedPassword</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> user.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">save</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">201</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ msg: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'User registered successfully!'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (err) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(err.message);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">500</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">send</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Server Error'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">module</span><span style="color:#24292E">.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">exports</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> router;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p><strong>5. <code>backend/routes/api/auth.js</code> (Login and Get User Routes):</strong></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> express</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'express'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> router</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> express.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">Router</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> bcrypt</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'bcryptjs'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> jwt</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'jsonwebtoken'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> config</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'config'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> auth</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'../../middleware/auth'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Import auth middleware</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> User</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'../../models/User'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Import User model</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// @route   POST api/auth/login</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// @desc    Authenticate user &amp; get token (Login)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// @access  Public</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">router.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">post</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'/login'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#D73A49">async</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#24292E"> { </span><span style="color:#005CC5">email</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">password</span><span style="color:#24292E"> } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> req.body;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    try</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Check if user exists</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        let</span><span style="color:#24292E"> user </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> User.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">findOne</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ email });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">user) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">400</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ msg: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Invalid credentials'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Compare password</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> isMatch</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> bcrypt.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">compare</span><span style="color:#24292E">(password, user.password);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">isMatch) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">            return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">400</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ msg: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Invalid credentials'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // User authenticated, create and send JWT</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> payload</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            user: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                id: user.id</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        jwt.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">sign</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            payload,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            config.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">get</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'jwtSecret'</span><span style="color:#24292E">),</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            { expiresIn: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'1h'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            (</span><span style="color:#E36209">err</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">token</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">                if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (err) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">throw</span><span style="color:#24292E"> err;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ token });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        );</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (err) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(err.message);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">500</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">send</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Server Error'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// @route   GET api/auth/user</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// @desc    Get authenticated user data</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// @access  Private (requires token)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">router.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">get</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'/user'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, auth, </span><span style="color:#D73A49">async</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    try</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // req.user.id comes from our 'auth' middleware</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> user</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> User.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">findById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(req.user.id).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">select</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'-password'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// -password excludes the password hash</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">(user);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (err) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(err.message);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">500</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">send</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'Server Error'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">module</span><span style="color:#24292E">.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">exports</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> router;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p><strong>6. <code>backend/middleware/auth.js</code> (Authentication Middleware):</strong></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> jwt</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'jsonwebtoken'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> config</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'config'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">function</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> auth</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">next</span><span style="color:#24292E">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Get token from header (usually 'x-auth-token' or 'Authorization: Bearer &lt;token&gt;')</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> token</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> req.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">header</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'x-auth-token'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Check if no token</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    if</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">token) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        return</span><span style="color:#24292E"> res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">401</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ msg: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'No token, authorization denied'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Verify token</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    try</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> decoded</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> jwt.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">verify</span><span style="color:#24292E">(token, config.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">get</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'jwtSecret'</span><span style="color:#24292E">));</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        req.user </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> decoded.user; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Attach user information from the token payload to the request</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">        next</span><span style="color:#24292E">(); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Call next middleware</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (err) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">status</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">401</span><span style="color:#24292E">).</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ msg: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'Token is not valid'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">module</span><span style="color:#24292E">.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">exports</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> auth;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p><strong>7. <code>backend/server.js</code> (Main Express Application File):</strong></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> express</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'express'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> mongoose</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'mongoose'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> config</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'config'</span><span style="color:#24292E">); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// For accessing mongoURI and jwtSecret</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> app</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> express</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Connect to MongoDB</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> connectDB</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> async</span><span style="color:#24292E"> () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">  try</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    await</span><span style="color:#24292E"> mongoose.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">connect</span><span style="color:#24292E">(config.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">get</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'mongoURI'</span><span style="color:#24292E">), {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      useNewUrlParser: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">true</span><span style="color:#24292E">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">      useUnifiedTopology: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">true</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'MongoDB Connected...'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  } </span><span style="color:#D73A49">catch</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (err) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">error</span><span style="color:#24292E">(err.message);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Exit process with failure</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    process.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">exit</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">1</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">};</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">connectDB</span><span style="color:#24292E">();</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Init Middleware</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">use</span><span style="color:#24292E">(express.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">json</span><span style="color:#24292E">({ extended: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">false</span><span style="color:#24292E"> })); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// Allows us to get data in req.body</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">get</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'/'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, (</span><span style="color:#E36209">req</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#E36209">res</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> res.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">send</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'API Running'</span><span style="color:#24292E">));</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Define Routes</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">use</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'/api/users'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#6F42C1">require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'./routes/api/users'</span><span style="color:#24292E">)); </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// For user registration</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">use</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'/api/auth'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#6F42C1">require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'./routes/api/auth'</span><span style="color:#24292E">));   </span><span style="color:#6A737D">// For user login and getting authenticated user</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> PORT</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> process.env.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">PORT</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> ||</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 5000</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">app.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">listen</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">PORT</span><span style="color:#24292E">, () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> console.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">log</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">`Server started on port ${</span><span style="color:#005CC5">PORT</span><span style="color:#032F62">}`</span><span style="color:#24292E">));</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>To run this backend, you would:</p>
<ol>
<li>Make sure MongoDB is running.</li>
<li>Navigate to the <code>backend</code> directory in your terminal.</li>
<li>Install dependencies: <code>npm install express mongoose bcryptjs jsonwebtoken config</code></li>
<li>Start the server: <code>node server.js</code></li>
</ol>
<p>You can then test these endpoints using a tool like Postman or Insomnia:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Register User (POST <code>http://localhost:5000/api/users/register</code>)</strong>:
Body (raw JSON): <code>{"username": "testuser", "email": "test@example.com", "password": "password123"}</code></li>
<li><strong>Login User (POST <code>http://localhost:5000/api/auth/login</code>)</strong>:
Body (raw JSON): <code>{"email": "test@example.com", "password": "password123"}</code>
<ul>
<li>This should return a JWT. Copy this token.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Get Authenticated User (GET <code>http://localhost:5000/api/auth/user</code>)</strong>:
Headers: <code>x-auth-token: &lt;PASTE_YOUR_JWT_HERE&gt;</code>
<ul>
<li>This should return the user's data (without the password). If you omit the token or provide an invalid one, you will receive a <code>401 Unauthorized</code> error.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Exercises</h2>
<ol>
<li><strong>Implement Email Verification (Hypothetical Scenario):</strong>
Modify the user registration flow to include a simple email verification step. After a user registers, instead of immediately returning <code>User registered successfully!</code>, generate a unique verification token (e.g., a short random string, not a JWT for this purpose) and save it to the user's document in the database (add a <code>verificationToken</code> field and an <code>isVerified: {type: Boolean, default: false}</code> field to the <code>User</code> model). Simulate sending this token via email by logging it to the console. The user would then "click a link" containing this token to a new <code>/api/users/verify/:token</code> endpoint. Implement this endpoint to find the user by <code>verificationToken</code>, set <code>isVerified</code> to <code>true</code>, and then return a success message.</li>
<li><strong>Add Role-Based Access Control (RBAC):</strong>
Extend the <code>User</code> model to include a <code>role</code> field (e.g., <code>role: { type: String, default: 'user', enum: ['user', 'admin'] }</code>).
<ul>
<li>Modify the JWT payload to include the user's role.</li>
<li>Create a new middleware (e.g., <code>middleware/adminAuth.js</code>) that first uses the existing <code>auth</code> middleware, and then checks if <code>req.user.role</code> is 'admin'. If not, return a <code>403 Forbidden</code> status.</li>
<li>Create a new protected route (e.g., <code>GET /api/admin/dashboard</code>) that <em>only</em> administrators can access by applying both the <code>auth</code> and <code>adminAuth</code> middleware. Test this by logging in as a regular user and an admin (you'll need to manually change a user's role in the database for testing).</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
  
</div>

<div id="chapter-7.3">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Creating and Managing Data with React and Node.js</h1><p>This lesson focuses on creating and managing data within a full-stack application, integrating the front-end (React) with the back-end (Node.js/Express) to perform common data operations. We will explore how to make HTTP requests from React components to an Express API and how the Express API handles these requests, interacts with a database (like MongoDB, as introduced in Module 6), and sends appropriate responses back to the React front-end. This involves implementing <strong>CRUD</strong> operations: Create, Read, Update, and Delete for our application's data.</p>
<h2>Setting Up API Endpoints for Data Management</h2>
<p>The Express.js back-end needs to expose specific endpoints that the front-end can interact with to manage data. These endpoints correspond to the CRUD operations. We'll use RESTful principles for our API design, which means using standard HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) and clear URL structures.</p>
<h3>Defining Routes in Express</h3>
<p>In Express, routes are defined using methods like <code>app.get()</code>, <code>app.post()</code>, <code>app.put()</code>, and <code>app.delete()</code>. Each route handles a specific HTTP request to a particular URL path.</p>
<p><strong>Example: Task Management Application</strong></p>
<p>Let's assume we are building a simple task management application where users can create, view, update, and delete tasks. Our MongoDB database might store task objects with fields like <code>title</code>, <code>description</code>, <code>status</code>, and <code>dueDate</code>.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// backend/server.js or backend/routes/taskRoutes.js</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> express</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> require</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'express'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>

<p>In <code>backend/server.js</code>, you would typically integrate these routes:</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">javascript</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// backend/server.js</span></span>

<h2>Consuming API Endpoints from React</h2>
<p>On the React front-end, we use the <code>fetch</code> API or a library like <code>Axios</code> to make HTTP requests to these Express endpoints. We'll leverage React Hooks like <code>useState</code> and <code>useEffect</code> (introduced in Module 5) to manage component state and side effects, such as fetching data when a component mounts.</p>
<h3>Fetching Data (Read)</h3>
<p>To display a list of tasks, a React component would make a <code>GET</code> request to the <code>/api/tasks</code> endpoint.</p>

<h3>Updating Data (Update)</h3>
<p>To update an existing task, a React component sends a <code>PUT</code> request to the <code>/api/tasks/:id</code> endpoint with the updated data.</p>

<h3>Deleting Data (Delete)</h3>
<p>To delete a task, a React component sends a <code>DELETE</code> request to the <code>/api/tasks/:id</code> endpoint.</p>

<p>The individual CRUD components (TaskList, TaskForm, EditTaskForm, TaskItem) need to be integrated into a main application component that manages the overall state and coordinates interactions.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            ) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">:</span><span style="color:#24292E"> (</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            )}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">hr</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> style</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{{ margin: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'30px 0'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> }} /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Current Tasks&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            {tasks.</span><span style="color:#005CC5">length</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> ===</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> &amp;&amp;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;No tasks to display.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;}</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> key</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{task._id} </span><span style="color:#6F42C1">style</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{{ display: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'flex'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, justifyContent: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'space-between'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, alignItems: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'center'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, padding: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'8px 0'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, borderBottom: </span><span style="color:#032F62">'1px dotted #eee'</span><span style="color:#24292E"> }}&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                        &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">                            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> onClick</span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E">{() </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> handleTaskDeleted</span><span style="color:#24292E">(task._id)}&gt;Delete&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">export</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> default</span><span style="color:#24292E"> App;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<h2>Error Handling and User Feedback</h2>
<p>Robust applications handle errors gracefully and provide clear feedback to the user.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Backend Error Handling</strong>: In Node.js, <code>try-catch</code> blocks are used to catch errors during database operations or other asynchronous tasks. Appropriate HTTP status codes (e.g., 400 for bad request, 404 for not found, 500 for server error) are crucial for the front-end to understand the nature of the error.</li>
<li><strong>Frontend Error Handling</strong>: In React, <code>try-catch</code> blocks within <code>fetch</code> or <code>Axios</code> calls handle network errors or API response errors. State variables (<code>error</code>, <code>loading</code>, <code>submitting</code>) are used to display messages to the user (e.g., "Failed to load tasks," "Adding...", "Error deleting task").</li>
<li><strong>Loading States</strong>: Showing a loading indicator (<code>loading</code> state) prevents users from thinking the application is frozen and provides immediate feedback during data fetching or submission.</li>
<li><strong>Validation</strong>: Input validation should occur on both the front-end (for immediate user feedback) and the back-end (for data integrity and security, as front-end validation can be bypassed).</li>
</ul>
<h2>Exercises</h2>
<ol>
<li><strong>Implement Edit Functionality in TaskList</strong>: Modify the <code>TaskList</code> component (or <code>TaskItem</code> component) to include "Edit" buttons next to each task. When an "Edit" button is clicked, set the <code>editingTask</code> state in <code>App.js</code> to the selected task, causing the <code>EditTaskForm</code> to render with the task's current data.</li>
<li><strong>Add Input Validation to TaskForm</strong>:
<ul>
<li><strong>Frontend</strong>: In <code>TaskForm.js</code>, add client-side validation to ensure the <code>title</code> field is not empty before submitting. Display an error message to the user if validation fails.</li>
<li><strong>Backend</strong>: In the Express <code>POST</code> route for creating a task, add server-side validation to check if <code>req.body.title</code> is present. If not, respond with a <code>400 Bad Request</code> status and a JSON message like <code>{ message: "Task title is required." }</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Enhance Error Display</strong>:
<ul>
<li>For the <code>TaskList</code> component, if there's an error fetching tasks, display a "Retry" button that attempts to fetch tasks again.</li>
<li>For the <code>TaskForm</code>, after a failed submission, clear the error message after 5 seconds automatically.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h2>Real-World Application</h2>
<p>Managing data with React and Node.js is fundamental to almost any dynamic web application.</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>E-commerce Platform</strong>: When a user adds an item to their cart, the React front-end sends a <code>POST</code> request to the Node.js back-end. The back-end then updates the user's cart in the database (e.g., MongoDB), adding the new item and its quantity. If the user later updates the quantity or removes an item, <code>PUT</code> or <code>DELETE</code> requests are made respectively. When the user views their cart, a <code>GET</code> request retrieves the current cart contents from the back-end, which React then renders.</li>
<li><strong>Social Media Feed</strong>: When you scroll through a social media feed, the React front-end continuously makes <code>GET</code> requests (often with pagination parameters) to a Node.js API to fetch new posts from the database. When you "like" a post, the React app sends a <code>PUT</code> request to the Node.js API to update the like count for that post in the database. When you create a new post, a <code>POST</code> request sends your content to the server for storage.</li>
</ol>
  
</div>

<div id="chapter-7.4">

<h1 class="mb-6 text-3xl font-semibold text-balance max-lg:mb-3 max-lg:text-xl">Website Accessibility Considerations and Best Practices</h1><p>Website accessibility ensures that people with disabilities can perceive, understand, navigate, and interact with the web. This includes a wide range of disabilities such as visual, auditory, physical, speech, cognitive, and neurological disabilities. Implementing accessibility best practices benefits everyone, including users with temporary limitations (e.g., a broken arm) or situational limitations (e.g., bright sunlight making a screen hard to read).</p>
<h2>Understanding Web Accessibility Principles</h2>
<p>Web accessibility is built upon core principles that guide its implementation. The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) categorize these principles under Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, and Robust (POUR).</p>
<h3>Perceivable</h3>
<p>Information and user interface components must be presentable to users in ways they can perceive. This means providing alternatives for non-text content, ensuring sufficient contrast, and making content adaptable.</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Text Alternatives for Non-Text Content:</strong> All non-text content (images, audio, video) should have a text alternative that serves the equivalent purpose. For example, an <code>&lt;img&gt;</code> tag requires an <code>alt</code> attribute. This text is read by screen readers for visually impaired users.</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Example 1 (Basic):</strong> A simple logo image.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">img</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> src</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"logo.png"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> alt</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Company Logo"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>In this case, "Company Logo" clearly describes the image's purpose.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Example 2 (Descriptive):</strong> An image conveying specific information.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">img</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> src</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"graph-sales-q3.png"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> alt</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Bar graph showing Q3 sales increasing by 15% compared to Q2."</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The <code>alt</code> text provides a concise summary of the visual data.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Hypothetical Scenario:</strong> Imagine an online retail site where product images are displayed. If a screen reader user encounters an image of a "Blue Denim Jacket," the <code>alt</code> text "Blue Denim Jacket" allows them to understand what the image shows, just like a sighted user would. Without it, they'd just hear "image" which provides no useful information.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Time-based Media Alternatives:</strong> For audio-only content, a transcript should be provided. For video-only content, a description. For synchronized media (audio + video), captions and/or sign language interpretation are needed.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Example (Video with Captions):</strong>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">video</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> controls</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> src</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"interview.mp4"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">track</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> kind</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"captions"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> srclang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> label</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"English"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> src</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"interview-captions-en.vtt"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">track</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> kind</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"descriptions"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> srclang</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"en"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> label</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"English Audio Description"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> src</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"interview-descriptions-en.vtt"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    Your browser does not support the video tag.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">video</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
The <code>&lt;track&gt;</code> elements link to WebVTT files that contain time-synchronized captions and audio descriptions, making the video accessible to users with hearing or visual impairments.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Distinguishable Content:</strong> Ensure good color contrast between text and background, and avoid using color as the sole means of conveying information. Text should be resizable without loss of content or functionality.</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Example 1 (Color Contrast):</strong> Text with insufficient contrast. If light gray text is used on a white background, it might be illegible for users with low vision or color blindness. WCAG recommends a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Poor contrast */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.poor-contrast</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#AAAAAA</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Light gray */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#FFFFFF</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* White */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Good contrast */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.good-contrast</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#333333</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Dark gray */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    background-color</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">#FFFFFF</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* White */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Example 2 (Color as Sole Indicator):</strong> A form where required fields are indicated only by red text. A colorblind user might not perceive the red and therefore miss which fields are mandatory. Instead, use icons, asterisks, or explicit text labels in addition to color.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">&lt;!-- Poor practice: only color for required --&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> for</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"name"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> style</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"color: red;"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Name:&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"text"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"name"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> required</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">&lt;!-- Better practice: color + asterisk + ARIA --&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> for</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"email"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">span</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> style</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"color: red;"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;*&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">span</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt; Email:&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"email"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"email"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> required</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> aria-required</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"true"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>Operable</h3>
<p>User interface components and navigation must be operable. This includes making all functionality available from a keyboard, giving users enough time to interact with content, avoiding content that causes seizures, and providing ways to help users navigate.</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Keyboard Accessibility:</strong> All interactive elements (links, buttons, form fields) must be reachable and operable using only a keyboard. This means ensuring proper tab order and providing clear visual focus indicators.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Example (Interactive elements):</strong> A navigation menu. Users should be able to tab through each link and activate it with the Enter key.
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">nav</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"#home"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Home&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"#products"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Products&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"#contact"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Contact&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">nav</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
HTML's native interactive elements (<code>&lt;a&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;button&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;input&gt;</code>) are keyboard-accessible by default. Custom elements or div-based buttons often require <code>tabindex</code> and event listeners for keyboard support.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Sufficient Time:</strong> Users should have enough time to read and use content. This means avoiding automatic content updates or carousels that move too quickly, or providing options to pause, stop, or extend time limits for tasks.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Example (Carousel control):</strong> A rotating image carousel should include "pause" and "next/previous" controls accessible to keyboard users.
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"carousel"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> aria-label</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Pause carousel"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"pause-button"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;⏸&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> aria-label</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Previous image"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"prev-button"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;←&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">img</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> src</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"img1.jpg"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> alt</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Description of image 1"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">img</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> src</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"img2.jpg"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> alt</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Description of image 2"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> aria-label</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Next image"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"next-button"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;→&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Navigation and Orientation:</strong> Provide clear and consistent navigation mechanisms. Use descriptive page titles and headings, and offer skip links to bypass repetitive content.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Example (Skip Link):</strong> A "Skip to main content" link at the top of a page.
