<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"#main-content"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"skip-link"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Skip to main content&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">header</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;...&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">header</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">nav</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;...&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">nav</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">main</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"main-content"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Welcome to our site&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        &lt;!-- Main content here --&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">main</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">body</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
The <code>.skip-link</code> should be visually hidden by default but become visible on keyboard focus.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>Understandable</h3>
<p>Information and the operation of user interface must be understandable. This involves making text readable, making content predictable, and helping users avoid and correct mistakes.</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Readable and Legible Content:</strong> Use clear and simple language, avoid jargon, and provide definitions for unusual words. Ensure text is presented in a readable font size and style.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Example (Clarity):</strong> Instead of "Leverage synergistic paradigms to optimize core competencies," write "Use effective strategies to improve key skills."
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Using effective strategies to improve key skills allows us to achieve better results.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Predictable Functionality:</strong> User interface components should behave in predictable ways. Navigation should be consistent across the site. Changes of context (like opening new windows) should be explicitly communicated.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Example (Consistent Navigation):</strong> The primary navigation bar should appear in the same location and order on every page.
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">&lt;!-- All pages should have a similar nav structure --&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">nav</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"main-nav"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"/"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Home&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"/about"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;About Us&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"/services"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Services&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">nav</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Input Assistance:</strong> Help users avoid mistakes and correct them. Provide clear error messages, labels for form fields, and instructions.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Example (Form Labels and Error Handling):</strong>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">form</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> for</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"username"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Username:&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"text"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"username"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> aria-describedby</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"username-error"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"username-error"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> role</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"alert"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> style</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"color: red; display: none;"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Username must be at least 6 characters long.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> for</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"password"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Password:&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"password"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"password"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> aria-describedby</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"password-error"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"password-error"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> role</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"alert"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> style</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"color: red; display: none;"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Password is required.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"submit"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Log In&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">form</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
Each input has a <code>&lt;label&gt;</code> linked by <code>for</code>/<code>id</code>. Error messages are associated with <code>aria-describedby</code> and given <code>role="alert"</code> so screen readers announce them immediately.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>Robust</h3>
<p>Content must be robust enough that it can be interpreted reliably by a wide variety of user agents, including assistive technologies. This largely means using valid HTML and ARIA.</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Markup Validity:</strong> Use valid HTML to ensure cross-browser and assistive technology compatibility. Semantic HTML (as covered in Module 1) plays a crucial role here, providing meaning to content beyond its visual presentation.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Example (Semantic HTML vs. Div Soup):</strong>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">&lt;!-- Less robust (div soup) --&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"header"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"logo"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Company Name&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"nav"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Home&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;About&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">&lt;!-- More robust (semantic HTML) --&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">header</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Company Name&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">nav</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"#"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Home&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">            &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> href</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"#"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;About&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">a</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">li</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">ul</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">nav</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">header</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
Semantic tags like <code>&lt;header&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;h1&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;nav&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;ul&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;li&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;a&gt;</code> inherently communicate their purpose to browsers and assistive technologies, making the content more robust.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>ARIA (Accessible Rich Internet Applications):</strong> When native HTML semantics are not sufficient (e.g., for custom widgets like tabs, accordions, or custom sliders), ARIA attributes provide additional semantic information to assistive technologies.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Example (Custom Tab Widget):</strong>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> role</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"tablist"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> aria-label</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Project Sections"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> role</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"tab"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"tab-1"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> aria-selected</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"true"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> aria-controls</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"panel-1"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Section A&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> role</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"tab"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"tab-2"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> aria-selected</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"false"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> aria-controls</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"panel-2"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Section B&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"panel-1"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> role</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"tabpanel"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> tabindex</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"0"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> aria-labelledby</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"tab-1"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    Content for Section A.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"panel-2"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> role</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"tabpanel"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> tabindex</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"0"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> aria-labelledby</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"tab-2"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> hidden</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    Content for Section B.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
ARIA roles (<code>tablist</code>, <code>tab</code>, <code>tabpanel</code>) define the structure and purpose of the custom component. <code>aria-selected</code> indicates the current state, and <code>aria-controls</code>/<code>aria-labelledby</code> link related elements.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Practical Accessibility Best Practices</h2>
<p>Applying the POUR principles involves concrete actions during development.</p>
<h3>Semantic HTML Usage</h3>
<p>As discussed in Module 1, using appropriate HTML5 semantic elements (<code>&lt;header&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;nav&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;main&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;aside&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;footer&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;article&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;section&gt;</code>) provides inherent meaning to the structure of your page. This is crucial for screen readers and other assistive technologies to understand the document outline.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Good Example:</strong> A blog post structure.
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">article</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">header</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Blog Post Title&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;By John Doe, &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">time</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> datetime</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"2023-10-26"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;October 26, 2023&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">time</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">header</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">section</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Introduction&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;...&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">section</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">section</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Main Topic&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;...&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Sub-topic 1&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;...&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">section</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">footer</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Tags: Accessibility, Web Dev&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">footer</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">article</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
Screen readers can navigate by headings (<code>h1</code>, <code>h2</code>, <code>h3</code>) and understand the different sections defined by <code>&lt;article&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;section&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;header&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;footer&gt;</code>.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Proper Image and Media Alternatives</h3>
<p>Always provide <code>alt</code> text for <code>&lt;img&gt;</code> tags. For decorative images, an empty <code>alt=""</code> is appropriate so screen readers skip them.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Example (Decorative Image):</strong> A background pattern or icon that doesn't convey information.
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">img</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> src</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"decorative-bg.png"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> alt</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">""</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
This signals to assistive technologies that the image is purely decorative and can be ignored.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Keyboard Navigation and Focus Management</h3>
<p>Ensure all interactive elements are reachable via keyboard (<code>Tab</code> key). The focus indicator (the outline that appears around elements) must be visible.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>CSS for Focus Indicator:</strong>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">css</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Default browser focus outline */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#22863A">*</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">:focus</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    outline</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> solid</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> blue</span><span style="color:#24292E">; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Or a custom, visible outline */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    outline-offset</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">2</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">/* Avoid removing outline without providing an alternative */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6F42C1">.my-button:focus</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    /* Bad: Removes outline entirely */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    /* outline: none; */</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    /* Good: Provides a clear visual indicator */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5">    box-shadow</span><span style="color:#24292E">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 0</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> 3</span><span style="color:#D73A49">px</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> rgba</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#005CC5">0</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">123</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">255</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#005CC5">0.5</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
Removing the default <code>outline</code> with <code>outline: none;</code> is a common anti-pattern that severely harms keyboard accessibility. Always provide an alternative if you customize it.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Form Accessibility</h3>
<p>Forms are critical interaction points. Use <code>&lt;label&gt;</code> elements linked to their respective inputs with <code>for</code>/<code>id</code>. Provide clear instructions and error messages.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Example (Accessible Form Field):</strong>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> for</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"newsletter-email"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Email Address:&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">label</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"email"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"newsletter-email"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> required</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> aria-describedby</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"email-help-text"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"email-help-text"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;We'll never share your email with anyone else.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">div</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
The <code>aria-describedby</code> attribute links the help text to the input, which is read by screen readers after the label.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Headings and Document Structure</h3>
<p>Use heading tags (<code>&lt;h1&gt;</code> to <code>&lt;h6&gt;</code>) to structure content hierarchically. Only use one <code>&lt;h1&gt;</code> per page for the main title. Do not skip heading levels (e.g., jump from <code>&lt;h2&gt;</code> to <code>&lt;h4&gt;</code>).</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Example (Heading Structure):</strong>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Page Main Title&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h1</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">section</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Section Heading&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Content for the section.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">article</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Article Sub-heading&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h3</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Content for the article.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h4</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Further Detail&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h4</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;More specific content.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">article</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">section</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">section</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Another Section&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">h2</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;More content.&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">p</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">section</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
This structure helps screen reader users navigate by headings, getting an overview of the page content.</li>
</ul>
<h3>ARIA Roles and Attributes (When Necessary)</h3>
<p>Use ARIA to enhance the semantics of custom UI components that lack native HTML equivalents. Common ARIA attributes include <code>role</code> (defines the type of UI element), <code>aria-label</code> (provides a descriptive label when no visible text is present), <code>aria-labelledby</code> (references a visible element that serves as a label), <code>aria-describedby</code> (references an element providing a description), and state attributes like <code>aria-expanded</code>, <code>aria-checked</code>, <code>aria-selected</code>.</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Example (Custom Button with Icon Only):</strong></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> aria-label</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"Close dialog"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> class</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"close-button"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">img</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> src</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"close-icon.svg"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> alt</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">""</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt; </span><span style="color:#6A737D">&lt;!-- Decorative image, empty alt --&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The <code>aria-label</code> provides a meaningful name for screen readers, as the button itself only contains an icon.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Example (Toggle Button):</strong></p>
<div class="not-prose my-6 max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 has-[code:empty]:hidden"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2"><span class="text-sm text-gray-600">html</span><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button class="flex size-6 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-black focus:outline-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button></div></div><div class="mt-0 text-sm [&amp;_pre]:py-0 [&amp;_pre]:grid [&amp;_code]:py-4 [&amp;_code]:w-full [&amp;_code]:grid [&amp;_code]:overflow-x-auto [&amp;_code]:no-scrollbar [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent [&amp;_.line]:px-3 [&amp;_.line]:w-full [&amp;_.line]:relative [&amp;_.line]:min-h-5"><div><pre class="shiki github-light" style="background-color:#fff;color:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> aria-pressed</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"false"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"toggle-mute"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Mute Audio&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">    const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> toggleButton</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> document.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getElementById</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'toggle-mute'</span><span style="color:#24292E">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    toggleButton.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">addEventListener</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'click'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, () </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#24292E"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#D73A49">        const</span><span style="color:#005CC5"> isPressed</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> =</span><span style="color:#24292E"> toggleButton.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">getAttribute</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'aria-pressed'</span><span style="color:#24292E">) </span><span style="color:#D73A49">===</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'true'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        toggleButton.</span><span style="color:#6F42C1">setAttribute</span><span style="color:#24292E">(</span><span style="color:#032F62">'aria-pressed'</span><span style="color:#24292E">, </span><span style="color:#D73A49">!</span><span style="color:#24292E">isPressed);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">        toggleButton.textContent </span><span style="color:#D73A49">=</span><span style="color:#24292E"> isPressed </span><span style="color:#D73A49">?</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'Mute Audio'</span><span style="color:#D73A49"> :</span><span style="color:#032F62"> 'Unmute Audio'</span><span style="color:#24292E">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Logic to mute/unmute audio</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">script</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div>
<p>The <code>aria-pressed</code> attribute communicates the toggle state (on/off) to assistive technologies.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Exercises</h2>
<ol>
<li>

<span class="line"></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">input</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> type</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"email"</span><span style="color:#6F42C1"> id</span><span style="color:#24292E">=</span><span style="color:#032F62">"user-email"</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E">    &lt;</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;Submit&lt;/</span><span style="color:#22863A">button</span><span style="color:#24292E">&gt;</span></span>
